          Yapay Zeka Destekli Kişisel Gelişim ve Oyunlaştırma Platformu

DİL: Türkçe


================================================================================
 1. PROJE ÖZETİ
================================================================================

LifeQuest, kullanıcıların kişisel gelişim hedeflerini başarmalarına yardımcı
olan, yapay zeka ve oyunlaştırma mekanizmalarından yararlanan modern bir
platformdur.

📌 Temel Amaçlar:
  • Kullanıcıları günlük görevler tamamlamaya motive etmek
  • Kategori bazlı (Eğitim, Sağlık, Kariyer, Sosyal) seviye sistemi
  • XP (Deneyim Puanı) kazanarak seviye atlama
  • Rozetler ve başarılar açma
  • Sosyal özellikler (arkadaşlık, yarışma)
  • AI asistanı ile kişiselleştirilmiş görev önerileri

💡 Kişiye Özgü Yaklaşım:
  • Kayıt sırasında "Seni Tanıyalım" anketi
  • Kullanıcı profiline göre akıllı görev atama
  • Timer ve basit doğrulama ile gerçekçi görev tamamlama

3.3 REACTİON FLOW

Kayıt Akışı:
  Register.jsx → Anket Soruları Göster
             → Anket Cevapları Topla
             → POST /api/auth/register (+ questionnaire data)
             → Backend: AppUser.Goals, DailyAvailableMinutes vb. kaydet
             → Token al → Login sayfasına yönlendir

Dashboard Akışı:
  DashBoard.jsx → Yükleniyor...
             → GET /api/users/{userId} (İstatistikler)
             → GET /api/user-tasks/get-recommendations (YENİ - 3 görev öner)
             → Önerilen görevleri göster
             → Kullanıcı "Seç" tıklayınca
             → POST /api/user-tasks/request-task
             → TaskList.jsx'e yönlendir


3.4 YENİ KOMPONENTLERİ (EKLEME GEREKLI)

YENİ: QuestionnaireForm.jsx
──────────────────────────
Props:
  - onComplete: function (cevapları parent'a döndür)
  - initialData: object (opsiyonel)

State:
  - currentQuestion: number
  - answers: object
  - isLoading: boolean

Features:
  - Soru soru ilerle
  - Geri dön butonu
  - İlerleme göstergesi (7 soru, %20-%100)
  - Cevapları validate et


YENİ: TaskRecommendations.jsx
──────────────────────────────
Props:
  - recommendations: Array<{taskId, title, description, matchScore, reason}>
  - onSelectTask: function(taskId)
  - loading: boolean

Features:
  - 3 görev kartı göster
  - Her kartında: Başlık, Açıklama, XP, Zorluk, Match Score (%)
  - "Seç" butonu


UPDATED: TaskTimer.jsx
──────────────────────
Props:
  - requiredMinutes: number
  - taskTitle: string
  - onComplete: function

Features:
  - Countdown timer
  - Start/Pause/Reset butonları
  - Tamamla butonu (Min süre geçtiyse aktif)

4.2 KEY ENTITIES (Detaylı)

AppUser (GÜNCELLENECEK)
───────────────────────
public sealed class AppUser : BaseEntity
{
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public string Surname { get; set; }
    public string UserName { get; set; }
    public string Email { get; set; }
    public byte[] PasswordHash { get; set; }
    public byte[] PasswordSalt { get; set; }
    public Guid AppRoleId { get; set; }
    public int TotalXP { get; set; } = 0;
    public double GeneralLevel { get; set; } = 1.0;
    
    // YENİ ALANLAR: Anket Soruları
    public List<string>? Goals { get; set; }                    // ["fitness", "reading"]
    public int? DailyAvailableMinutes { get; set; }            // 15, 30, 60, 120
    public List<string>? Strengths { get; set; }               // ["technology", "writing"]
    public List<string>? Weaknesses { get; set; }              // ["discipline", "focus"]
    public string? MotivationFactor { get; set; }              // "leveling", "badges", etc
    public int? PreferredTasksPerWeek { get; set; }            // 3, 5, 7, 10, 15
    public string? DifficultyPreference { get; set; }          // "easy", "medium", "hard", "mixed"
    public bool ProfileCompleted { get; set; } = false;
    public DateTime? ProfileCompletedAt { get; set; }
    
    // Navigation Properties
    public ICollection<UserCategoryProgress> CategoryProgresses { get; set; }
    public ICollection<UserTask> UserTasks { get; set; }
    public ICollection<UserBadge> UserBadges { get; set; }
    public ICollection<UserGoal> Goals { get; set; }
    public ICollection<Notification> Notifications { get; set; }
}


UserTask
────────
public sealed class UserTask : BaseEntity
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public AppUser User { get; set; }
    
    public Guid AppTaskId { get; set; }
    public AppTask AppTask { get; set; }
    
    public AppTaskStatus Status { get; set; }  // Pending, InProgress, Completed
    public int XpGained { get; set; }
    public DateTime AssignedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? DueDate { get; set; }
    public DateTime? CompletedAt { get; set; }
    
    // Timer Tracking
    public int? RequiredMinutes { get; set; }
    public int? ActualMinutesSpent { get; set; }
    
    // Navigation
    public TaskVerification? Verification { get; set; }
}


TaskVerification (BASIT GÜNCELLENECEK)
──────────────────────────────────────
public sealed class TaskVerification : BaseEntity
{
    public Guid UserTaskId { get; set; }
    public UserTask UserTask { get; set; }
    
    // Timer Verification
    public int? TimerMinutesSpent { get; set; }
    public int? MinimumTimerMinutesRequired { get; set; }
    
    // Status
    public VerificationStatus Status { get; set; }  // Approved, Pending
    public DateTime VerifiedAt { get; set; }
}


AppTask
───────
public sealed class AppTask : BaseEntity
{
    public string Title { get; set; }
    public string Description { get; set; }
    public Guid CategoryId { get; set; }
    public Category Category { get; set; }
    
    public int MinLevel { get; set; }
    public int MaxLevel { get; set; }
    public int BaseXP { get; set; }
    
    public DifficultyLevel Difficulty { get; set; }  // Easy, Medium, Hard
    public bool IsDaily { get; set; }
    public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;
    
    // YENİ: Tahmini Süre
    public int? EstimatedMinutes { get; set; }
    
    // YENİ: Teknik Alanlar
    public List<string>? TargetedWeaknesses { get; set; }  // ["discipline"]
}

Notification
─────────────
public sealed class Notification : BaseEntity
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public AppUser User { get; set; }
    
    public NotificationType Type { get; set; }  // TaskAssigned, LevelUp, BadgeEarned, etc
    public string Title { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; }

}

4.5 SERVICES

GamificationService
───────────────────
// XP ve Level Hesaplaması
public int CalculateXP(UserTask completedTask)
{
    int baseXP = completedTask.AppTask.BaseXP;
    double difficultyMultiplier = completedTask.AppTask.Difficulty == DifficultyLevel.Hard ? 1.5 :
                                  completedTask.AppTask.Difficulty == DifficultyLevel.Medium ? 1.2 : 1.0;
    return (int)(baseXP * difficultyMultiplier);
}

public void GrantXP(AppUser user, int xp)
{
    user.TotalXP += xp;
    
    // Seviye Sistemi: Her 1000 XP'de 1 seviye
    double newLevel = Math.Floor(user.TotalXP / 1000.0) + 1;
    if (newLevel > user.GeneralLevel)
    {
        user.GeneralLevel = newLevel;
        // LevelUp bildirim gönder
        _notificationService.SendLevelUpNotification(user);
    }
}


TaskRecommendationService (YENİ)
────────────────────────────────
// ML.NET model kullanarak görev önerme
public async Task<List<Guid>> GetRecommendedTasksAsync(Guid userId, int count = 3)
{
    var user = await _userRepository.GetByIdAsync(userId);
    var userProfile = MapToUserProfile(user); // Questionnaire verileri
    var availableTasks = await _taskRepository.GetAvailableTasksAsync();
    
    // ML Model'i kullan veya Kural Tabanlı Algoritma
    var scoredTasks = availableTasks.Select(task => new {
        TaskId = task.Id,
        Score = CalculateMatchScore(userProfile, task)
    })
    .OrderByDescending(x => x.Score)
    .Take(count)
    .Select(x => x.TaskId)
    .ToList();
    
    return scoredTasks;
}

private float CalculateMatchScore(UserProfile profile, AppTask task)
{
    float score = 0;
    
    // 1. Goal Match (0.4 weight)
    if (profile.Goals.Contains(task.CategoryName.ToLower()))
        score += 0.4f;
    
    // 2. Strength Match (0.25 weight)
    if (profile.Strengths.Any(s => task.Description.Contains(s)))
        score += 0.25f;
    
    // 3. Time Match (0.2 weight)
    if (task.EstimatedMinutes <= profile.DailyAvailableMinutes)
        score += 0.2f;
    
    // 4. Difficulty Match (0.15 weight)
    if (IsMatchingDifficulty(task, profile.DifficultyPreference))
        score += 0.15f;
    
    return score;
}


DailyQuestWorker (Background Service)
──────────────────────────────────────
// Her gün 00:00'de çalışır, her kullanıcıya 3 görev atar
public class DailyQuestWorker : BackgroundService
{
    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var nextRun = DateTime.Today.AddDays(1); // Yarın 00:00
            var delay = nextRun - DateTime.Now;
            
            await Task.Delay(delay, stoppingToken);
            
            // Tüm aktif kullanıcılara görev ata
            var users = await _userRepository.GetAllActiveUsersAsync();
            foreach (var user in users)
            {
                await _dailyQuestService.AssignDailyQuestsAsync(user.Id, 3);
            }
        }
    }
}

5.4 MODELS DETAYLI

IntentClassifier
────────────────
Algoritmasi:
  • Feature: TF-IDF (char n-gram, 2-5 grams)
  • Classifier: Multinomial Naive Bayes
  • Language: Turkish
  • Accuracy: ~92%

Niyetler (7 class):
  1. motivasyon       - "Motivasyon ver", "Cesaret istiyorum"
  2. gorev_sorgula    - "Bana görev ver", "Ne yapmalıyım?"
  3. istatistik       - "Benim XP'im ne?", "Kaç rozet kazandım?"
  4. oneri            - "Ne yapabilirim?", "Tavsiye ver"
  5. selamlama        - "Merhaba", "Nasılsın?"
  6. saglik           - "Sağlık nedir?", "Koşu iyi mi?"
  7. rozet            - "Rozetler ne?", "Nasıl rozet kazanırım?"


SentimentAnalyzer
─────────────────
Algoritmasi:
  • Feature: TF-IDF (char n-gram, 2-4 grams)
  • Classifier: Linear SVM
  • Classes: positive, negative, neutral
  • Accuracy: ~89%

Kullanım:
  • Kullanıcı moodunun adaptif mesajlar gönder
  • "Negatif" duygusunda hevesli bir mesaj gönder


5.5 MAİN.PY YAPISI

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from pydantic import BaseModel
from services.intent_classifier import IntentClassifier
from services.sentiment_analyzer import SentimentAnalyzer

# Modelleri başlangıçta eğit
intent_clf = IntentClassifier()
sentiment_analyzer = SentimentAnalyzer()

app = FastAPI(
    title="LifeQuest AI Service",
    version="2.0.0"
)

# CORS
app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=["*"], ...)

# Schemas
class ChatRequest(BaseModel):
    user_id: str
    message: str

class ChatResponse(BaseModel):
    intent: str
    confidence: float
    response: str
    sentiment: str
    sentiment_confidence: float
    suggestions: List[str]

# Endpoints
@app.post("/api/chat")
async def chat(request: ChatRequest):
    intent, confidence = intent_clf.predict(request.message)
    sentiment, sent_conf = sentiment_analyzer.predict(request.message)
    
    # Tarafından cevap oluştur (örneğin template'ler)
    response = generate_response(intent, sentiment)
    suggestions = get_suggestions(intent)
    
    return ChatResponse(
        intent=intent,
        confidence=confidence,
        response=response,
        sentiment=sentiment,
        sentiment_confidence=sent_conf,
        suggestions=suggestions
    )

@app.get("/health")
async def health():
    return {"status": "ok"}

TaskRecommendationService:
──────────────────────────
public class TaskRecommendationService : ITaskRecommendationService
{
    public async Task<List<Guid>> GetRecommendedTasksAsync(
        Guid userId, 
        int count = 3)
    {
        var user = await _userRepository.GetByIdAsync(userId);
        var availableTasks = await _taskRepository.GetActiveTasksAsync();
        
        var scored = availableTasks.Select(task => new {
            TaskId = task.Id,
            Score = CalculateScore(user, task)
        })
        .OrderByDescending(x => x.Score)
        .Take(count)
        .Select(x => x.TaskId)
        .ToList();
        
        return scored;
    }
    
    private float CalculateScore(AppUser user, AppTask task)
    {
        float score = 0;
        
        // Goal Match (40%)
        if (user.Goals?.Contains(task.Category.Name.ToLower()) == true)
            score += 0.4f;
        
        // Strength Match (25%)
        if (user.Strengths?.Any(s => task.Description.Contains(s)) == true)
            score += 0.25f;
        
        // Time Match (20%)
        if (task.EstimatedMinutes <= user.DailyAvailableMinutes)
            score += 0.2f;
        
        // Difficulty Match (15%)
        bool difficultyMatch = user.DifficultyPreference == "mixed" ||
                               (user.DifficultyPreference == "easy" && task.Difficulty == DifficultyLevel.Easy) ||
                               (user.DifficultyPreference == "medium" && task.Difficulty == DifficultyLevel.Medium) ||
                               (user.DifficultyPreference == "hard" && task.Difficulty == DifficultyLevel.Hard);
        if (difficultyMatch)
            score += 0.15f;
        
        return score;
    }
}

  "message": "İşlem başarılı",
  "data": { /* actual data */ }
}

Error Response:
───────────────
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Hata açıklaması",
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      "message": "Email gereklidir"
    }
  ]
}

Paginated Response:
───────────────────
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [...],
  "pageNumber": 1,
  "pageSize": 10,
  "totalCount": 150,
  "totalPages": 15
}


================================================================================
 12. AUTHENTICATION & SECURITY
================================================================================

JWT Token:
──────────
- Algorithm: HS256 (SHA-256)
- Secret Key: 64+ karakterli key (appsettings.json)
- Expiration: Configurable (default: 24 saat)
- Claims: userId, role

Token Storage (Frontend):
─────────────────────────
- localStorage'da sakla
- Her request'te Authorization header'a ekle
- 401 response'da yeni token al (refresh)

Rate Limiting:
──────────────
- 500 requests / 1 minute
- Per user (userId) + IP basis
- 429 (Too Many Requests) response


CORS:
─────
- AllowedOrigins: localhost (dev), production domain (prod)
- AllowedMethods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS
- AllowedHeaders: *, Authorization, Content-Type
- AllowCredentials: true (SignalR için)

================================================================================
 1. PROJE ÖZETİ
================================================================================

LifeQuest, kullanıcıların kişisel gelişim hedeflerini başarmalarına yardımcı
olan, yapay zeka ve oyunlaştırma mekanizmalarından yararlanan modern bir
platformdur.

📌 Temel Amaçlar:
  • Kullanıcıları günlük görevler tamamlamaya motive etmek
  • Kategori bazlı (Eğitim, Sağlık, Kariyer, Sosyal) seviye sistemi
  • XP (Deneyim Puanı) kazanarak seviye atlama
  • Rozetler ve başarılar açma
  • Sosyal özellikler (arkadaşlık, yarışma)
  • AI asistanı ile kişiselleştirilmiş görev önerileri

💡 Kişiye Özgü Yaklaşım:
  • Kayıt sırasında "Seni Tanıyalım" anketi
  • Kullanıcı profiline göre akıllı görev atama
  • Timer ve basit doğrulama ile gerçekçi görev tamamlama

3.3 REACTİON FLOW

Kayıt Akışı:
  Register.jsx → Anket Soruları Göster
             → Anket Cevapları Topla
             → POST /api/auth/register (+ questionnaire data)
             → Backend: AppUser.Goals, DailyAvailableMinutes vb. kaydet
             → Token al → Login sayfasına yönlendir

Dashboard Akışı:
  DashBoard.jsx → Yükleniyor...
             → GET /api/users/{userId} (İstatistikler)
             → GET /api/user-tasks/get-recommendations (YENİ - 3 görev öner)
             → Önerilen görevleri göster
             → Kullanıcı "Seç" tıklayınca
             → POST /api/user-tasks/request-task
             → TaskList.jsx'e yönlendir


3.4 YENİ KOMPONENTLERİ (EKLEME GEREKLI)

YENİ: QuestionnaireForm.jsx
──────────────────────────
Props:
  - onComplete: function (cevapları parent'a döndür)
  - initialData: object (opsiyonel)

State:
  - currentQuestion: number
  - answers: object
  - isLoading: boolean

Features:
  - Soru soru ilerle
  - Geri dön butonu
  - İlerleme göstergesi (7 soru, %20-%100)
  - Cevapları validate et


YENİ: TaskRecommendations.jsx
──────────────────────────────
Props:
  - recommendations: Array<{taskId, title, description, matchScore, reason}>
  - onSelectTask: function(taskId)
  - loading: boolean

Features:
  - 3 görev kartı göster
  - Her kartında: Başlık, Açıklama, XP, Zorluk, Match Score (%)
  - "Seç" butonu


UPDATED: TaskTimer.jsx
──────────────────────
Props:
  - requiredMinutes: number
  - taskTitle: string
  - onComplete: function

Features:
  - Countdown timer
  - Start/Pause/Reset butonları
  - Tamamla butonu (Min süre geçtiyse aktif)

4.5 SERVICES

GamificationService
───────────────────
// XP ve Level Hesaplaması
public int CalculateXP(UserTask completedTask)
{
    int baseXP = completedTask.AppTask.BaseXP;
    double difficultyMultiplier = completedTask.AppTask.Difficulty == DifficultyLevel.Hard ? 1.5 :
                                  completedTask.AppTask.Difficulty == DifficultyLevel.Medium ? 1.2 : 1.0;
    return (int)(baseXP * difficultyMultiplier);
}

public void GrantXP(AppUser user, int xp)
{
    user.TotalXP += xp;
    
    // Seviye Sistemi: Her 1000 XP'de 1 seviye
    double newLevel = Math.Floor(user.TotalXP / 1000.0) + 1;
    if (newLevel > user.GeneralLevel)
    {
        user.GeneralLevel = newLevel;
        // LevelUp bildirim gönder
        _notificationService.SendLevelUpNotification(user);
    }
}


TaskRecommendationService (YENİ)
────────────────────────────────
// ML.NET model kullanarak görev önerme
public async Task<List<Guid>> GetRecommendedTasksAsync(Guid userId, int count = 3)
{
    var user = await _userRepository.GetByIdAsync(userId);
    var userProfile = MapToUserProfile(user); // Questionnaire verileri
    var availableTasks = await _taskRepository.GetAvailableTasksAsync();
    
    // ML Model'i kullan veya Kural Tabanlı Algoritma
    var scoredTasks = availableTasks.Select(task => new {
        TaskId = task.Id,
        Score = CalculateMatchScore(userProfile, task)
    })
    .OrderByDescending(x => x.Score)
    .Take(count)
    .Select(x => x.TaskId)
    .ToList();
    
    return scoredTasks;
}

private float CalculateMatchScore(UserProfile profile, AppTask task)
{
    float score = 0;
    
    // 1. Goal Match (0.4 weight)
    if (profile.Goals.Contains(task.CategoryName.ToLower()))
        score += 0.4f;
    
    // 2. Strength Match (0.25 weight)
    if (profile.Strengths.Any(s => task.Description.Contains(s)))
        score += 0.25f;
    
    // 3. Time Match (0.2 weight)
    if (task.EstimatedMinutes <= profile.DailyAvailableMinutes)
        score += 0.2f;
    
    // 4. Difficulty Match (0.15 weight)
    if (IsMatchingDifficulty(task, profile.DifficultyPreference))
        score += 0.15f;
    
    return score;
}


DailyQuestWorker (Background Service)
──────────────────────────────────────
// Her gün 00:00'de çalışır, her kullanıcıya 3 görev atar
public class DailyQuestWorker : BackgroundService
{
    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var nextRun = DateTime.Today.AddDays(1); // Yarın 00:00
            var delay = nextRun - DateTime.Now;
            
            await Task.Delay(delay, stoppingToken);
            
            // Tüm aktif kullanıcılara görev ata
            var users = await _userRepository.GetAllActiveUsersAsync();
            foreach (var user in users)
            {
                await _dailyQuestService.AssignDailyQuestsAsync(user.Id, 3);
            }
        }
    }
}

 5. AI SERVICE (Python)

5.1 GENEL AÇIKLAMA

FastAPI tabanlı mikro servis. Backend tarafından HTTP POST istekleri ile çağrılır.

Modeller:
  • Intent Classifier: Türkçe mesajları 7 niyet kategorisine sınıflandırır
  • Sentiment Analyzer: Duygusal ton analizi (olumlu, olumsuz, nötr)

Veri: Türkçe eğitim veri setleri (JSON dosyaları)
Modeller: scikit-learn (TF-IDF + Naive Bayes/SVM)

5.4 MODELS DETAYLI

IntentClassifier
────────────────
Algoritmasi:
  • Feature: TF-IDF (char n-gram, 2-5 grams)
  • Classifier: Multinomial Naive Bayes
  • Language: Turkish
  • Accuracy: ~92%

Niyetler (7 class):
  1. motivasyon       - "Motivasyon ver", "Cesaret istiyorum"
  2. gorev_sorgula    - "Bana görev ver", "Ne yapmalıyım?"
  3. istatistik       - "Benim XP'im ne?", "Kaç rozet kazandım?"
  4. oneri            - "Ne yapabilirim?", "Tavsiye ver"
  5. selamlama        - "Merhaba", "Nasılsın?"
  6. saglik           - "Sağlık nedir?", "Koşu iyi mi?"
  7. rozet            - "Rozetler ne?", "Nasıl rozet kazanırım?"


SentimentAnalyzer
─────────────────
Algoritmasi:
  • Feature: TF-IDF (char n-gram, 2-4 grams)
  • Classifier: Linear SVM
  • Classes: positive, negative, neutral
  • Accuracy: ~89%

Kullanım:
  • Kullanıcı moodunun adaptif mesajlar gönder
  • "Negatif" duygusunda hevesli bir mesaj gönder


5.5 MAİN.PY YAPISI

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from pydantic import BaseModel
from services.intent_classifier import IntentClassifier
from services.sentiment_analyzer import SentimentAnalyzer

# Modelleri başlangıçta eğit
intent_clf = IntentClassifier()
sentiment_analyzer = SentimentAnalyzer()

app = FastAPI(
    title="LifeQuest AI Service",
    version="2.0.0"
)

# CORS
app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=["*"], ...)

# Schemas
class ChatRequest(BaseModel):
    user_id: str
    message: str

class ChatResponse(BaseModel):
    intent: str
    confidence: float
    response: str
    sentiment: str
    sentiment_confidence: float
    suggestions: List[str]

# Endpoints
@app.post("/api/chat")
async def chat(request: ChatRequest):
    intent, confidence = intent_clf.predict(request.message)
    sentiment, sent_conf = sentiment_analyzer.predict(request.message)
    
    # Tarafından cevap oluştur (örneğin template'ler)
    response = generate_response(intent, sentiment)
    suggestions = get_suggestions(intent)
    
    return ChatResponse(
        intent=intent,
        confidence=confidence,
        response=response,
        sentiment=sentiment,
        sentiment_confidence=sent_conf,
        suggestions=suggestions
    )

@app.get("/health")
async def health():
    return {"status": "ok"}

   ├─ 1. Hedeflerim? (Multi-select)
   ├─ 2. Günlük zaman? (Single-select)
   ├─ 3. Güçlü alanlar? (Multi-select)
   ├─ 4. Geliştirilecek alanlar? (Multi-select)
   ├─ 5. Motivasyon? (Single-select)
   ├─ 6. Haftada kaç görev? (Single-select)
   └─ 7. Zorluk seviyesi? (Single-select)
3. POST /api/auth/register (+ questionnaire data)
4. Backend kaydetsin
5. Token al → Dashboard'a yönlendir


10.3 DASHBOARD AKIŞI (UPDATED)

1. DashBoard.jsx sayfası açılsın
2. İstatistikleri yükle (XP, Level, vb)
3. GET /api/user-tasks/get-recommendations (3 görev öner)
4. TaskRecommendations.jsx ile göster
5. User "Seç" basınca:
   POST /api/user-tasks/assign/{taskId}
6. Task atanır → TaskList.jsx'e yönlendir

TaskRecommendationService:
──────────────────────────
public class TaskRecommendationService : ITaskRecommendationService
{
    public async Task<List<Guid>> GetRecommendedTasksAsync(
        Guid userId, 
        int count = 3)
    {
        var user = await _userRepository.GetByIdAsync(userId);
        var availableTasks = await _taskRepository.GetActiveTasksAsync();
        
        var scored = availableTasks.Select(task => new {
            TaskId = task.Id,
            Score = CalculateScore(user, task)
        })
        .OrderByDescending(x => x.Score)
        .Take(count)
        .Select(x => x.TaskId)
        .ToList();
        
        return scored;
    }
    
    private float CalculateScore(AppUser user, AppTask task)
    {
        float score = 0;
        
        // Goal Match (40%)
        if (user.Goals?.Contains(task.Category.Name.ToLower()) == true)
            score += 0.4f;
        
        // Strength Match (25%)
        if (user.Strengths?.Any(s => task.Description.Contains(s)) == true)
            score += 0.25f;
        
        // Time Match (20%)
        if (task.EstimatedMinutes <= user.DailyAvailableMinutes)
            score += 0.2f;
        
        // Difficulty Match (15%)
        bool difficultyMatch = user.DifficultyPreference == "mixed" ||
                               (user.DifficultyPreference == "easy" && task.Difficulty == DifficultyLevel.Easy) ||
                               (user.DifficultyPreference == "medium" && task.Difficulty == DifficultyLevel.Medium) ||
                               (user.DifficultyPreference == "hard" && task.Difficulty == DifficultyLevel.Hard);
        if (difficultyMatch)
            score += 0.15f;
        
        return score;
    }
}

 11. API RESPONSE STANDARDS

Success Response:
─────────────────
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "İşlem başarılı",
  "data": { /* actual data */ }
}

Error Response:
───────────────
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Hata açıklaması",
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      "message": "Email gereklidir"
    }
  ]
}

Paginated Response:
───────────────────
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [...],
  "pageNumber": 1,
  "pageSize": 10,
  "totalCount": 150,
  "totalPages": 15
}


================================================================================
 12. AUTHENTICATION & SECURITY
================================================================================

JWT Token:
──────────
- Algorithm: HS256 (SHA-256)
- Secret Key: 64+ karakterli key (appsettings.json)
- Expiration: Configurable (default: 24 saat)
- Claims: userId, role

Token Storage (Frontend):
─────────────────────────
- localStorage'da sakla
- Her request'te Authorization header'a ekle
- 401 response'da yeni token al (refresh)

Rate Limiting:
──────────────
- 500 requests / 1 minute
- Per user (userId) + IP basis
- 429 (Too Many Requests) response


CORS:
─────
- AllowedOrigins: localhost (dev), production domain (prod)
- AllowedMethods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS
- AllowedHeaders: *, Authorization, Content-Type
- AllowCredentials: true (SignalR için)

==================================================
DOSYA YOLU: docs\chatyolharitasi.txt
==================================================

1. Aşama: Veri Entegrasyonu ve RAG Mimarisini Kurmak
Bu aşama projenin en çok puan toplayacağı "akıllı" kısımdır. Chatbot'un senin veritabanındaki (PostgreSQL/SQLite) kullanıcı verilerine erişmesini sağlayacağız.

ASP.NET Core Tarafı: Kullanıcının haftalık başarı oranını, tamamladığı görevleri ve kazandığı rozetleri özetleyen özel bir /api/user-stats/{id} endpoint'i hazırla.

Python Tarafı: Mesaj geldiğinde önce bu API'den veriyi çek.

Prompt Engineering: Kullanıcı mesajı ile bu verileri birleştirerek bir "Context" (Bağlam) oluştur.

Örnek: "Kullanıcı bugün 3 görevini tamamladı ama motivasyonu düşük diyor. Ona bir koç gibi tavsiye ver."

2. Aşama: LangChain ile Hafıza (Memory) Ekleme
Kullanıcının "Az önce bahsettiğim görev..." dediğinde chatbot'un kopmamasını sağlayacağız.

Hafıza Yönetimi: Python tarafında LangChain kütüphanesini projeye dahil et.

Kalıcı Hafıza: Sohbet geçmişini saklamak için Redis kullanabilirsin (çok hızlıdır) veya mevcut veritabanında ChatHistory tablosu oluştur.

Implementasyon: ConversationBufferMemory kullanarak son 5-10 mesajın model tarafından "hatırlanmasını" sağla. Bu, chatbot'un bir "asistan" gibi hissettirmesi için kritiktir.

3. Aşama: Derin Öğrenme Modeline Geçiş (BERT)
Mevcut Scikit-learn (SVM/Naive Bayes) yapısını, modern bir NLP mimarisi olan Transformers ile değiştireceğiz.

Model Seçimi: Hugging Face üzerinden dbmdz/bert-base-turkish-128k-uncased modelini seç.

Eğitim (Fine-Tuning): Elindeki intents_tr.json verilerini BERT'in anlayacağı formatta (PyTorch veya TensorFlow) tokenize et ve modeli bu verilerle "ince ayar" sürecinden geçir.

Akademik Katkı: Bitirme tezinde "Geleneksel Makine Öğrenmesi (SVM) vs. Derin Öğrenme (BERT)" karşılaştırması yapabilmek için her iki modelin doğruluk (accuracy) ve F1 skorlarını not et.

4. Aşama: Optimizasyon ve Sunum Hazırlığı (Final)
Modeli eğittin, hafızayı kurdun. Şimdi bunu jüriye en iyi şekilde sunma vakti.

Dockerize Et: Python servisini ve ASP.NET Core backend'ini Docker konteynerlerine taşı. Bu, "benim bilgisayarımda çalışıyordu" sorununu ortadan kaldırır.

Performans Testi: Chatbot'un cevap süresini (latency) ölç. Eğer model çok yavaş çalışıyorsa ONNX veya TensorRT (Jetson deneyimin burada çok işe yarar) ile optimize et.

UI/UX Dokunuşu: React Native tarafında chatbot'un mesaj yazarken "yazıyor..." efekti göstermesini sağla. Bu, kullanıcı deneyimini iyileştirir.

import React from 'react';
import { BrowserRouter as Router, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AuthProvider } from './context/authContext';
import ErrorBoundary from './components/ErrorBoundary';

import DashBoard from './pages/DashBoard';
import TaskList from './pages/TaskList';
import LoginPage from './pages/LoginPage';
import Register from './pages/Register';
import BadgeGallery from './pages/BadgeGallery';
import ProfilePage from './pages/ProfilePage';
import AdminPage from './pages/AdminPage';
import GoalsPage from './pages/GoalsPage';
import ReportsPage from './pages/ReportsPage';
import SocialPage from './pages/SocialPage';
import LeaderboardPage from './pages/LeaderboardPage';
import DailyTaskPage from './pages/DailyTaskPage';
import OnboardingPage from './pages/OnboardingPage';

import PrivateRoute from './components/PrivateRoute';
import ChatBot from './components/ChatBot';

function App() {
  return (
    <ErrorBoundary>
      <Router>
        <AuthProvider>
          <Routes>
            <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
            <Route path="/register" element={<Register />} />

            <Route path="/" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />} />

            <Route path="/dashboard" element={<PrivateRoute><DashBoard /></PrivateRoute>} />
            <Route path="/tasks" element={<PrivateRoute><TaskList /></PrivateRoute>} />
            <Route path="/badges" element={<PrivateRoute><BadgeGallery /></PrivateRoute>} />
            <Route path="/profile" element={<PrivateRoute><ProfilePage /></PrivateRoute>} />
            <Route path="/goals" element={<PrivateRoute><GoalsPage /></PrivateRoute>} />
            <Route path="/reports" element={<PrivateRoute><ReportsPage /></PrivateRoute>} />
            <Route path="/social" element={<PrivateRoute><SocialPage /></PrivateRoute>} />
            <Route path="/leaderboard" element={<PrivateRoute><LeaderboardPage /></PrivateRoute>} />
            <Route path="/daily" element={<PrivateRoute><DailyTaskPage /></PrivateRoute>} />
            <Route path="/admin" element={<PrivateRoute><AdminPage /></PrivateRoute>} />
            <Route path="/onboarding" element={<PrivateRoute><OnboardingPage /></PrivateRoute>} />
          </Routes>
          <ChatBot />
        </AuthProvider>
      </Router>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  );
}

export default App;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\api\axiosClient.js
==================================================

import axios from "axios";

const axiosClient = axios.create({
  baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:5020/api",
  headers: {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

axiosClient.interceptors.request.use(
  (config) => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem("token");

    if (token) {
      config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    }
    return config;
  },
  (error) => {
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

axiosClient.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  (error) => {
    if (error.response && error.response.status === 401) {
      localStorage.removeItem("token");
      localStorage.removeItem("user_data");
      window.location.href = "/login";
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export default axiosClient;

import axiosClient from './axiosClient';

// ─── Mood API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const moodApi = {
  recordDailyMood: (data) =>
    axiosClient.post('/mood/daily', data),

  getTodayMood: () =>
    axiosClient.get('/mood/today'),

  getMoodHistory: () =>
    axiosClient.get('/mood/history'),
};

// ─── Daily Task Pool API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const taskPoolApi = {
  getDailyPool: (count = 6) =>
    axiosClient.get(`/user-tasks/daily-pool?count=${count}`),

  selectTask: (userTaskId) =>
    axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${userTaskId}/select`),

  postponeTask: (userTaskId, postponeTo, skipReason) =>
    axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${userTaskId}/postpone`, { postponeTo, skipReason }),

  pauseTask: (userTaskId) =>
    axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${userTaskId}/pause`),

  resumeTask: (userTaskId) =>
    axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${userTaskId}/resume`),

  abandonTask: (userTaskId, reason) =>
    axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${userTaskId}/abandon`, { reason }),
};

import React from "react";

const BadgeCard = ({
  name,
  description,
  iconPath,
  isEarned,
  requiredLevel,
}) => {
  const showIcon = iconPath && iconPath.length < 5;

  return (
    <div
      className={`relative p-6 rounded-3xl border transition-all duration-500 group ${
        isEarned
          ? "bg-slate-900 border-indigo-500/50 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,70,229,0.1)]"
          : "bg-slate-950 border-slate-800 opacity-60"
      }`}
    >
      {!isEarned && (
        <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-slate-600 text-sm">
          🔒{" "}
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-tighter">
            LVL {requiredLevel}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center gap-4">
        <div
          className={`w-20 h-20 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-3xl mb-2 transition-transform duration-500 overflow-hidden relative ${
            isEarned
              ? "bg-indigo-600/20 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(79,70,229,0.3)] group-hover:scale-110 border border-indigo-500/30"
              : "bg-slate-800 grayscale border border-slate-700"
          }`}
        >
          {isEarned && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-indigo-500/10 blur-md"></div>
          )}

          {showIcon ? (
            <span className="relative z-10">{iconPath}</span>
          ) : (
            <span
              className={`relative z-10 text-3xl font-black font-mono ${
                isEarned ? "text-indigo-400" : "text-slate-600"
              }`}
            >
              {name ? name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : "?"}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div>
          <h4
            className={`font-black tracking-tight mb-1 ${
              isEarned ? "text-white" : "text-slate-500"
            }`}
          >
            {name ? name.toUpperCase() : "ROZET"}
          </h4>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 leading-relaxed px-2">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>

        {isEarned && (
          <div className="mt-2 py-1 px-3 bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/20 rounded-full">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-widest">
              Kazanıldı
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default BadgeCard;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\components\BehaviorInsightCard.jsx

import React from "react";
import {
  BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, Cell
} from "recharts";

const CustomTooltip = ({ active, payload, label }) => {
  if (active && payload?.length) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs shadow-xl">
        <p className="text-white font-bold mb-1">{label}</p>
        <p className="text-emerald-400">✅ {payload[0]?.value} tamamlandı</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return null;
};

const BehaviorInsightCard = ({ summary }) => {
  if (!summary) return null;

  const {
    weeklyProgress = [],
    completionRateLast30Days = 0,
    totalCompletedLast30Days = 0,
    totalPostponeCount = 0,
    abandonedTaskCount = 0,
    bestTimeOfDay = "Bilinmiyor",
    mostCompletedCategory,
    mostSkippedCategory,
    currentStreak = 0,
    longestStreak = 0,
    insightMessage,
  } = summary;

  const completionPct = Math.round(completionRateLast30Days * 100);

  const barColors = weeklyProgress.map((d) =>
    d.completedCount >= 3
      ? "#10b981"
      : d.completedCount >= 1
      ? "#6366f1"
      : "#334155"
  );

  return (
    <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900/80 to-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700/50 rounded-[2rem] p-6 space-y-6">
      {/* Başlık */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h3 className="text-base font-black text-white tracking-wider uppercase italic flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-lg">📊</span> Haftalık Davranış Özeti
        </h3>
        {currentStreak > 0 && (
          <span className="bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-orange-500/30">
            🔥 {currentStreak} günlük seri
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Mini istatistik row */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        {[
          { label: "Tamamlandı", value: totalCompletedLast30Days, icon: "✅", color: "text-emerald-400" },
          { label: "Ertelendi", value: totalPostponeCount, icon: "⏸️", color: "text-yellow-400" },
          { label: "Vazgeçildi", value: abandonedTaskCount, icon: "❌", color: "text-red-400" },
        ].map(({ label, value, icon, color }) => (
          <div
            key={label}
            className="bg-slate-900/60 rounded-2xl p-3 text-center border border-slate-800"
          >
            <p className="text-lg mb-0.5">{icon}</p>
            <p className={`text-xl font-black ${color}`}>{value}</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{label}</p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Mini bar chart — son 7 gün */}
      {weeklyProgress.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-2 font-medium">Son 7 Gün</p>
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={70}>
            <BarChart data={weeklyProgress} barSize={20}>
              <XAxis
                dataKey="dayName"
                tick={{ fill: "#94a3b8", fontSize: 10 }}
                axisLine={false}
                tickLine={false}
              />
              <YAxis hide />
              <Tooltip content={<CustomTooltip />} cursor={{ fill: "rgba(255,255,255,0.03)" }} />
              <Bar dataKey="completedCount" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]}>
                {weeklyProgress.map((_, idx) => (
                  <Cell key={idx} fill={barColors[idx]} />
                ))}
              </Bar>
            </BarChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 30 gün tamamlama oranı */}
      <div>
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium">30 Gün Tamamlama Oranı</span>
          <span
            className={`text-sm font-black ${
              completionPct >= 70
                ? "text-emerald-400"
                : completionPct >= 40
                ? "text-yellow-400"
                : "text-red-400"
            }`}
          >
            %{completionPct}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
          <div
            className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-700 ${
              completionPct >= 70
                ? "bg-emerald-500"
                : completionPct >= 40
                ? "bg-yellow-500"
                : "bg-red-500"
            }`}
            style={{ width: `${completionPct}%` }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Kategori & zaman bilgisi */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
        {mostCompletedCategory && (
          <div className="bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-2xl p-3">
            <p className="text-emerald-400 font-bold mb-0.5">🏆 En iyi kategori</p>
            <p className="text-white font-semibold">{mostCompletedCategory}</p>
          </div>
        )}
        {bestTimeOfDay !== "Bilinmiyor" && (
          <div className="bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/20 rounded-2xl p-3">
            <p className="text-indigo-400 font-bold mb-0.5">⏰ En verimli zaman</p>
            <p className="text-white font-semibold">{bestTimeOfDay}</p>
          </div>
        )}
        {mostSkippedCategory && (
          <div className="bg-orange-500/10 border border-orange-500/20 rounded-2xl p-3 col-span-2">
            <p className="text-orange-400 font-bold mb-0.5">⚠️ Gelişim fırsatı</p>
            <p className="text-white font-semibold">
              {mostSkippedCategory} — bu kategoride küçük adımlar at
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* En uzun seri */}
      {longestStreak > 0 && (
        <div className="text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
          En uzun serim: <span className="text-white font-bold">{longestStreak} gün</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* AI insight mesajı */}
      {insightMessage && (
        <div className="bg-indigo-600/10 border border-indigo-600/20 rounded-2xl p-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-indigo-200 leading-relaxed">🤖 {insightMessage}</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default BehaviorInsightCard;

              <span className="text-3xl">{iconPath}</span>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-700 group-hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors font-mono">
                {name ? name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : "?"}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1">
            <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-lg group-hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors">
              {name}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs font-mono mt-1">
              PKT: {taskCount} GÖREV
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 w-0 group-hover:w-full transition-all duration-500"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CategoryCard;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\components\ChallengeCard.jsx

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { challengeService } from '../services/challengeService';

const TYPE_ICONS = {
  TaskCount: '📋',
  XPRace: '⭐',
  StreakBattle: '🔥',
  CategoryFocus: '🎯',
  SpecificTask: '✅'
};

const ChallengeCard = ({ challenge, onUpdate }) => {
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState('');
  const [responding, setResponding] = useState(false);

  // Canlı sayaç
  useEffect(() => {
    const calc = () => {
      const end = new Date(challenge.endDate);
      const diff = end - Date.now();
      if (diff <= 0) { setTimeLeft('Sona erdi'); return; }
      const d = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
      const h = Math.floor((diff % 86400000) / 3600000);
      const m = Math.floor((diff % 3600000) / 60000);
      setTimeLeft(d > 0 ? `${d}g ${h}s` : `${h}s ${m}dk`);
    };
    calc();
    const id = setInterval(calc, 60000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [challenge.endDate]);

  const handleRespond = async (accept) => {
    setResponding(true);
    try {
      await challengeService.respondToChallenge(challenge.id, accept);
      onUpdate?.();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setResponding(false);
    }
  };

  const myPct = challenge.targetValue
    ? Math.min(100, Math.round((challenge.myProgress / challenge.targetValue) * 100))
    : 0;
  const opPct = challenge.targetValue
    ? Math.min(100, Math.round((challenge.opponentProgress / challenge.targetValue) * 100))
    : 0;

  const isWinner = challenge.winnerId && challenge.iAmChallenger
    ? challenge.winnerId === challenge.opponentId ? false : true
    : challenge.winnerId && !challenge.iAmChallenger
    ? challenge.winnerId !== challenge.opponentId : false;

  return (
    <div style={{
      background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',
      border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
      borderRadius: '16px',
      padding: '1.25rem',
      marginBottom: '0.75rem',
      transition: 'all 0.2s'
    }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
        <div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem', marginBottom: '0.25rem' }}>
            <span>{TYPE_ICONS[challenge.challengeType] || '⚔️'}</span>
            <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: '#fff', fontSize: '0.95rem' }}>{challenge.title}</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)' }}>
            vs {challenge.opponentName} • {challenge.status === 'Active' ? `⏱️ ${timeLeft}` : challenge.status}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{
          padding: '0.25rem 0.6rem',
          borderRadius: '8px',
          fontSize: '0.72rem',
          fontWeight: 600,
          background: challenge.status === 'Active' ? 'rgba(16,185,129,0.15)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.07)',
          color: challenge.status === 'Active' ? '#10b981' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)',
          border: `1px solid ${challenge.status === 'Active' ? 'rgba(16,185,129,0.3)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)'}`
        }}>
          {challenge.status === 'Invited' ? '⏳ Davet' : challenge.status === 'Active' ? 'Aktif' : challenge.status}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Progress Bars */}
      {challenge.status === 'Active' && (
        <div style={{ marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: '0.8rem', marginBottom: '0.3rem' }}>
            <span style={{ color: '#a78bfa', fontWeight: 600 }}>Sen: {challenge.myProgress}{challenge.targetValue ? `/${challenge.targetValue}` : ''}</span>
            <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)', fontWeight: 600 }}>Rakip: {challenge.opponentProgress}{challenge.targetValue ? `/${challenge.targetValue}` : ''}</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ height: '6px', background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', borderRadius: '99px', overflow: 'hidden', marginBottom: '0.3rem' }}>
            <div style={{ height: '100%', width: `${myPct}%`, background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #7c3aed, #4f46e5)', borderRadius: '99px', transition: 'width 0.5s' }} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ height: '6px', background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', borderRadius: '99px', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <div style={{ height: '100%', width: `${opPct}%`, background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #ef4444, #dc2626)', borderRadius: '99px', transition: 'width 0.5s' }} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Completed */}
      {challenge.status === 'Completed' && (
        <div style={{
          textAlign: 'center', padding: '0.75rem',
          background: isWinner ? 'rgba(16,185,129,0.1)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',
          borderRadius: '10px', marginBottom: '1rem',
          color: isWinner ? '#10b981' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)',
          fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.9rem'
        }}>
          {isWinner ? '🏆 Kazandın! ' : '💪 Tamamlandı'}
          {isWinner && `+${challenge.winnerXPBonus} XP`}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Invite Actions */}
      {challenge.status === 'Invited' && !challenge.iAmChallenger && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
          <button
            onClick={() => handleRespond(true)}
            disabled={responding}
            style={{
              flex: 1, padding: '0.5rem', background: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.2)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.4)', borderRadius: '10px',
              color: '#10b981', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.85rem'
            }}
          >
            ✅ Kabul Et
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => handleRespond(false)}
            disabled={responding}
            style={{
              flex: 1, padding: '0.5rem', background: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.1)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.3)', borderRadius: '10px',
              color: '#ef4444', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.85rem'
            }}
          >
            ❌ Reddet
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {challenge.challengerMessage && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)', marginTop: '0.5rem', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
          "{challenge.challengerMessage}"
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ChallengeCard;


==================================================
DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\components\ChatBot.jsx

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import aiService from "../services/aiService";
import taskService from "../services/taskService";
import chatService from "../services/chatService";
import userService from "../services/userService";
import MiniTaskCard from "./MiniTaskCard";
import GoalRevisionModal from "./GoalRevisionModal";

// ─── Sabitler ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const URGENCY_STYLES = {
  0: "", // Normal
  1: "border-l-2 border-yellow-500/40",
  2: "border-l-2 border-orange-500/50 bg-orange-500/5",
  3: "border-l-2 border-red-500/50 bg-red-500/5",
};

const INTENT_LABELS = {
  motivasyon: "💪 Motivasyon", gorev_sorgula: "📋 Görev", istatistik: "📊 İstatistik",
  oneri: "🎯 Öneri", oneri_iste: "🎯 Öneri", selamlama: "👋 Selamlama",
  saglik: "💊 Sağlık", rozet: "🏆 Rozet", gorev_ertele: "📅 Erteleme",
  gorev_baslat: "▶️ Başlat", gorev_tamamla: "✅ Tamamla", gorev_vazgec: "🚫 Vazgeç",
  gorev_sec: "🎯 Seç", mood_negatif: "💙 Empati", mood_pozitif: "🔥 Enerji",
  hafif_mod: "🌿 Hafif Mod", istatistik_sorgula: "📊 İstatistik",
};

// ─── ChatBot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const ChatBot = () => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([
    {
      id: 1, sender: "bot", type: "assistant",
      text: "Merhaba! 👋 Ben LifeQuest AI asistanın. Görevlerin, istatistiklerin veya motivasyon hakkında konuşabiliriz!",
      time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString("tr-TR", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
    },
  ]);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [aiStatus, setAiStatus] = useState("unknown");
  const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState(0);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null); // action type
  const [revisionModalOpen, setRevisionModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [revisionCategory, setRevisionCategory] = useState("");
  const [currentGoals, setCurrentGoals] = useState([]);
  const messagesEndRef = useRef(null);
  const inputRef = useRef(null);

  // AI Servis sağlık kontrolü
  useEffect(() => {
    const checkHealth = async () => {
      try {
        const health = await aiService.healthCheck();
        setAiStatus(health.status === "ok" ? "online" : "offline");
      } catch { setAiStatus("offline"); }
    };
    checkHealth();
    const interval = setInterval(checkHealth, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  // SP-03: Dashboard toast'tan gelen openChatBot event
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOpen = (e) => {
      setIsOpen(true);
      const nudgeMsg = e?.detail?.message;
      if (nudgeMsg) {
        setMessages(prev => [...prev, {
          id: Date.now(), sender: "bot", type: "proactive",
          text: nudgeMsg,
          time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString("tr-TR", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
        }]);
        setUnreadCount(0); // panel açık olduğu için sıfırla
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("openChatBot", handleOpen);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("openChatBot", handleOpen);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  }, [messages]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      inputRef.current?.focus();
      setUnreadCount(0);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const addBotMessage = useCallback((text, extras = {}) => {
    const msg = {
      id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
      sender: "bot", type: "assistant",
      text,
      time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString("tr-TR", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
      ...extras,
    };
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, msg]);
    if (!isOpen) setUnreadCount(c => c + 1);
    return msg.id;
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleSend = async (textOverride) => {
    const trimmed = (textOverride || input).trim();
    if (!trimmed || loading) return;

    const userMsg = {
      id: Date.now(), sender: "user", type: "user",
      text: trimmed,
      time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString("tr-TR", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
    };
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setInput("");
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await chatService.sendMessage(trimmed);

      const botExtras = {
        intent: response.intent,
        confidence: response.confidence ?? response.intentConfidence,
        sentiment: response.sentiment,
        sentimentConfidence: response.sentimentConfidence,
        urgencyLevel: response.urgencyLevel ?? 0,
        suggestions: response.suggestions || [],
        actions: response.actions || [],
        suggestedTasks: response.suggestedTasks || null,
        suggestedTaskId: response.suggestedTaskId,
        suggestedTaskTitle: response.suggestedTaskTitle,
        suggestedTaskXp: response.suggestedTaskXp,
        shouldShowMoodSelector: response.shouldShowMoodSelector,
        actionsUsed: false, // henüz kullanılmadı
        messageId: response.messageId,
      };

      addBotMessage(response.response, botExtras);
    } catch {
      addBotMessage("⚠️ AI servisine bağlanılamadı. Servisin çalıştığından emin olun (port 5001).", { isError: true });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAction = async (action, msgId) => {
    // SP-04: Hedef revizyonu aksiyonlarını araya gir
    if (action.type === "update_goal") {
      try {
        const profile = await userService.getProfile();
        setCurrentGoals(profile.userGoals || []);
        setRevisionCategory(action.payload);
        setRevisionModalOpen(true);
        setMessages(prev => prev.map(m => m.id === msgId ? { ...m, actionsUsed: true } : m));
      } catch (err) {
        addBotMessage("⚠️ Hedefler alınırken hata oluştu.", { isError: true });
      }
      return;
    }
    if (action.type === "keep_goal") {
      setMessages(prev => prev.map(m => m.id === msgId ? { ...m, actionsUsed: true } : m));
      addBotMessage("Harika! Bu hedefle devam ediyoruz. 💪");
      return;
    }

    setActionLoading(action.type);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/chat/action", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem("token")}` },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          messageId: msgId,
          actionType: action.type,
          taskId: action.task_id,
          payload: action.payload,
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();

      // Aksiyonu "kullanıldı" olarak işaretle
      setMessages(prev => prev.map(m => m.id === msgId ? { ...m, actionsUsed: true } : m));

      // Sonuç mesajı ekle
      addBotMessage(data.message || "✅ İşlem tamamlandı!", { type: "action_result" });
    } catch {
      addBotMessage("⚠️ Aksiyon işlenirken bir hata oluştu.", { isError: true });
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const handleAssignTask = async (taskId, msgId) => {
    try {
      await taskService.assignSpecificTask(taskId);
      setMessages(prev => prev.map(m => m.id === msgId ? { ...m, suggestedTaskId: null } : m));
      addBotMessage("✅ Görev başarıyla eklendi! Görevler sayfasından detaylara bakabilirsin.");
    } catch (err) {
      addBotMessage("⚠️ Görev eklenirken bir hata oluştu: " + (err.response?.data?.message || err.message), { isError: true });
    }
  };

  const handleSelectMiniTask = async (taskId) => {
    try {
      await fetch(`/api/user-tasks/${taskId}/select`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem("token")}` },
      });
      addBotMessage("✅ Görev seçildi! Görevler sayfasında aktif görünecek.");
    } catch {
      addBotMessage("⚠️ Görev seçilirken hata oluştu.");
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); handleSend(); }
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* Floating Button */}
      <button
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className={`fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 w-16 h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110 active:scale-95 ${
          isOpen ? "bg-slate-700" : "bg-indigo-600 shadow-indigo-500/40 hover:shadow-indigo-500/60"
        }`}
      >
        {isOpen ? (
          <span className="text-2xl text-white">✕</span>
        ) : (
          <div className="relative">
            <span className="text-2xl">🤖</span>
            {aiStatus === "online" && (
              <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-3 h-3 bg-emerald-400 rounded-full border-2 border-slate-950 animate-pulse" />
            )}
            {unreadCount > 0 && (
              <span className="absolute -top-2 -left-2 min-w-[20px] h-5 bg-red-500 text-white text-[10px] font-bold rounded-full flex items-center justify-center px-1">
                {unreadCount}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </button>

      {/* Chat Window */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-24 right-6 z-50 w-[440px] h-[620px] bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-700/50 shadow-2xl shadow-black/50 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="p-5 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-indigo-700 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-white/20 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-lg backdrop-blur-sm">
                🤖
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-white font-black text-sm tracking-wide">LifeQuest AI</h3>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${aiStatus === "online" ? "bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" : "bg-rose-400"}`} />
                  <span className="text-indigo-200 text-[10px] font-medium">
                    {aiStatus === "online" ? "Çevrimiçi" : "Çevrimdışı"}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setMessages(messages.slice(0, 1))}
              className="text-white/60 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
              title="Sohbeti temizle"
            >
              🗑️
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Messages */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4 scrollbar-thin">
            {messages.map((msg) => (
              <div key={msg.id} className={`flex ${msg.sender === "user" ? "justify-end" : "justify-start"}`}>
                <div
                  className={`max-w-[88%] rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 ${
                    msg.sender === "user"
                      ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-br-md"
                      : msg.isError
                        ? "bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 text-rose-300 rounded-bl-md"
                        : msg.type === "action_result"
                          ? "bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-200 rounded-bl-md"
                          : `bg-slate-800 text-slate-100 rounded-bl-md border border-slate-700/50 ${URGENCY_STYLES[msg.urgencyLevel ?? 0]}`
                  }`}
                >
                  <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{msg.text}</p>

                  {/* AI Metadata */}
                  {msg.sender === "bot" && msg.intent && (
                    <div className="mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-700/50 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 text-[10px]">
                      <span className="bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">
                        {INTENT_LABELS[msg.intent] || msg.intent}
                      </span>
                      <span className="bg-slate-700/50 text-slate-400 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                        %{((msg.confidence ?? 0) * 100).toFixed(0)} güven
                      </span>
                      {msg.urgencyLevel > 0 && (
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold ${
                          msg.urgencyLevel >= 3 ? "bg-red-500/20 text-red-300"
                            : msg.urgencyLevel === 2 ? "bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-300"
                              : "bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-300"
                        }`}>
                          ⚠️ Aciliyet {msg.urgencyLevel}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Aksiyon Butonları */}
                  {msg.sender === "bot" && msg.actions?.length > 0 && !msg.actionsUsed && (
                    <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      {msg.actions.map((action, i) => (
                        <button
                          key={i}
                          onClick={() => handleAction(action, msg.id)}
                          disabled={actionLoading !== null}
                          className="text-xs bg-indigo-500/15 border border-indigo-500/40 text-indigo-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-indigo-500/25 transition-colors font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                        >
                          {actionLoading === action.type ? "⌛" : action.label}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* MiniTaskCard'lar (suggested_tasks) */}
                  {msg.sender === "bot" && msg.suggestedTasks?.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mt-3 flex flex-col gap-2">
                      {msg.suggestedTasks.map((task) => (
                        <MiniTaskCard
                          key={task.taskId}
                          task={task}
                          onSelect={handleSelectMiniTask}
                        />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Tekil görev önerisi (eski uyumluluk) */}
                  {msg.sender === "bot" && msg.suggestedTaskId && (
                    <div className="mt-3 bg-slate-900/50 rounded-xl p-3 border border-indigo-500/30">
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                        <h4 className="text-white font-bold text-sm">{msg.suggestedTaskTitle}</h4>
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-400">+{msg.suggestedTaskXp} XP</span>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleAssignTask(msg.suggestedTaskId, msg.id)}
                        className="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-bold py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                      >
                        ✅ Görevi Kabul Et
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Quick Replies */}
                  {msg.suggestions?.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                      {msg.suggestions.map((s, i) => (
                        <button
                          key={i}
                          onClick={() => handleSend(s)}
                          className="text-[11px] bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-300 px-3 py-1 rounded-full hover:bg-indigo-500/20 transition-colors font-medium"
                        >
                          {s}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Mood Selector önerisi */}
                  {msg.shouldShowMoodSelector && (
                    <div className="mt-3 p-2 bg-purple-500/10 border border-purple-500/30 rounded-lg">
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-purple-300 font-semibold mb-1.5">
                        😊 Bugünkü ruh halini güncellemek ister misin?
                      </p>
                      <a href="/daily" className="text-[11px] text-purple-400 underline">
                        Mood seçimine git →
                      </a>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <p className={`text-[9px] mt-1.5 ${msg.sender === "user" ? "text-indigo-200" : "text-slate-500"}`}>
                    {msg.time}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}

            {loading && (
              <div className="flex justify-start">
                <div className="bg-slate-800 rounded-2xl rounded-bl-md px-4 py-3 border border-slate-700/50">
                  <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                    {[0, 150, 300].map(delay => (
                      <span key={delay} className="w-2 h-2 bg-indigo-400 rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: `${delay}ms` }} />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
          </div>

          {/* Input */}
          <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-sm shrink-0">
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                ref={inputRef}
                type="text"
                value={input}
                onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
                placeholder="Mesajınızı yazın..."
                className="flex-1 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-white text-sm rounded-xl px-4 py-3 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/50 focus:border-indigo-500 transition-all placeholder:text-slate-500"
                disabled={loading}
              />
              <button
                onClick={() => handleSend()}
                disabled={loading || !input.trim()}
                className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:bg-slate-700 disabled:text-slate-500 text-white px-4 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold transition-all active:scale-95 shrink-0"
              >
                ➤
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* SP-04: GoalRevisionModal */}
      <GoalRevisionModal
        isOpen={revisionModalOpen}
        category={revisionCategory}
        currentGoals={currentGoals}
        onClose={() => setRevisionModalOpen(false)}
        onUpdated={(newGoals) => {
          setRevisionModalOpen(false);
          setCurrentGoals(newGoals);
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default ChatBot;

import { useState } from 'react';
import { moodApi } from '../api/moodApi';
import '../styles/DailyMoodSelector.css';

const MOOD_OPTIONS = [
  {
    key: 0,
    label: 'Enerjik',
    emoji: '⚡',
    description: 'Harika hissediyorum, büyük hedefler koyabilirim!',
    color: '#f59e0b',
    gradient: 'from-amber-400 to-orange-500',
  },
  {
    key: 1,
    label: 'Normal',
    emoji: '😊',
    description: 'Dengeli bir gün, her şey yolunda.',
    color: '#10b981',
    gradient: 'from-emerald-400 to-teal-500',
  },
  {
    key: 2,
    label: 'Yorgun',
    emoji: '😴',
    description: 'Biraz yorgunum, hafif görevler tercih ederim.',
    color: '#6366f1',
    gradient: 'from-indigo-400 to-purple-500',
  },
  {
    key: 3,
    label: 'Bunalmış',
    emoji: '😰',
    description: 'Çok şey var, sadece bir şeye odaklanabilirim.',
    color: '#ef4444',

  {

    label: 'Vaktim Kısıtlı',

    description: 'Az vaktim var, hızlı görevler istiyorum.',
    color: '#3b82f6',
    gradient: 'from-blue-400 to-cyan-500',
  },
];

export default function DailyMoodSelector({ onMoodRecorded }) {
  const [selectedMood, setSelectedMood] = useState(null);
  const [availableMinutes, setAvailableMinutes] = useState(30);
  const [energyLevel, setEnergyLevel] = useState(3);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1); // 1: mood seç, 2: detaylar

  const handleMoodSelect = (mood) => {
    setSelectedMood(mood);
    setStep(2);
    // Mood'a göre otomatik enerji ve süre öneri
    if (mood.key === 0) { setEnergyLevel(5); setAvailableMinutes(60); }
    else if (mood.key === 1) { setEnergyLevel(3); setAvailableMinutes(30); }
    else if (mood.key === 2) { setEnergyLevel(2); setAvailableMinutes(20); }
    else if (mood.key === 3) { setEnergyLevel(1); setAvailableMinutes(15); }
    else if (mood.key === 4) { setEnergyLevel(3); setAvailableMinutes(10); }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!selectedMood) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await moodApi.recordDailyMood({
        moodMode: selectedMood.key,
        availableMinutes,
        energyLevel,
      });
      onMoodRecorded?.({ mood: selectedMood, availableMinutes, energyLevel });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Mood kaydedilemedi:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mood-selector-container">
      {step === 1 && (
        <>
          <div className="mood-selector-header">
            <h2>🌅 Bugün nasılsın?</h2>
            <p>Ruh haline göre en uygun görevleri seçeceğiz</p>
          </div>
          <div className="mood-grid">
            {MOOD_OPTIONS.map((mood) => (
              <button
                key={mood.key}
                className="mood-card"
                style={{ '--mood-color': mood.color }}
                onClick={() => handleMoodSelect(mood)}
              >
                <span className="mood-emoji">{mood.emoji}</span>
                <span className="mood-label">{mood.label}</span>
                <span className="mood-description">{mood.description}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {step === 2 && selectedMood && (
        <div className="mood-details">
          <div className="selected-mood-badge" style={{ '--mood-color': selectedMood.color }}>
            <span>{selectedMood.emoji}</span>
            <span>{selectedMood.label}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="mood-slider-group">
            <label>
              ⚡ Enerji Seviyesi: <strong>{energyLevel}/5</strong>
            </label>
            <input
              type="range"
              min="1"
              max="5"
              value={energyLevel}
              onChange={(e) => setEnergyLevel(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="mood-slider"
            />
            <div className="slider-labels">
              <span>Düşük</span><span>Orta</span><span>Yüksek</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mood-slider-group">
            <label>
              ⏱️ Bugün müsait olduğun süre: <strong>{availableMinutes} dk</strong>
            </label>
            <input
              type="range"
              min="5"
              max="240"
              step="5"
              value={availableMinutes}
              onChange={(e) => setAvailableMinutes(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="mood-slider"
            />
            <div className="slider-labels">
              <span>5 dk</span><span>2 saat</span><span>4 saat</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mood-actions">
            <button className="mood-back-btn" onClick={() => setStep(1)}>← Değiştir</button>
            <button
              className="mood-submit-btn"
              onClick={handleSubmit}
              disabled={loading}
            >
              {loading ? '⌛ Kaydediliyor...' : '🎯 Görevlerimi Getir'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
