import { useState } from 'react';
import { taskPoolApi } from '../api/moodApi';
import '../styles/EnhancedTaskCard.css';

const DIFFICULTY_CONFIG = {
  Easy: { label: 'Kolay', color: '#10b981', stars: 1 },
  Medium: { label: 'Orta', color: '#f59e0b', stars: 2 },
  Hard: { label: 'Zor', color: '#ef4444', stars: 3 },
};

export default function EnhancedTaskCard({ task, isSelected, onSelect }) {
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('suggested'); // suggested | selected | inprogress | paused | postponed
  const [showPostpone, setShowPostpone] = useState(false);
  const [postponeReason, setPostponeReason] = useState('');

  const diff = DIFFICULTY_CONFIG[task.difficulty] || DIFFICULTY_CONFIG.Easy;
  const matchPercent = Math.round((task.matchScore || 0) * 100);

  const handleSelect = async () => {
    setActionLoading('select');
    try {
      await taskPoolApi.selectTask(task.userTaskId);
      setStatus('selected');
      onSelect?.();
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const handlePause = async () => {
    setActionLoading('pause');
    try {
      await taskPoolApi.pauseTask(task.userTaskId);
      setStatus('paused');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const handleResume = async () => {
    setActionLoading('resume');
    try {
      await taskPoolApi.resumeTask(task.userTaskId);
      setStatus('inprogress');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const handlePostpone = async () => {
    setActionLoading('postpone');
    try {
      const tomorrow = new Date();
      tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1);
      const dateStr = tomorrow.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      await taskPoolApi.postponeTask(task.userTaskId, dateStr, postponeReason);
      setStatus('postponed');
      setShowPostpone(false);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const handleAbandon = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm('Bu görevden vazgeçmek istediğinden emin misin?')) return;
    setActionLoading('abandon');
    try {
      await taskPoolApi.abandonTask(task.userTaskId, 'Kullanıcı vazgeçti');
      setStatus('abandoned');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  if (status === 'abandoned') {
    return (
      <div className="task-card task-card--abandoned">
        <span>🚫 Bu görevden vazgeçildi</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (status === 'postponed') {
    return (
      <div className="task-card task-card--postponed">
        <span>📅 Yarına ertelendi — XP %70 olacak</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={`task-card ${isSelected ? 'task-card--selected' : ''} task-card--${status}`}>
      {/* Match Score Badge */}
      <div className="task-match-badge">
        <div
          className="match-ring"
          style={{ '--match': matchPercent, '--match-color': matchPercent > 70 ? '#10b981' : matchPercent > 40 ? '#f59e0b' : '#6366f1' }}
        >
          <span>{matchPercent}%</span>
        </div>
        <span className="match-label">uyum</span>
      </div>

      {/* Card Header */}
      <div className="task-card-header">
        <span className="task-category">{task.categoryName}</span>
        <span className="task-difficulty" style={{ color: diff.color }}>
          {'★'.repeat(diff.stars)}{'☆'.repeat(3 - diff.stars)} {diff.label}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Title & Description */}
      <h3 className="task-title">{task.title}</h3>
      <p className="task-description">{task.description}</p>

      {/* Why This Task */}
      {task.whyThisTask && (
        <div className="task-why">
          <span>💡</span>
          <span>{task.whyThisTask}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Recommendation Reason */}
      {task.recommendationReason && (
        <div className="task-reason">
          🎯 {task.recommendationReason}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Meta */}
      <div className="task-meta">
        {task.estimatedMinutes && <span>⏱️ {task.estimatedMinutes} dk</span>}
        <span>✨ {task.baseXP} XP</span>
      </div>

      {/* Badge Hint */}
      {task.badgeHint && (
        <div className="task-badge-hint">
          🏅 {task.badgeHint}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Actions */}
      <div className="task-actions">
        {status === 'suggested' && (
          <button
            className="task-btn task-btn--primary"
            onClick={handleSelect}
            disabled={!!actionLoading}
          >
            {actionLoading === 'select' ? '⌛' : '✅ Seç'}
          </button>
        )}

        {status === 'selected' && (
          <button
            className="task-btn task-btn--start"
            onClick={() => setStatus('inprogress')}
          >
            ▶️ Başla
          </button>
        )}

        {status === 'inprogress' && (
          <button
            className="task-btn task-btn--pause"
            onClick={handlePause}
            disabled={!!actionLoading}
          >
            {actionLoading === 'pause' ? '⌛' : '⏸️ Duraklat'}
          </button>
        )}

        {status === 'paused' && (
          <button
            className="task-btn task-btn--resume"
            onClick={handleResume}
            disabled={!!actionLoading}
          >
            {actionLoading === 'resume' ? '⌛' : '▶️ Devam Et'}
          </button>
        )}

        {/* Erteleme butonu her durumda görünür */}
        {['suggested', 'selected', 'paused'].includes(status) && (
          <button
            className="task-btn task-btn--postpone"
            onClick={() => setShowPostpone(!showPostpone)}
          >
            📅 Ertele
          </button>
        )}

        {['selected', 'inprogress', 'paused'].includes(status) && (
          <button
            className="task-btn task-btn--abandon"
            onClick={handleAbandon}
            disabled={!!actionLoading}
          >
            {actionLoading === 'abandon' ? '⌛' : '🚫'}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Postpone Panel */}
      {showPostpone && (
        <div className="postpone-panel">
          <p>Neden erteliyorsun? (isteğe bağlı)</p>
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Sebebi yaz..."
            value={postponeReason}
            onChange={(e) => setPostponeReason(e.target.value)}
            className="postpone-input"
          />
          <div className="postpone-actions">
            <button
              className="task-btn task-btn--primary"
              onClick={handlePostpone}
              disabled={actionLoading === 'postpone'}
            >
              {actionLoading === 'postpone' ? '⌛' : 'Yarına Ertele (%70 XP)'}
            </button>
            <button
              className="task-btn"
              onClick={() => setShowPostpone(false)}
            >
              İptal
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';

class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) {
    this.setState({
      error: error,
      errorInfo: errorInfo
    });
    console.error("ErrorBoundary caught an error", error, errorInfo);
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-8 max-w-lg w-full text-center shadow-2xl">
            <div className="text-6xl mb-6">💥</div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-white mb-2 uppercase tracking-tight">
              Sistem Çöktü
            </h1>
            <p className="text-slate-400 mb-8">
              Beklenmedik bir hata oluştu. Mühendislerimiz durumu inceliyor (umarız).
            </p>
            <button
              onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
              className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold transition-all shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/25"
            >
              Yeniden Yükle
            </button>
            
            {process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && (
              <div className="mt-8 text-left bg-slate-950 p-4 rounded-xl overflow-auto text-xs text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/20 max-h-48">
                <p className="font-bold mb-1">{this.state.error?.toString()}</p>
                <p className="font-mono">{this.state.errorInfo?.componentStack}</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

export default ErrorBoundary;

import React from 'react';

const GoalProgressRing = ({
  percent = 0,
  size = 80,
  stroke = 7,
  color = '#7c3aed',
  label,
  icon
}) => {
  const radius = (size - stroke) / 2;
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  const offset = circumference - (percent / 100) * circumference;

  return (
    <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: size, height: size, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
      <svg width={size} height={size} style={{ transform: 'rotate(-90deg)', position: 'absolute' }}>
        {/* Track */}
        <circle
          cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius}
          fill="none"
          stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.08)"
          strokeWidth={stroke}
        />
        {/* Progress */}
        <circle
          cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius}
          fill="none"
          stroke={color}
          strokeWidth={stroke}
          strokeDasharray={circumference}
          strokeDashoffset={offset}
          strokeLinecap="round"
          style={{ transition: 'stroke-dashoffset 0.6s ease' }}
        />
      </svg>
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', zIndex: 1 }}>
        {icon
          ? <div style={{ fontSize: size > 70 ? '1.4rem' : '1rem' }}>{icon}</div>
          : <div style={{ fontSize: size > 70 ? '0.95rem' : '0.75rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#fff' }}>{percent}%</div>
        }
        {label && <div style={{ fontSize: '0.6rem', color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)', marginTop: '2px' }}>{label}</div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GoalProgressRing;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\components\GoalRevisionModal.jsx

import React, { useState } from "react";
import axiosClient from "../api/axiosClient";
import { getUserIdFromToken } from "../utils/authUtils";

/**
 * GoalRevisionModal — SP-04
 * ChatBot'tan gelen goal_revision aksiyonuna karşılık açılır.
 * Kullanıcıya zayıf kategoriyi güncellemesini veya devam etmesini sorar.
 *
 * Props:
 *   isOpen: bool
 *   category: string — revize önerilen kategori adı
 *   currentGoals: string[] — mevcut hedefler
 *   onClose: () => void
 *   onUpdated: (updatedGoals: string[]) => void
 */
const GoalRevisionModal = ({ isOpen, category, currentGoals = [], onClose, onUpdated }) => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [resultMsg, setResultMsg] = useState("");

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleUpdate = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const userId = getUserIdFromToken();
      const res = await axiosClient.put(`/users/${userId}/goals`, {
        newGoals: [],
        removedGoals: [category],
      });
      setResultMsg("Hedefiniz güncellendi! Yeni görevler hazırlanıyor. 🎯");
      setDone(true);
      onUpdated?.(res.data?.updatedGoals || currentGoals.filter(g => g !== category));
    } catch {
      setResultMsg("Bir hata oluştu. Tekrar dene.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleKeep = () => {
    setResultMsg("Harika! Bu hedefle devam ediyoruz. 💪");
    setDone(true);
    setTimeout(onClose, 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700/50 rounded-[2rem] shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full p-6 space-y-5 animate-fade-in">
        {/* Başlık */}
        <div className="text-center">
          <span className="text-4xl block mb-2">🎯</span>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-white">Hedef Revizyonu</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">
            LifeQuest AI bir öneri hazırladı
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Analiz özeti */}
        <div className="bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 rounded-2xl p-4">
          <p className="text-amber-200 text-sm leading-relaxed">
            <span className="font-bold text-amber-400">'{category}'</span> kategorisini
            son 2 haftadır zorlanıyor gibisin. Bu hedefi güncellemek ister misin?
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Mevcut hedefler */}
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mb-2 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
            Mevcut Hedeflerin
          </p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {currentGoals.map((g) => (
              <span
                key={g}
                className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold border transition-all ${
                  g.toLowerCase() === category.toLowerCase()
                    ? "bg-red-500/20 border-red-500/40 text-red-300 line-through"
                    : "bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-slate-300"
                }`}
              >
                {g}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
          {currentGoals.some(g => g.toLowerCase() === category.toLowerCase()) && (
            <p className="text-xs text-red-400 mt-2">
              ↑ <span className="font-semibold">{category}</span> kaldırılacak
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Sonuç mesajı */}
        {done ? (
          <div className="bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-2xl p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-emerald-300 font-semibold text-sm">{resultMsg}</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={handleUpdate}
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex-1 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-2xl text-sm transition-all disabled:opacity-50 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20"
            >
              {loading ? "Güncelleniyor..." : "✅ Evet, güncelle"}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleKeep}
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex-1 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-bold py-3 rounded-2xl text-sm transition-all border border-slate-700"
            >
              💪 Hayır, devam et
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Kapat */}
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="w-full text-xs text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-400 transition-colors"
        >
          Kapat
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GoalRevisionModal;

import { useState } from "react";

/**
 * MiniTaskCard — SP-02: Chatbot içinde görev önerisi için kompakt kart.
 */
const MiniTaskCard = ({ task, onSelect, isSelected: initialSelected = false }) => {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(initialSelected);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleSelect = async () => {
    if (selected || loading) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await onSelect?.(task.taskId);
      setSelected(true);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl p-3 border transition-all ${
      selected
        ? "bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30"
        : "bg-slate-900/60 border-slate-700/50 hover:border-indigo-500/40"
    }`}>
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <h4 className="text-white font-bold text-xs leading-tight truncate">{task.title}</h4>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] bg-indigo-500/15 text-indigo-300 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
              {task.categoryName}
            </span>
            {task.estimatedMinutes && (
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">⏱️ {task.estimatedMinutes}dk</span>
            )}
            <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 font-bold">+{task.baseXP} XP</span>
          </div>
          {task.whyThisTask && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1 leading-tight line-clamp-1 italic">
              💡 {task.whyThisTask}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={handleSelect}
          disabled={selected || loading}
          className={`shrink-0 text-[11px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all ${
            selected
              ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 cursor-default"
              : "bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95"
          }`}
        >
          {loading ? "⌛" : selected ? "✓ Seçildi" : "Seç"}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MiniTaskCard;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\components\NotificationBell.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { HubConnectionBuilder, LogLevel } from "@microsoft/signalr";
import axiosClient from "../api/axiosClient";

const NotificationBell = () => {
    const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState([]);
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
    const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState(0);
    const connectionRef = useRef(null);

    // Fetch initial notifications
    useEffect(() => {
        const fetchNotifications = async () => {
            try {
                const response = await axiosClient.get("/notifications");
                const notifs = response.data.notifications || [];
                setNotifications(notifs);
                setUnreadCount(notifs.filter(n => !n.isRead).length);
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Failed to fetch notifications", err);
            }
        };

        fetchNotifications();
    }, []);

    // Setup SignalR
    useEffect(() => {
        const token = localStorage.getItem("token");
        if (!token) return;

        const baseUrl = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "https://localhost:7071/api").replace("/api", "");
        const newConnection = new HubConnectionBuilder()
            .withUrl(`${baseUrl}/hubs/notification`, { 
                accessTokenFactory: () => token 
            })
            .withAutomaticReconnect()
            .configureLogging(LogLevel.Information)
            .build();

        newConnection.start()
            .then(() => {
                console.log("SignalR Connected");
                newConnection.on("ReceiveNotification", (notification) => {
                    setNotifications(prev => [notification, ...prev]);
                    setUnreadCount(prev => prev + 1);
                    
                    // İsteğe bağlı browser notification atılabilir
                    /* if ("Notification" in window && Notification.permission === "granted") {
                        new Notification(notification.title, { body: notification.message });
                    } */
                });
            })
            .catch(e => console.log("Connection failed: ", e));

        connectionRef.current = newConnection;

        return () => {
            if (connectionRef.current) {
                connectionRef.current.stop();
            }
        };
    }, []);

    const toggleOpen = () => {
        if (!isOpen && unreadCount > 0) {
            axiosClient.patch("/notifications/mark-all-as-read").then(() => {
                setUnreadCount(0);
                setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => ({...n, isRead: true})));
            });
        }
        setIsOpen(!isOpen);
    };

    return (
        <div className="relative">
            <button 
                onClick={toggleOpen}
                className="relative p-2 text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-full transition-colors"
                title="Bildirimler"
            >
                <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 17h5l-1.405-1.405A2.032 2.032 0 0118 14.158V11a6.002 6.002 0 00-4-5.659V5a2 2 0 10-4 0v.341C7.67 6.165 6 8.388 6 11v3.159c0 .538-.214 1.055-.595 1.436L4 17h5m6 0v1a3 3 0 11-6 0v-1m6 0H9" />
                </svg>
                {unreadCount > 0 && (
                    <span className="absolute top-1 right-1 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-red-500 rounded-full animate-bounce" />
                )}
            </button>

            {isOpen && (
                <div className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-80 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl shadow-2xl z-50 overflow-hidden text-sm animate-fade-in">
                    <div className="p-3 bg-slate-700/50 border-b border-slate-600 font-semibold text-slate-100 flex justify-between">
                        Bildirimler
                        {unreadCount > 0 && <span className="text-xs bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">{unreadCount} yeni</span>}
                    </div>
                    <div className="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
                        {notifications.length === 0 ? (
                            <div className="p-4 text-center text-slate-400">Bildirim bulunmuyor.</div>
                        ) : (
                            notifications.map((n, idx) => (
                                <div key={n.id || idx} className={`p-4 border-b border-slate-700/50 hover:bg-slate-700/40 transition-colors ${!n.isRead ? 'bg-slate-700/20' : ''}`}>
                                    <h4 className="font-medium text-slate-200 mb-1">{n.title}</h4>
                                    <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs">{n.message}</p>
                                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-2 block">
                                        {new Date(n.createdAt).toLocaleString('tr-TR')}
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                            ))
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
};

export default NotificationBell;

import React, { useState } from "react";

const DIFFICULTY_COLORS = {
  Easy: "text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-400/10 border-emerald-400/20",
  Medium: "text-amber-400 bg-amber-400/10 border-amber-400/20",
  Hard: "text-rose-400 bg-rose-400/10 border-rose-400/20",
};

const TaskItem = ({
  id,
  title,
  description,
  xp,
  difficulty,
  isCompleted,
  onComplete,
}) => {
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [showDesc, setShowDesc] = useState(false);

  const safeDifficulty = DIFFICULTY_COLORS[difficulty] ? difficulty : "Medium";

  const handleComplete = async () => {
    if (isSubmitting || isCompleted) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await onComplete(id);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Görev tamamlama hatası:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`rounded-2xl border transition-all duration-300 ${
        isCompleted
          ? "opacity-50 grayscale border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/20"
          : "border-slate-800 hover:border-indigo-500/40 bg-slate-900/40 hover:bg-slate-900/60 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-indigo-500/5"
      }`}
    >
      <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        {/* Checkbox + Info */}
        <div
          className="flex items-center gap-4 flex-1 cursor-pointer min-w-0"
          onClick={() => description && setShowDesc(!showDesc)}
        >
          <div
            className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full border-2 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 transition-all duration-300 ${
              isCompleted
                ? "bg-emerald-500 border-emerald-500 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(16,185,129,0.4)]"
                : "border-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-500"
            }`}
          >
            {isCompleted && (
              <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-white" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={3}>
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
              </svg>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <h4
              className={`font-bold text-base truncate ${
                isCompleted ? "text-slate-400 line-through" : "text-slate-100"
              }`}
            >
              {title}
            </h4>
            <div className="flex gap-2 mt-1.5 flex-wrap items-center">
              <span
                className={`text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-bold uppercase ${DIFFICULTY_COLORS[safeDifficulty]}`}
              >
                {difficulty || "Normal"}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                +{xp} XP
              </span>
              {description && (
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-400 transition-colors">
                  {showDesc ? "▲ Gizle" : "▼ Detay"}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Complete Button */}
        <button
          onClick={handleComplete}
          disabled={isCompleted || isSubmitting}
          className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition-all flex-shrink-0 shadow-lg active:scale-95 ${
            isCompleted
              ? "bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 cursor-not-allowed shadow-none"
              : isSubmitting
              ? "bg-indigo-800 text-indigo-400 cursor-wait"
              : "bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white shadow-indigo-500/25 hover:shadow-indigo-500/40"
          }`}
        >
          {isCompleted ? "✓ Tamamlandı" : isSubmitting ? "..." : "Bitir"}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Description Expandable */}
      {showDesc && description && (
        <div className="px-4 pb-4 border-t border-slate-800/50">
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-3 leading-relaxed">{description}</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default TaskItem;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\components\TaskPoolSelector.jsx

import { useState } from 'react';
import EnhancedTaskCard from './EnhancedTaskCard';
import '../styles/TaskPoolSelector.css';

const MOOD_LABELS = {
  0: { label: 'Enerjik', emoji: '⚡', color: '#f59e0b' },
  1: { label: 'Normal', emoji: '😊', color: '#10b981' },
  2: { label: 'Yorgun', emoji: '😴', color: '#6366f1' },
  3: { label: 'Bunalmış', emoji: '😰', color: '#ef4444' },
  4: { label: 'Vaktim Kısıtlı', emoji: '⏰', color: '#3b82f6' },
};

const SLOT_LABELS = {
  0: 'Sabah',
  1: 'Öğle',
  2: 'Öğleden Sonra',
  3: 'Akşam',
  4: 'Gece',
};

export default function TaskPoolSelector({ poolData, onTaskSelect, onRefresh }) {
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState(new Set());
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all'); // all | quick | deep

  if (!poolData) return null;

  const mood = MOOD_LABELS[poolData.todayMood] || MOOD_LABELS[1];
  const slot = SLOT_LABELS[poolData.timeSlot] || 'Gün';

  const filteredTasks = poolData.tasks?.filter((t) => {
    if (filter === 'quick') return t.estimatedMinutes && t.estimatedMinutes <= 20;
    if (filter === 'deep') return t.estimatedMinutes && t.estimatedMinutes > 20;
    return true;
  }) || [];

  const handleSelect = async (task) => {
    if (selectedIds.has(task.userTaskId)) return;
    setSelectedIds((prev) => new Set([...prev, task.userTaskId]));
    await onTaskSelect?.(task);
  };

  return (
    <div className="task-pool-container">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="task-pool-header">
        <div className="pool-context">
          <div className="pool-mood-badge" style={{ '--mood-color': mood.color }}>
            {mood.emoji} {mood.label}
          </div>
          <div className="pool-meta">
            <span>🌅 {slot}</span>
            <span>⏱️ {poolData.availableMinutes} dk müsait</span>
            <span>⚡ Enerji {poolData.energyLevel}/5</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="pool-filters">
          {['all', 'quick', 'deep'].map((f) => (
            <button
              key={f}
              className={`filter-chip ${filter === f ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setFilter(f)}
            >
              {f === 'all' ? 'Tümü' : f === 'quick' ? '⚡ Hızlı (≤20dk)' : '🧠 Odak (>20dk)'}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <button className="pool-refresh-btn" onClick={onRefresh}>
          🔄 Yenile
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Task Grid */}
      {filteredTasks.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="pool-empty">
          <span>🎉</span>
          <p>Bu filtre için görev bulunamadı</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="task-pool-grid">
          {filteredTasks.map((task) => (
            <EnhancedTaskCard
              key={task.userTaskId}
              task={task}
              isSelected={selectedIds.has(task.userTaskId)}
              onSelect={() => handleSelect(task)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {selectedIds.size > 0 && (
        <div className="selection-summary">
          ✅ {selectedIds.size} görev seçildi — Harika! Başarılar!
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\components\VacationModeToggle.jsx

import React, { useState } from "react";
import axiosClient from "../api/axiosClient";
import { getUserIdFromToken } from "../utils/authUtils";

const VACATION_REASONS = [
  { value: "Tatil", label: "🏖️ Tatil" },
  { value: "Hastalık", label: "🤒 Hastalık" },
  { value: "Çok yoğunum", label: "💼 Çok yoğunum" },
];

const VacationModeToggle = ({ isOnVacation: initialVacation = false, onVacationChange }) => {
  const [isOnVacation, setIsOnVacation] = useState(initialVacation);
  const [showConfirm, setShowConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("Tatil");
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState(null);

  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];

  const handleStartVacation = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const userId = getUserIdFromToken();
      const body = {
        reason,
        endDate: endDate || null,
      };
      const res = await axiosClient.post(`/users/${userId}/vacation/start`, body);
      setIsOnVacation(true);
      setMessage({ type: "success", text: res.data?.message || "Tatil modu başlatıldı! 🏖️" });
      setShowConfirm(false);
      onVacationChange?.(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: "Bir hata oluştu." });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEndVacation = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const userId = getUserIdFromToken();
      const res = await axiosClient.post(`/users/${userId}/vacation/end`);
      setIsOnVacation(false);
      setMessage({ type: "success", text: res.data?.message || "Tatil modu kapatıldı! 🔥" });
      onVacationChange?.(false);
    } catch (err) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: "Bir hata oluştu." });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900/80 to-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700/50 rounded-[2rem] p-6 space-y-5">
      {/* Başlık */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-black text-white tracking-wider uppercase italic flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-xl">🏖️</span> Tatil / Mola Modu
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Bu sürede streak'in korunur, görev gelmez.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Toggle */}
        <button
          onClick={() => isOnVacation ? handleEndVacation() : setShowConfirm(true)}
          disabled={loading}
          className={`relative w-14 h-7 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
            isOnVacation
              ? "bg-emerald-500 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/30"
              : "bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600"
          } disabled:opacity-50`}
          aria-label="Tatil modunu aç/kapat"
        >
          <span
            className={`absolute top-1 w-5 h-5 bg-white rounded-full shadow transition-all duration-300 ${
              isOnVacation ? "left-8" : "left-1"
            }`}
          />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Durum rozeti */}
      {isOnVacation && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-2xl px-4 py-2">
          <span className="text-emerald-400 text-sm">✅</span>
          <p className="text-emerald-300 text-sm font-medium">
            Tatil modundasın — streak'in güvende! 🔥
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Onay formu */}
      {showConfirm && !isOnVacation && (
        <div className="space-y-4 border border-slate-700/50 rounded-2xl p-4 bg-slate-900/40">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-300 font-semibold">Tatil nedeni nedir?</p>

          {/* Neden seçimi */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            {VACATION_REASONS.map((r) => (
              <button
                key={r.value}
                onClick={() => setReason(r.value)}
                className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                  reason === r.value
                    ? "bg-indigo-600/30 border border-indigo-500 text-white"
                    : "bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-500"
                }`}
              >
                {r.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Bitiş tarihi */}
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mb-1">Bitiş tarihi (opsiyonel)</label>
            <input
              type="date"
              min={todayStr}
              value={endDate}
              onChange={(e) => setEndDate(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 transition-colors"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Açıklama */}
          <div className="bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 rounded-xl p-3">
            <p className="text-amber-300 text-xs">
              ⚠️ Tatil süresince sana görev atanmaz. Dilediğin zaman kapatabilirsin.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Butonlar */}
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={handleStartVacation}
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex-1 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-sm font-bold py-2 rounded-xl transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {loading ? "Başlatılıyor..." : "Başlat 🏖️"}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowConfirm(false)}
              className="flex-1 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 text-sm font-bold py-2 rounded-xl transition-all"
            >
              İptal
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mesaj */}
      {message && (
        <div
          className={`rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm ${
            message.type === "success"

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\components\onboarding\StepGoals.jsx

import React from 'react';

const FOCUS_AREAS = [
  { value: 'health',       label: 'Sağlık & Spor',    emoji: '💪', sub: 'Egzersiz, uyku, beslenme' },
  { value: 'career',       label: 'Kariyer & İş',     emoji: '🚀', sub: 'Beceri, networking, verimlilik' },
  { value: 'education',    label: 'Öğrenme',          emoji: '🎓', sub: 'Okuma, kurslar, yeni beceriler' },
  { value: 'social',       label: 'İlişkiler',        emoji: '🤝', sub: 'Aile, arkadaşlar, sosyal hayat' },
  { value: 'mindfulness',  label: 'Zihinsel Sağlık',  emoji: '🧘', sub: 'Meditasyon, stres yönetimi' },
  { value: 'finance',      label: 'Finans',           emoji: '💰', sub: 'Tasarruf, bütçe, yatırım' },
];

const StepGoals = ({ answers, onChange, onNext, onBack }) => {
  const toggleSecondary = (v) => {
    if (v === answers.primaryFocusArea) return;
    const cur = answers.secondaryGoals || [];
    const next = cur.includes(v)
      ? cur.filter(x => x !== v)
      : cur.length < 2 ? [...cur, v] : cur;
    onChange({ secondaryGoals: next });
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="step-title">Ne üzerinde çalışmak istiyorsun? 🎯</div>
      <div className="step-subtitle">Ana odak alanın öncelikli görevleri belirler.</div>

      <label style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.65)', fontSize: '0.85rem', display: 'block', marginBottom: '0.75rem' }}>
        En çok neyi geliştirmek istiyorsun?
      </label>
      <div className="option-cards">
        {FOCUS_AREAS.map(opt => (
          <div
            key={opt.value}
            className={`option-card ${answers.primaryFocusArea === opt.value ? 'selected' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => onChange({ primaryFocusArea: opt.value })}
          >
            <span className="card-emoji">{opt.emoji}</span>
            <div className="card-label">{opt.label}</div>
            <div className="card-sub">{opt.sub}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {answers.primaryFocusArea && (
        <>
          <label style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.65)', fontSize: '0.85rem', display: 'block', marginBottom: '0.5rem' }}>
            Bunlar dışında neler var? (Opsiyonel, max 2)
          </label>
          <div className="chips-grid">
            {FOCUS_AREAS
              .filter(f => f.value !== answers.primaryFocusArea)
              .map(f => (
                <div
                  key={f.value}
                  className={`chip ${answers.secondaryGoals?.includes(f.value) ? 'active' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => toggleSecondary(f.value)}
                >
                  {f.emoji} {f.label}
                </div>
              ))}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      <div className="step-actions">
        <button className="btn-secondary" onClick={onBack}>← Geri</button>
        <button className="btn-primary" onClick={onNext} disabled={!answers.primaryFocusArea}>
          Devam →
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default StepGoals;

];

const DAYS = ['Paz','Pzt','Sal','Çar','Per','Cum','Cmt'];

const StepLifestyle = ({ answers, onChange, onNext, onBack }) => {

            <div className="card-label">{opt.label}</div>

      <div className="chips-grid" style={{ marginBottom: '1.5rem' }}>
        {WAKE_TIMES.map(t => (
          <div
            key={t}

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\components\onboarding\StepSummary.jsx

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

const AVATARS = ['🦁','🐯','🦊','🐺','🦅','🦋','🐉','🦄','🐬','🦈','🐸','🐼','🐻','🦝','🐮','🐧','🦩','🐙','🦕','🤖'];

const FOCUS_LABELS = {
  health: '💪 Sağlık & Spor',
  career: '🚀 Kariyer & İş',
  education: '🎓 Öğrenme',
  social: '🤝 İlişkiler',
  mindfulness: '🧘 Zihinsel Sağlık',
  finance: '💰 Finans',
};

const StepSummary = ({ answers, result, onFinish }) => {
  const [confetti, setConfetti] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Konfeti animasyonu
    const items = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => ({
      id: i,
      left: `${Math.random() * 100}%`,
      delay: `${Math.random() * 2}s`,
      duration: `${1.5 + Math.random() * 2}s`,
      color: ['#7c3aed','#06b6d4','#10b981','#f59e0b','#ef4444'][i % 5]
    }));
    setConfetti(items);
  }, []);

  const avatar = AVATARS[(answers.avatarId || 1) - 1];
  const dailyLimit = result?.dailyTaskLimit || Math.max(1, Math.floor((answers.preferredTasksPerWeek || 5) / 7));

  return (
    <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', position: 'relative', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      {/* Konfeti */}
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, left: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
        {confetti.map(c => (
          <div
            key={c.id}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              left: c.left,
              top: '-10px',
              width: '8px', height: '8px',
              borderRadius: '50%',
              background: c.color,
              animation: `fall ${c.duration} ${c.delay} ease-in forwards`
            }}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      <style>{`
        @keyframes fall {
          to { transform: translateY(400px) rotate(720deg); opacity: 0; }
        }
      `}</style>

      <div style={{ fontSize: '4rem', marginBottom: '0.75rem' }}>{avatar}</div>
      <div className="step-title" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>Hazırsın! 🎉</div>
      <div className="step-subtitle" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
        Merhaba, <strong style={{ color: '#fff' }}>{answers.displayName || 'Kahraman'}</strong>! Profiin oluşturuldu.
      </div>

      {/* Özet Kartlar */}
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'left', marginBottom: '1.5rem' }}>
        <div className="summary-card">
          <div className="summary-icon">🎯</div>
          <div className="summary-info">
            <h4>Odak Alanın</h4>
            <p>{FOCUS_LABELS[answers.primaryFocusArea] || answers.primaryFocusArea || 'Genel'}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="summary-card">
          <div className="summary-icon">📋</div>
          <div className="summary-info">
            <h4>Günlük Görev Limitin</h4>
            <p>Günde {dailyLimit} görev, haftada {answers.preferredTasksPerWeek || 5} görev hedefi</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="summary-card">
          <div className="summary-icon">🔥</div>
          <div className="summary-info">
            <h4>Streak Başladı!</h4>
            <p>1. Gün • Devam et!</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        {result?.firstTaskTitle && (
          <div className="summary-card">
            <div className="summary-icon">✅</div>
            <div className="summary-info">
              <h4>İlk Görev Hazır</h4>
              <p>{result.firstTaskTitle}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <button className="btn-primary" style={{ width: '100%', fontSize: '1rem', padding: '1rem' }} onClick={onFinish}>
        🚀 Hadi Başlayalım!
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default StepSummary;

        placeholder="Takma isim veya ad"
        value={answers.displayName}
        onChange={e => onChange({ displayName: e.target.value })}
      />

      <label style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.65)', fontSize: '0.85rem', display: 'block', marginBottom: '0.75rem' }}>
        Bir avatar seç
      </label>
      <div className="avatar-grid">
        {AVATARS.map((emoji, i) => (
          <div
            key={i}
            className={`avatar-item ${answers.avatarId === i + 1 ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => onChange({ avatarId: i + 1 })}
          >
            {emoji}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="step-actions">
        <button
          className="btn-primary"
          onClick={onNext}
          disabled={!answers.displayName.trim()}
        >
          Devam →
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default StepWelcome;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\context\authContext.jsx
==================================================

import React, { createContext, useState, useContext, useEffect } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

const AuthContext = createContext();

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [token, setToken] = useState(localStorage.getItem("token"));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => {
    const storedToken = localStorage.getItem("token");
    const storedUser = localStorage.getItem("user_data");

    if (storedToken && storedUser) {
      setToken(storedToken);
      setUser(JSON.parse(storedUser));
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  const login = (userData, userToken) => {
    localStorage.setItem("token", userToken);
    localStorage.setItem("user_data", JSON.stringify(userData));
    setToken(userToken);
    setUser(userData);
    navigate("/dashboard");
  };

  const logout = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem("token");
    localStorage.removeItem("user_data");
    setToken(null);
    setUser(null);
    navigate("/login");
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, token, login, logout, loading }}>
      {!loading && children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => useContext(AuthContext);

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import MainLayout from "../layouts/MainLayout";
import categoryService from "../services/categoryService";
import taskService from "../services/taskService";
import badgeService from "../services/badgeService";

const AdminPage = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("tasks");
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [jsonInput, setJsonInput] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const [taskData, setTaskData] = useState({
    title: "",
    description: "",
    categoryId: "",
    baseXP: 100,
    minLevel: 1,
    difficulty: 0,
  });
  const [catData, setCatData] = useState({
    name: "",
    description: "",
    iconPath: "🔹",
  });
  const [badgeData, setBadgeData] = useState({
    name: "",
    description: "",
    iconPath: "🏆",
    requiredLevel: 1,
    categoryId: "",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCategories();
  }, []);

  const loadCategories = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await categoryService.getAllCategories();
      const catList = Array.isArray(data) ? data : data?.categories || [];
      setCategories(catList);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const handleSingleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      if (activeTab === "tasks") await taskService.createTask(taskData);
      else if (activeTab === "categories")
        await categoryService.createCategory(catData);
      else if (activeTab === "badges") {
        if (!badgeData.categoryId) {
          alert("Lütfen rozet için bir kategori seçin!");
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        await badgeService.createBadge(badgeData);
      }

      alert("✅ Başarıyla eklendi!");
      if (activeTab === "categories") loadCategories();
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Hata: " + (err.response?.data?.message || err.message));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleBulkSubmit = async () => {
    if (!jsonInput) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonInput);
      if (activeTab === "tasks") await taskService.createBulkTasks(parsed);
      else if (activeTab === "categories")
        await categoryService.createBulkCategories(parsed);
      else if (activeTab === "badges")
        await badgeService.createBulkBadges(parsed);

      alert("🚀 Toplu yükleme başarılı!");
      setJsonInput("");
      if (activeTab === "categories") loadCategories();
    } catch (err) {
      alert("JSON hatası veya API reddetti: " + err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const inputClass =
    "w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 text-white outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 transition-colors placeholder:text-slate-600";
  const labelClass =
    "text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest ml-1 mb-2 block";

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-10">
        <section>
          <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter uppercase">
            ADMİN KONTROL PANELİ
          </h2>
          <div className="h-1.5 w-32 bg-rose-600 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(225,29,72,0.4)] mt-2"></div>
        </section>

        <div className="flex gap-2 p-1 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-fit">
          {["categories", "tasks", "badges"].map((tab) => (
            <button
              key={tab}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
              className={`px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-black uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest transition-all ${
                activeTab === tab
                  ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg"
                  : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800"
              }`}
            >
              {tab === "tasks"
                ? "⚔️ Görevler"
                : tab === "categories"
                ? "📂 Kategoriler"
                : "🏆 Rozetler"}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-10">
          <div className="bg-slate-900/40 p-10 rounded-[3rem] border border-slate-800 relative overflow-hidden">
            <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-indigo-500/10 blur-[60px] rounded-full"></div>
            <h3 className="text-white font-black italic mb-8 uppercase text-lg tracking-widest border-b border-slate-800 pb-4">
              Tekli{" "}
              {activeTab === "tasks"
                ? "Görev"
                : activeTab === "categories"
                ? "Kategori"
                : "Rozet"}{" "}
              Ekle
            </h3>

            <form
              onSubmit={handleSingleSubmit}
              className="space-y-6 relative z-10"
            >
              {activeTab === "tasks" && (
                <>
                  <div>
                    <label className={labelClass}>Görev Başlığı</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="Örn: 5KM Koşu"
                      className={inputClass}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setTaskData({ ...taskData, title: e.target.value })
                      }
                      required
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className={labelClass}>Açıklama</label>
                    <textarea
                      rows="2"
                      placeholder="Detaylar..."
                      className={inputClass}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setTaskData({
                          ...taskData,
                          description: e.target.value,
                        })
                      }
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className={labelClass}>Kategori</label>
                    <select
                      className={inputClass}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setTaskData({ ...taskData, categoryId: e.target.value })
                      }
                      required
                    >
                      <option value="">Seçiniz...</option>
                      {categories.map((c) => (

                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import MainLayout from "../layouts/MainLayout";
import BadgeCard from "../components/BadgeCard";
import badgeService from "../services/badgeService";

const BadgeGallery = () => {
  const [badges, setBadges] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchBadges = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await badgeService.getBadgeGallery();
        setBadges(data);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Rozetler yüklenirken hata:", err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchBadges();
  }, []);

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="space-y-10">
        <section>
          <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2">
            ROZETLER
          </h2>
          <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-indigo-600 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,70,229,0.5)]"></div>
          <p className="text-slate-500 mt-4 font-medium italic">
            Başarılarını sergile ve yeni hedeflere odaklan.
          </p>
        </section>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8">
          {!loading ? (
            badges.length > 0 ? (
              badges.map((badge) => <BadgeCard key={badge.id} {...badge} />)
            ) : (
              <p className="text-slate-500 italic col-span-4 text-center">
                Henüz rozet tanımlanmamış.
              </p>
            )
          ) : (
            [1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
              <div
                key={i}
                className="h-64 bg-slate-900/50 rounded-3xl animate-pulse border border-slate-800"
              ></div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default BadgeGallery;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\pages\DailyTaskPage.jsx

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import DailyMoodSelector from '../components/DailyMoodSelector';
import TaskPoolSelector from '../components/TaskPoolSelector';
import { moodApi, taskPoolApi } from '../api/moodApi';
import MainLayout from '../layouts/MainLayout';
import '../styles/DailyTaskPage.css';

export default function DailyTaskPage() {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState('loading'); // loading | mood | pool
  const [poolData, setPoolData] = useState(null);
  const [poolLoading, setPoolLoading] = useState(false);

  // Sayfa açıldığında bugün zaten mood girildi mi kontrol et
  useEffect(() => {
    checkTodayMood();
  }, []);

  const checkTodayMood = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await moodApi.getTodayMood();
      if (res.data?.data) {
        // Bugün mood girilmiş — direkt pool'a geç
        await loadPool();
        setPhase('pool');
      } else {
        setPhase('mood');
      }
    } catch {
      setPhase('mood');
    }
  };

  const handleMoodRecorded = async () => {
    await loadPool();
    setPhase('pool');
  };

  const loadPool = async () => {
    setPoolLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await taskPoolApi.getDailyPool(6);
      setPoolData(res.data?.data || res.data || null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Pool yüklenemedi:', err);
    } finally {
      setPoolLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTaskSelect = async (task) => {
    try {
      await taskPoolApi.selectTask(task.userTaskId);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Görev seçilemedi:', err);
    }
  };

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="daily-task-page">
        {/* Page Header */}
        <div className="daily-task-page__header">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2">🎯 Günlük Görevler</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm">Ruh haline göre kişiselleştirilmiş görevler</p>
          </div>
          {phase === 'pool' && (
            <button
              className="mood-reset-btn bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl transition-colors"
              onClick={() => setPhase('mood')}
            >
              😊 Moodunu Güncelle
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        {phase === 'loading' && (
          <div className="daily-task-page__loading flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12">
            <div className="loading-spinner w-8 h-8 border-t-2 border-indigo-500 rounded-full animate-spin mb-4" />
            <p className="text-slate-400">Yükleniyor...</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {phase === 'mood' && (
          <DailyMoodSelector onMoodRecorded={handleMoodRecorded} />
        )}

        {phase === 'pool' && (
          poolLoading ? (
            <div className="daily-task-page__loading flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12">
              <div className="loading-spinner w-8 h-8 border-t-2 border-indigo-500 rounded-full animate-spin mb-4" />
              <p className="text-slate-400">Görevler hazırlanıyor...</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <TaskPoolSelector
              poolData={poolData}
              onTaskSelect={handleTaskSelect}
              onRefresh={loadPool}
            />
          )
        )}
      </div>
    </MainLayout>
  );
}

const DashBoard = () => {

    weeklyGrowth: 0

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const connectionRef = useRef(null);

  // SP-03: SignalR proaktif nudge bağlantısı
  useEffect(() => {
    const userId = getUserIdFromToken();
    if (!userId) return;

    const connection = new signalR.HubConnectionBuilder()
      .withUrl(`${import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL?.replace('/api', '') ?? 'http://localhost:5000'}/hubs/notification`, {
        accessTokenFactory: () => localStorage.getItem('token') ?? ''
      })
      .withAutomaticReconnect()
      .configureLogging(signalR.LogLevel.Warning)
      .build();

    connectionRef.current = connection;

    connection.on('ReceiveNotification', (notif) => {
      if (notif?.type === 'ProactiveNudge') {
        toast(
          <div>
            <p className="font-bold text-sm mb-1">LifeQuest AI 🤖</p>
            <p className="text-xs">{notif.message}</p>
          </div>,
          {
            autoClose: 8000,
            className: 'bg-slate-800 border border-indigo-500/40 text-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl',
            progressClassName: 'bg-indigo-500',
            onClick: () => {
              // ChatBot açılsun — window event üzerinden ChatBot dinler
              window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('openChatBot', { detail: { message: notif.message } }));
            }
          }
        );
      }
    });

    connection.start().catch(err => console.warn('SignalR bağlanamıyor:', err));

    return () => { connection.stop(); };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchDashboardData = async () => {
      try {
        try {
          const catsRes = await categoryService.getAllCategories();
          setCategories(Array.isArray(catsRes) ? catsRes : (catsRes?.categories || []));
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Kategoriler hatası:", err);
        }

        try {
          const actsRes = await userService.getActivities();
          const activitiesList = actsRes.activities || actsRes.Activities || actsRes || [];
          setRecentActivities(Array.isArray(activitiesList) ? activitiesList : []);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Aktiviteler hatası:", err);
          setRecentActivities([]);
        }

        try {
          const statsRes = await userService.getUserStats();
          setStats(statsRes || { streak: [], streakCount: 0, totalCompleted: 0, weeklyGrowth: 0 });
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("İstatistik hatası:", err);
        }

        // AI Motivasyon Çekme
        try {
          const aiResponse = await axiosClient.post('/chat/send', { 
            message: "Beni motive et" 
          });
          if (aiResponse.data && aiResponse.data.response) {
            setMotivation(aiResponse.data.response);
          } else {
             setMotivation("Bugün hedeflerine ulaşmak için harika bir gün! Küçük adımlar büyük sonuçlar getirir.");
          }
        } catch (err) {
          setMotivation("Bugün hedeflerine ulaşmak için harika bir gün! Küçük adımlar büyük sonuçlar getirir.");
        }

        // Mood Check
        try {
          const moodRes = await moodApi.getTodayMood();
          if (moodRes.data?.data) {
            setTodayMood(moodRes.data.data);
          } else {
            setShowMoodModal(true);
          }

          setShowMoodModal(true);
        }

      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Genel Dashboard hatası:", error);
      } finally {

      }
    };

    fetchDashboardData();
  }, []);

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="space-y-8">
        <section className="relative flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-6">

            <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2 relative z-10">DASHBOARD</h2>
            <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-indigo-600 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,70,229,0.6)]"></div>
          </div>
          
          {/* AI Motivasyon Widget */}
          <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-900/50 to-violet-900/50 border border-indigo-500/30 rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center gap-4 max-w-md shadow-lg backdrop-blur-sm relative overflow-hidden group">
            <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-indigo-500/10 blur-3xl rounded-full group-hover:bg-indigo-500/20 transition-all"></div>
            <div className="text-3xl relative z-10 animate-bounce">🤖</div>
            <div className="relative z-10">
              <p className="text-[10px] text-indigo-300 font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">Yapay Zeka Asistanı</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-200 leading-tight italic">"{motivation}"</p>

        </section>

        {/* Günlük Özet Bar */}
        {todayMood && (
          <div className="bg-slate-900/40 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span className="text-2xl">{todayMood.moodMode === 0 ? '⚡' : todayMood.moodMode === 1 ? '😊' : todayMood.moodMode === 2 ? '😴' : todayMood.moodMode === 3 ? '😰' : '⏰'}</span>

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import MainLayout from '../layouts/MainLayout';
import goalService from '../services/goalService';
import GoalCard from '../components/GoalCard';

const GOAL_TYPES = [
  { value: 0, label: 'Genel', emoji: '⭐' },
  { value: 1, label: 'Haftalık', emoji: '📅' },
  { value: 2, label: 'Aylık', emoji: '🗓️' },
  { value: 3, label: 'Proje', emoji: '🚀' },
];

const ICONS = ['🎯', '💪', '📚', '🧘', '🏃', '💰', '🎨', '🤝', '🌱', '⚡', '🏋️', '🎓'];
const COLORS = ['#7c3aed', '#0ea5e9', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444', '#ec4899', '#8b5cf6', '#06b6d4'];

const GoalsPage = () => {
  const [dashboard, setDashboard] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('active');
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [newGoal, setNewGoal] = useState({
    title: '',
    description: '',
    type: 0,
    targetValue: 30,
    bonusXP: 100,
    icon: '🎯',
    color: '#7c3aed',
    why: '',
    progressUnit: 'görev',
    autoTrackByCategory: false,
    autoTrackByXP: false,
    reminderEnabled: true,
    reminderFrequency: 'daily',
    startDate: new Date().toISOString(),
    endDate: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 86400000).toISOString(),
    durationDays: 30,
  });

  const fetchDashboard = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const data = await goalService.getGoalDashboard();
      setDashboard(data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Dashboard alınamadı:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { fetchDashboard(); }, [fetchDashboard]);

  const handleCreateGoal = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const endDate = new Date(Date.now() + newGoal.durationDays * 86400000).toISOString();
      await goalService.createGoal({ ...newGoal, endDate });
      setShowModal(false);
      fetchDashboard();
      setNewGoal(prev => ({ ...prev, title: '', description: '', why: '' }));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Hedef oluşturulamadı:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'active', label: 'Aktif', count: dashboard?.totalActiveGoals || 0, color: '#7c3aed' },
    { id: 'completed', label: 'Tamamlanan', count: dashboard?.totalCompletedThisMonth || 0, color: '#10b981' },
    { id: 'archived', label: 'Arşiv', count: dashboard?.archivedGoals?.length || 0, color: '#64748b' },
  ];

  const goalList = activeTab === 'active'
    ? dashboard?.activeGoals || []
    : activeTab === 'completed'
    ? dashboard?.completedGoals || []
    : dashboard?.archivedGoals || [];

  const lagGoals = dashboard?.activeGoals?.filter(g => g.isOnLag) || [];

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="space-y-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex justify-between items-end">
          <section className="relative">
            <div className="absolute -left-10 -top-10 w-40 h-40 bg-teal-600/10 blur-[80px] rounded-full"></div>
            <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2 relative z-10">HEDEFLER</h2>
            <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-teal-600 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(13,148,136,0.6)]"></div>
          </section>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowModal(true)}
            className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(79,70,229,0.3)]"
          >
            + Yeni Hedef
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Lag uyarısı */}
        {lagGoals.length > 0 && (
          <div className="bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="text-2xl">⚠️</span>
            <div>
              <div className="text-amber-400 font-bold text-sm">{lagGoals.length} hedef geride kalıyor</div>
              <div className="text-amber-400/60 text-xs mt-0.5">
                {lagGoals.map(g => g.title).join(', ')} — biraz daha ilerleme gerekiyor!
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {tabs.map(tab => (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
              className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition-all ${
                activeTab === tab.id
                  ? 'text-white shadow-lg'
                  : 'bg-slate-900/60 text-slate-400 hover:text-white border border-slate-800'
              }`}
              style={activeTab === tab.id ? { background: `${tab.color}cc` } : {}}
            >
              {tab.label}
              {tab.count > 0 && (
                <span className="ml-1.5 text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-black"
                  style={{ background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)' }}>
                  {tab.count}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        {loading ? (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {[1, 2, 3].map(i => (
              <div key={i} className="h-32 bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl animate-pulse border border-slate-800" />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : goalList.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-700 p-12 text-center">
            <p className="text-4xl mb-4">🎯</p>
            <p className="text-slate-400 font-bold">
              {activeTab === 'active' ? 'Aktif hedef yok.' : activeTab === 'completed' ? 'Bu ay tamamlanan yok.' : 'Arşivlenmiş hedef yok.'}
            </p>
            {activeTab === 'active' && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowModal(true)}
                className="mt-4 px-6 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold text-sm hover:bg-indigo-500 transition-all"
              >
                İlk Hedefini Oluştur →
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {goalList.map(goal => (
              <GoalCard key={goal.id} goal={goal} onUpdate={fetchDashboard} />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Hedef Oluştur Modal */}
      {showModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 p-8 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-lg shadow-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
              <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Yeni Hedef</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowModal(false)} className="text-slate-500 hover:text-white text-xl">✕</button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleCreateGoal} className="space-y-4">
              {/* Icon + Color seçici */}
              <div className="flex gap-4">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 block">İkon</label>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {ICONS.map(ic => (
                      <button
                        type="button" key={ic}
                        className={`text-xl w-9 h-9 rounded-lg transition-all ${newGoal.icon === ic ? 'bg-indigo-600/40 ring-2 ring-indigo-500' : 'bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700'}`}
                        onClick={() => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, icon: ic }))}
                      >{ic}</button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 block">Renk</label>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {COLORS.map(c => (
                      <button
                        type="button" key={c}
                        className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-full transition-all ${newGoal.color === c ? 'ring-2 ring-white scale-110' : 'opacity-70 hover:opacity-100'}`}
                        style={{ background: c }}
                        onClick={() => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, color: c }))}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Hedef Başlığı *</label>
                <input required type="text" className="w-full bg-slate-800 border-none rounded-xl text-white p-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
                  placeholder="Örn: 30 Günde 30 Kitap"
                  value={newGoal.title} onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, title: e.target.value }))} />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Neden yapıyorum? (Motivasyon)</label>
                <input type="text" className="w-full bg-slate-800 border-none rounded-xl text-white p-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
                  placeholder="Bu hedef benim için ne ifade ediyor?"
                  value={newGoal.why} onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, why: e.target.value }))} />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Hedef Değer</label>
                  <input type="number" min="1" className="w-full bg-slate-800 border-none rounded-xl text-white p-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
                    value={newGoal.targetValue} onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, targetValue: parseInt(e.target.value) }))} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Birim</label>
                  <input type="text" className="w-full bg-slate-800 border-none rounded-xl text-white p-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
                    placeholder="görev, km, sayfa..." 
                    value={newGoal.progressUnit} onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, progressUnit: e.target.value }))} />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Süre (Gün)</label>
                  <input type="number" min="1" max="365" className="w-full bg-slate-800 border-none rounded-xl text-white p-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
                    value={newGoal.durationDays}
                    onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, durationDays: parseInt(e.target.value) }))} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Ödül XP</label>
                  <input type="number" min="0" step="25" className="w-full bg-slate-800 border-none rounded-xl text-white p-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
                    value={newGoal.bonusXP}
                    onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, bonusXP: parseInt(e.target.value) }))} />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Otomatik takip */}
              <div className="flex gap-4">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                  <input type="checkbox" className="w-4 h-4 accent-indigo-600"
                    checked={newGoal.autoTrackByCategory}
                    onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, autoTrackByCategory: e.target.checked }))} />
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-300 font-bold">Kategori ile takip</span>
                </label>
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                  <input type="checkbox" className="w-4 h-4 accent-indigo-600"
                    checked={newGoal.autoTrackByXP}
                    onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, autoTrackByXP: e.target.checked }))} />
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-300 font-bold">XP ile takip</span>
                </label>
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                  <input type="checkbox" className="w-4 h-4 accent-indigo-600"
                    checked={newGoal.reminderEnabled}
                    onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, reminderEnabled: e.target.checked }))} />
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-300 font-bold">Hatırlatma</span>
                </label>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 mt-6">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}
                  className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors text-sm">
                  İptal
                </button>
                <button type="submit" disabled={submitting}
                  className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold bg-teal-600 text-white hover:bg-teal-500 shadow-lg shadow-teal-900/50 text-sm transition-all disabled:opacity-50">
                  {submitting ? '⏳ Oluşturuluyor...' : '✨ Hedefi Oluştur'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default GoalsPage;
