import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import MainLayout from '../layouts/MainLayout';
import leaderboardService from '../services/leaderboardService';
import { getUserIdFromToken } from '../utils/authUtils';

const RANK_COLORS = [
  'from-amber-400 to-yellow-500',   // 1st
  'from-slate-300 to-slate-400',    // 2nd
  'from-amber-600 to-orange-700',   // 3rd
];

const RANK_ICONS = ['👑', '🥈', '🥉'];
const RANK_BORDER = ['border-amber-400/50 shadow-amber-500/20', 'border-slate-400/50 shadow-slate-400/10', 'border-amber-600/50 shadow-orange-700/10'];

const LeaderboardPage = () => {
  const [leaderboard, setLeaderboard] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [myRank, setMyRank] = useState(null);
  const currentUserId = getUserIdFromToken?.() || null;

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchLeaderboard = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await leaderboardService.getLeaderboard();
        const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.leaderboard || []);
        setLeaderboard(list);
        // Find current user's rank
        const myEntry = list.findIndex(u => u.userName === localStorage.getItem('username'));
        if (myEntry >= 0) setMyRank(myEntry + 1);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchLeaderboard();
  }, []);

  const top3 = leaderboard.slice(0, 3);
  const rest = leaderboard.slice(3);

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="space-y-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <section className="relative">
          <div className="absolute -left-10 -top-10 w-40 h-40 bg-amber-600/10 blur-[80px] rounded-full"></div>
          <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2 relative z-10">SIRALAMALAR</h2>
          <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-amber-500 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.6)]"></div>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-2">En yüksek XP'ye sahip oyuncular</p>
        </section>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {[1,2,3,4,5].map(i => (
              <div key={i} className="h-16 bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl animate-pulse border border-slate-800"></div>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Top 3 Podium */}
            {top3.length > 0 && (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-4">
                {/* 2nd place */}
                <div className={`order-1 mt-8 bg-slate-900/60 rounded-2xl border p-4 text-center ${RANK_BORDER[1]} shadow-lg`}>
                  <div className="text-3xl mb-2">{RANK_ICONS[1]}</div>
                  <div className={`w-14 h-14 mx-auto rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br ${RANK_COLORS[1]} flex items-center justify-center font-black text-white text-lg shadow-lg mb-3`}>
                    {top3[1]?.name?.charAt(0)}{top3[1]?.surname?.charAt(0)}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-white font-bold text-sm truncate">{top3[1]?.name} {top3[1]?.surname}</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{top3[1]?.userName}</p>
                  <p className="text-amber-400 font-black text-sm mt-2">{top3[1]?.totalXP?.toLocaleString()} XP</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-600 text-xs">Lv. {top3[1]?.generalLevel}</p>
                </div>

                {/* 1st place */}
                <div className={`order-2 bg-slate-900/60 rounded-2xl border p-4 text-center ${RANK_BORDER[0]} shadow-2xl relative`}>
                  <div className="absolute -top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-amber-500 text-black text-xs font-black px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-lg">1. SIRALAMASINDA</div>
                  <div className="text-3xl mb-2 mt-4">{RANK_ICONS[0]}</div>
                  <div className={`w-16 h-16 mx-auto rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br ${RANK_COLORS[0]} flex items-center justify-center font-black text-black text-xl shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/30 mb-3`}>
                    {top3[0]?.name?.charAt(0)}{top3[0]?.surname?.charAt(0)}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-white font-bold truncate">{top3[0]?.name} {top3[0]?.surname}</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{top3[0]?.userName}</p>
                  <p className="text-amber-400 font-black mt-2">{top3[0]?.totalXP?.toLocaleString()} XP</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-600 text-xs">Lv. {top3[0]?.generalLevel}</p>
                </div>

                {/* 3rd place */}
                <div className={`order-3 mt-12 bg-slate-900/60 rounded-2xl border p-4 text-center ${RANK_BORDER[2]} shadow-lg`}>
                  <div className="text-3xl mb-2">{RANK_ICONS[2]}</div>
                  <div className={`w-14 h-14 mx-auto rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br ${RANK_COLORS[2]} flex items-center justify-center font-black text-white text-lg shadow-lg mb-3`}>
                    {top3[2]?.name?.charAt(0)}{top3[2]?.surname?.charAt(0)}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-white font-bold text-sm truncate">{top3[2]?.name} {top3[2]?.surname}</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{top3[2]?.userName}</p>
                  <p className="text-amber-400 font-black text-sm mt-2">{top3[2]?.totalXP?.toLocaleString()} XP</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-600 text-xs">Lv. {top3[2]?.generalLevel}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Rest of leaderboard */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {rest.map((user, idx) => {
                const rank = idx + 4;
                return (
                  <div key={user.userName} className={`flex items-center gap-4 p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                    rank === myRank
                      ? 'border-indigo-500/50 bg-indigo-500/10 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/10'
                      : 'border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/40 hover:border-slate-700'
                  }`}>
                    <div className="w-8 text-center">
                      <span className="text-slate-500 font-black text-sm">{rank}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-600 to-violet-600 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-white text-sm">
                      {user.name?.charAt(0)}{user.surname?.charAt(0)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-white font-bold text-sm truncate">
                        {user.name} {user.surname}
                        {rank === myRank && <span className="ml-2 text-[10px] text-indigo-400 font-black">(Sen)</span>}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{user.userName}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <p className="text-amber-400 font-black text-sm">{user.totalXP?.toLocaleString()} XP</p>
                      <p className="text-slate-600 text-xs">Lv. {user.generalLevel}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {leaderboard.length === 0 && (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <p className="text-4xl mb-4">🏆</p>
                <p className="font-bold">Sıralama verisi yok.</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default LeaderboardPage;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\pages\LoginPage.jsx

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import authService from "../services/authService";
import { useAuth } from "../context/authContext";
import { getUserNameFromToken } from "../utils/authUtils";

const LoginPage = () => {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const { login } = useAuth();

  const handleLogin = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await authService.login({ email, password });

      if (response && response.token) {
        localStorage.setItem("token", response.token);

        const derivedName = getUserNameFromToken();
        const userData = {
          name: derivedName,
          ...response.user,
        };

        login(userData, response.token);
      } else {
        setError("Beklenmedik bir sunucu yanıtı alındı.");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setError("Giriş başarısız! E-posta veya şifre hatalı olabilir.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-indigo-900/20 via-slate-950 to-slate-950">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md">
        <div className="text-center mb-10">
          <div className="inline-flex w-16 h-16 bg-indigo-600 rounded-2xl items-center justify-center font-black text-3xl shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(79,70,229,0.3)] mb-4 text-white">
            LQ
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-white tracking-tighter">
            LIFEQUEST
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium mt-2 italic">
            Maceraya devam etmek için giriş yap.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-800 p-8 rounded-[2.5rem] backdrop-blur-sm shadow-2xl">
          <form className="space-y-6" onSubmit={handleLogin}>
            {error && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 rounded-xl text-rose-500 text-xs font-bold text-center">
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 ml-1">
                E-Posta Adresi
              </label>
              <input
                type="email"
                placeholder="admin@lifequest.com"
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-slate-800/50 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-4 text-white placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/50 focus:border-indigo-500 transition-all"
                required
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 ml-1">
                Şifre
              </label>
              <input
                type="password"
                placeholder="••••••••"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-slate-800/50 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-4 text-white placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/50 focus:border-indigo-500 transition-all"
                required
              />
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black py-4 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,70,229,0.3)] transition-all active:scale-[0.98] uppercase tracking-widest"
            >
              Giriş Yap
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="mt-8 text-center">
            <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm">
              Hesabın yok mu?{" "}
              <Link
                to="/register"
                className="text-indigo-400 font-bold hover:text-indigo-300 underline decoration-2 underline-offset-4"
              >
                Hemen Kaydol
              </Link>
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default LoginPage;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\pages\OnboardingPage.jsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { onboardingService } from '../services/onboardingService';
import StepWelcome from '../components/onboarding/StepWelcome';
import StepLifestyle from '../components/onboarding/StepLifestyle';
import StepGoals from '../components/onboarding/StepGoals';
import StepCapacity from '../components/onboarding/StepCapacity';
import StepMotivation from '../components/onboarding/StepMotivation';
import StepDifficulty from '../components/onboarding/StepDifficulty';
import StepFirstTask from '../components/onboarding/StepFirstTask';
import StepSummary from '../components/onboarding/StepSummary';
import './OnboardingPage.css';

const TOTAL_STEPS = 8;

const OnboardingPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState({
    displayName: '',
    avatarId: 1,
    lifestyleType: '',
    wakeUpTime: '07:00',
    workDays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    primaryFocusArea: '',
    secondaryGoals: [],
    dailyAvailableMinutes: 30,
    preferredTaskDuration: 'short_15',
    preferredTasksPerWeek: 5,
    motivationFactor: '',
    motivationKillers: [],
    difficultyPreference: 'medium',
    ageRange: '25-34'
  });

  const updateAnswers = (updates) => setAnswers(prev => ({ ...prev, ...updates }));

  const next = () => setStep(s => Math.min(s + 1, TOTAL_STEPS));
  const prev = () => setStep(s => Math.max(s - 1, 1));

  const handleComplete = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await onboardingService.completeOnboarding(answers);
      setResult(response);
      setStep(8);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Onboarding tamamlanırken hata:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const goToDashboard = () => navigate('/dashboard');

  const progressPct = Math.round((step / TOTAL_STEPS) * 100);

  return (
    <div className="onboarding-page">
      <div className="onboarding-container">
        {/* Progress Bar */}
        <div className="onboarding-progress">
          <div className="progress-header">
            <span className="progress-step">Adım {step} / {TOTAL_STEPS}</span>
            <span className="progress-pct">{progressPct}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="progress-track">
            <div className="progress-fill" style={{ width: `${progressPct}%` }} />
          </div>
          <div className="step-dots">
            {Array.from({ length: TOTAL_STEPS }, (_, i) => (
              <div
                key={i}
                className={`step-dot ${i + 1 < step ? 'done' : ''} ${i + 1 === step ? 'active' : ''}`}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Adım İçeriği */}
        <div className="step-content">
          {step === 1 && (
            <StepWelcome answers={answers} onChange={updateAnswers} onNext={next} />
          )}
          {step === 2 && (
            <StepLifestyle answers={answers} onChange={updateAnswers} onNext={next} onBack={prev} />
          )}
          {step === 3 && (
            <StepGoals answers={answers} onChange={updateAnswers} onNext={next} onBack={prev} />
          )}
          {step === 4 && (
            <StepCapacity answers={answers} onChange={updateAnswers} onNext={next} onBack={prev} />
          )}
          {step === 5 && (
            <StepMotivation answers={answers} onChange={updateAnswers} onNext={next} onBack={prev} />
          )}
          {step === 6 && (
            <StepDifficulty
              answers={answers}
              onChange={updateAnswers}
              onNext={handleComplete}
              onBack={prev}
              loading={loading}
            />
          )}
          {step === 7 && (
            <StepFirstTask result={result} onNext={next} onSkip={goToDashboard} />
          )}
          {step === 8 && (
            <StepSummary answers={answers} result={result} onFinish={goToDashboard} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default OnboardingPage;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";

import VacationModeToggle from "../components/VacationModeToggle";
import { Radar, RadarChart, PolarGrid, PolarAngleAxis, PolarRadiusAxis, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip } from 'recharts';

const PERSONALITY_OPTIONS = [
  { value: "friendly", label: "Arkadaşça 😊", desc: "Sıcak, destekleyici ve neşeli" },
  { value: "motivator", label: "Motivasyoncu 🔥", desc: "Enerjik, heyecanlı ve teşvik edici" },
  { value: "coach", label: "Koç 🎯", desc: "Analitik, stratejik ve verimlilik odaklı" },
];

const ProfilePage = () => {
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [chatPersonality, setChatPersonality] = useState("friendly");
  const [nudgeEnabled, setNudgeEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [personalitySaving, setPersonalitySaving] = useState(false);
  const [behaviorSummary, setBehaviorSummary] = useState(null);
  const [isOnVacation, setIsOnVacation] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchProfile = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await userService.getProfile();
        setProfile(data);
        setChatPersonality(data?.chatPersonality || "friendly");
        setNudgeEnabled(data?.nudgeEnabled ?? true);
        setIsOnVacation(data?.isOnVacation ?? false);

        // SP-03: Davranış analizi özeti
        const userId = getUserIdFromToken();
        if (userId) {
          try {
            const bRes = await axiosClient.get(`/users/${userId}/behavior-summary`);
            setBehaviorSummary(bRes.data);
          } catch { /* henüz veri yoksa sessizce geç */ }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchProfile();
  }, []);

  const handlePersonalityChange = async (value) => {
    setChatPersonality(value);
    setPersonalitySaving(true);
    try {
      const userId = getUserIdFromToken();
      await axiosClient.patch(`/users/${userId}/chat-personality`, { chatPersonality: value });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Kişilik kaydedilemedi:", err);
    } finally {
      setPersonalitySaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleNudgeToggle = async () => {
    const newVal = !nudgeEnabled;
    setNudgeEnabled(newVal);
    try {
      const userId = getUserIdFromToken();
      await axiosClient.patch(`/users/${userId}/nudge-settings`, { nudgeEnabled: newVal });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Nudge kaydedilemedi:", err);
      setNudgeEnabled(!newVal); // rollback
    }
  };


  const getActiveDays = (dateString) => {
    if (!dateString) return 0;
    const start = new Date(dateString);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffTime = Math.abs(now - start);
    return Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  };

  const colors = [
    "bg-blue-500",
    "bg-emerald-500",
    "bg-amber-500",
    "bg-rose-500",
    "bg-purple-500",
  ];

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <MainLayout>
        <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-center h-96">
          <p className="text-slate-500 animate-pulse">
            Profil Bilgileri Getiriliyor...
          </p>
        </div>
      </MainLayout>
    );
  }

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-10">
        <section className="bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-800 rounded-[2.5rem] p-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center gap-10 relative overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
          <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-64 h-64 bg-indigo-600/5 blur-[120px] rounded-full"></div>

          <div className="relative">
            <div className="w-32 h-32 bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-600 to-cyan-400 rounded-3xl rotate-3 flex items-center justify-center text-5xl shadow-2xl transform hover:rotate-6 transition-transform">
              👤
            </div>
            <div className="absolute -bottom-2 -right-2 bg-slate-950 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-slate-800 font-black text-indigo-400 text-sm italic shadow-lg">
              LVL {Math.floor(profile?.generalLevel || 1)}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1 text-center md:text-left z-10">
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-black text-white tracking-tighter uppercase italic mb-1">
              {profile?.name} {profile?.surname}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">
              @{profile?.userName || "kullanici"} •{" "}
              <span className="text-indigo-400">
                {getActiveDays(profile?.createdAt)} Gündür Aktif
              </span>
            </p>

            <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center md:justify-start">
              <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/50 flex flex-col items-center min-w-[100px]">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-black uppercase tracking-widest">
                  TOPLAM XP
                </span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white">
                  {profile?.totalXP}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/50 flex flex-col items-center min-w-[100px]">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-black uppercase tracking-widest">
                  GÖREVLER
                </span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-400">
                  {profile?.completedTaskCount} Bitti
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/50 flex flex-col items-center min-w-[100px]">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-black uppercase tracking-widest">
                  ROZETLER
                </span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-400">
                  {profile?.earnedBadges?.length || 0} Kazanıldı
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
          <div className="bg-slate-900/40 p-8 rounded-[2rem] border border-slate-800 h-full flex flex-col">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-white mb-6 tracking-widest uppercase italic flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xl">📊</span> Yetenek İlerlemesi
            </h3>

            <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center min-h-[300px]">
              {profile?.categoryStats && profile.categoryStats.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="w-full h-full -ml-4">
                  <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
                    <RadarChart cx="50%" cy="50%" outerRadius="70%" data={profile.categoryStats.map(stat => ({
                      subject: stat.categoryName,
                      A: stat.level,
                      fullMark: Math.max(...profile.categoryStats.map(s => s.level)) + 5
                    }))}>
                      <PolarGrid stroke="#334155" />
                      <PolarAngleAxis dataKey="subject" tick={{ fill: '#94a3b8', fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 'bold' }} />
                      <PolarRadiusAxis angle={30} domain={[0, 'auto']} tick={false} axisLine={false} />
                      <Radar
                        name="Level"
                        dataKey="A"
                        stroke="#818cf8"
                        strokeWidth={2}
                        fill="#6366f1"
                        fillOpacity={0.5}
                      />
                      <Tooltip 
                        contentStyle={{ backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: '1px solid #1e293b', borderRadius: '0.75rem' }}
                        itemStyle={{ color: '#818cf8', fontWeight: 'bold' }}
                      />
                    </RadarChart>
                  </ResponsiveContainer>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="text-center opacity-50">
                  <p>Henüz kategori istatistiği oluşmadı.</p>
                  <p className="text-xs mt-2">Görev tamamladıkça burası dolacak.</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-900/40 p-8 rounded-[2rem] border border-slate-800 flex flex-col h-full">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-white mb-6 tracking-widest uppercase italic flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xl">🏆</span> Rozet Koleksiyonu
            </h3>

            {profile?.earnedBadges && profile.earnedBadges.length > 0 ? (

                    badge.iconPath && badge.iconPath.length < 5;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\pages\Register.jsx
==================================================

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate, Link } from "react-router-dom";
import authService from "../services/authService";

const Register = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: "",
    surname: "",
    username: "",
    email: "",
    password: "",
    passwordConfirm: "",
  });
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState("");
  const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState("");

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    setFormData({ ...formData, [e.target.name]: e.target.value });
    if (errors[e.target.name]) {
      setErrors({ ...errors, [e.target.name]: null });
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrors({});
    setServerError("");
    setSuccessMsg("");

    if (formData.password !== formData.passwordConfirm) {
      setErrors({ passwordConfirm: "Şifreler uyuşmuyor!" });
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await authService.register({
        name: formData.name,
        surname: formData.surname,
        username: formData.username,
        email: formData.email,
        password: formData.password,
        passwordConfirm: formData.passwordConfirm,
      });

      setSuccessMsg("🎉 Kayıt başarılı! Giriş sayfasına yönlendiriliyorsun.");
      setTimeout(() => navigate("/login"), 2000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      if (err.response?.data?.errors) {
        const newErrors = {};
        err.response.data.errors.forEach((errItem) => {
          const field = errItem.property.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + errItem.property.slice(1);
          newErrors[field] = errItem.error;
        });
        setErrors(newErrors);
      } else {
        setServerError(err.response?.data?.message || "Kayıt olunamadı.");
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const inputClass =
    "w-full bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:bg-slate-900 transition-all placeholder:text-slate-600";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center p-4 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-96 h-96 bg-indigo-600/20 blur-[120px] rounded-full"></div>
      <div className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-rose-600/10 blur-[120px] rounded-full"></div>

      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-800 p-8 rounded-[2rem] shadow-2xl relative z-10">
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-indigo-600 rounded-2xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-center text-3xl shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(79,70,229,0.5)] mb-4">
            🚀
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter uppercase">
            LifeQuest
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-2 font-medium">
            Maceraya Başlamak İçin Katıl
          </p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          {serverError && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 rounded-xl text-rose-500 text-xs font-bold text-center mb-4">
              {serverError}
            </div>
          )}
          {successMsg && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-xl text-emerald-500 text-xs font-bold text-center mb-4">
              {successMsg}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <input
                type="text"
                name="name"
                placeholder="Ad"
                required
                className={`${inputClass} ${errors.name ? "border-rose-500 focus:border-rose-500 focus:ring-rose-500/50" : ""}`}
                onChange={handleChange}
              />
              {errors.name && <p className="text-rose-500 text-xs mt-1 ml-1">{errors.name}</p>}
            </div>
            <div>
              <input
                type="text"
                name="surname"
                placeholder="Soyad"
                required
                className={`${inputClass} ${errors.surname ? "border-rose-500 focus:border-rose-500 focus:ring-rose-500/50" : ""}`}
                onChange={handleChange}
              />
              {errors.surname && <p className="text-rose-500 text-xs mt-1 ml-1">{errors.surname}</p>}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <input
              type="text"
              name="username"
              placeholder="Kullanıcı Adı"
              required
              className={`${inputClass} ${errors.username ? "border-rose-500 focus:border-rose-500 focus:ring-rose-500/50" : ""}`}
              onChange={handleChange}
            />
            {errors.username && <p className="text-rose-500 text-xs mt-1 ml-1">{errors.username}</p>}
          </div>

          <div>
            <input
              type="email"
              name="email"
              placeholder="E-Posta Adresi"
              required
              className={`${inputClass} ${errors.email ? "border-rose-500 focus:border-rose-500 focus:ring-rose-500/50" : ""}`}
              onChange={handleChange}
            />
            {errors.email && <p className="text-rose-500 text-xs mt-1 ml-1">{errors.email}</p>}
          </div>

          <div>
            <input
              type="password"
              name="password"
              placeholder="Şifre"
              required
              className={`${inputClass} ${errors.password ? "border-rose-500 focus:border-rose-500 focus:ring-rose-500/50" : ""}`}
              onChange={handleChange}
            />
            {errors.password && <p className="text-rose-500 text-xs mt-1 ml-1">{errors.password}</p>}
          </div>

          <div>
            <input
              type="password"
              name="passwordConfirm"
              placeholder="Şifre Tekrar"
              required
              className={`${inputClass} ${errors.passwordConfirm ? "border-rose-500 focus:border-rose-500 focus:ring-rose-500/50" : ""}`}
              onChange={handleChange}
            />
            {errors.passwordConfirm && <p className="text-rose-500 text-xs mt-1 ml-1">{errors.passwordConfirm}</p>}
          </div>

          <button
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black py-4 rounded-xl uppercase tracking-widest shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/20 transition-all active:scale-[0.98] mt-4"
          >
            {loading ? "KAYDEDİLİYOR..." : "KAYIT OL"}
          </button>
        </form>

        <div className="mt-6 text-center">
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm">
            Zaten hesabın var mı?{" "}
            <Link
              to="/login"
              className="text-indigo-400 font-bold hover:text-indigo-300 underline decoration-2 underline-offset-4"
            >
              Giriş Yap
            </Link>
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Register;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\pages\ReportsPage.jsx
==================================================

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import MainLayout from '../layouts/MainLayout';
import reportService from '../services/reportService';
import { AreaChart, Area, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, CartesianGrid } from 'recharts';
import BehaviorInsightCard from '../components/BehaviorInsightCard';
import axiosClient from '../api/axiosClient';
import { getUserIdFromToken } from '../utils/authUtils';

const ReportsPage = () => {
  const [reports, setReports] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [behaviorSummary, setBehaviorSummary] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchReports = async () => {
        try {
            const data = await reportService.getReports();
            
            // Recharts için veriyi ters çevirip formatla (eski → yeni)
            const formattedData = [...data].reverse().map(r => ({
                name: new Date(r.weekEndDate).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' }),
                XPKazanci: r.totalXPEarned,
                Tamamlanan: r.tasksCompleted
            }));
            
            setReports(formattedData);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Raporlar alınamadı:", error);
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    };

    const fetchBehavior = async () => {
      const userId = getUserIdFromToken();
      if (!userId) return;
      try {
        const res = await axiosClient.get(`/users/${userId}/behavior-summary`);
        setBehaviorSummary(res.data);
      } catch (err) { }
    };

    fetchReports();
    fetchBehavior();
  }, []);

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="space-y-8">
        <section className="relative">
            <div className="absolute -left-10 -top-10 w-40 h-40 bg-fuchsia-600/10 blur-[80px] rounded-full"></div>
            <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2 relative z-10">RAPORLAR</h2>
            <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-fuchsia-600 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(192,38,211,0.6)]"></div>
        </section>

        {loading ? (
            <p className="text-slate-400">Raporlar yükleniyor...</p>
        ) : reports.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="bg-slate-900/50 p-10 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl text-center text-slate-400">
                Henüz yeterli veri yok. Raporların her hafta sonu oluşturulacak.
            </div>
        ) : (
            <div className="space-y-8">
                {/* SP-04: Adaptif Davranış Analizi */}
                {behaviorSummary && (
                   <BehaviorInsightCard summary={behaviorSummary} />
                )}

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
                    {/* XP Grafiği */}
                <div className="bg-slate-900/40 border border-slate-800 p-6 rounded-3xl shadow-xl">
                    <h3 className="text-slate-300 font-bold mb-6 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="w-2 h-2 bg-fuchsia-500 rounded-full"></span> 
                        Haftalık XP Gelişimi
                    </h3>
                    <div className="h-64">
                         <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                            <AreaChart data={reports}>
                                <defs>
                                    <linearGradient id="colorXp" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                                        <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#c026d3" stopOpacity={0.8}/>
                                        <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#c026d3" stopOpacity={0}/>
                                    </linearGradient>
                                </defs>
                                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#1e293b" vertical={false} />
                                <XAxis dataKey="name" stroke="#64748b" fontSize={12} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} />
                                <YAxis stroke="#64748b" fontSize={12} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} />
                                <Tooltip 
                                    contentStyle={{ backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: 'none', borderRadius: '8px', color: '#fff' }}
                                    itemStyle={{ color: '#c026d3' }}
                                />
                                <Area type="monotone" dataKey="XPKazanci" stroke="#c026d3" strokeWidth={3} fillOpacity={1} fill="url(#colorXp)" />
                            </AreaChart>
                        </ResponsiveContainer>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* Görev Başarı Grafiği */}
                <div className="bg-slate-900/40 border border-slate-800 p-6 rounded-3xl shadow-xl">
                    <h3 className="text-slate-300 font-bold mb-6 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="w-2 h-2 bg-emerald-500 rounded-full"></span> 
                        Tamamlanan Görevler
                    </h3>
                    <div className="h-64">
                         <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                            <AreaChart data={reports}>
                                <defs>
                                    <linearGradient id="colorTasks" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                                        <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#10b981" stopOpacity={0.8}/>
                                        <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#10b981" stopOpacity={0}/>
                                    </linearGradient>
                                </defs>
                                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#1e293b" vertical={false} />
                                <XAxis dataKey="name" stroke="#64748b" fontSize={12} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} />
                                <YAxis stroke="#64748b" fontSize={12} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} />
                                <Tooltip 
                                    contentStyle={{ backgroundColor: '#0f172a', border: 'none', borderRadius: '8px', color: '#fff' }}
                                    itemStyle={{ color: '#10b981' }}
                                />
                                <Area type="monotone" dataKey="Tamamlanan" stroke="#10b981" strokeWidth={3} fillOpacity={1} fill="url(#colorTasks)" />
                            </AreaChart>
                        </ResponsiveContainer>
                    </div>
                </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default ReportsPage;


==================================================
DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\pages\SocialPage.jsx
==================================================

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import MainLayout from '../layouts/MainLayout';
import socialService from '../services/socialService';
import ChallengeCard from '../components/ChallengeCard';
import { challengeService } from '../services/challengeService';

const tabs = ['Arkadaşlarım', 'İstekler', 'Mücadeleler', 'Kullanıcı Ara'];
const CHALLENGE_STATUS_TABS = ['active', 'invited', 'completed'];

const SocialPage = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(0);
  const [challengeStatus, setChallengeStatus] = useState('active');
  const [friends, setFriends] = useState([]);
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState([]);
  const [challenges, setChallenges] = useState([]);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);
  const [searching, setSearching] = useState(false);
  const [showChallengeModal, setShowChallengeModal] = useState(false);
  const [challengeTarget, setChallengeTarget] = useState(null);
  const [challengeForm, setChallengeForm] = useState({
    title: '',
    challengeType: 'TaskCount',
    targetValue: 10,
    durationDays: 7,
    winnerXPBonus: 200,
    challengerMessage: '',
  });


  const showToast = (message, type = 'success') => {
    setToast({ message, type });
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500);
  };

  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [friendsData, requestsData] = await Promise.all([
        socialService.getFriends(),
        socialService.getFriendRequests(),
      ]);
      setFriends(friendsData);
      setRequests(requestsData);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const fetchChallenges = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const result = await challengeService.getActiveChallenges(challengeStatus);
      setChallenges(result?.challenges || result || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  }, [challengeStatus]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
  }, [fetchData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab === 2) fetchChallenges();
  }, [fetchChallenges, activeTab, challengeStatus]);

  const handleSearch = async () => {
    if (searchQuery.length < 2) return;
    setSearching(true);
    try {
      const results = await socialService.searchUsers(searchQuery);
      setSearchResults(results);
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('Arama sırasında hata oluştu.', 'error');
    } finally {
      setSearching(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSendRequest = async (userId) => {
    try {
      await socialService.sendFriendRequest(userId);
      showToast('Arkadaşlık isteği gönderildi! 🤝');
      setSearchResults(prev => prev.filter(u => u.id !== userId));
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || 'İstek gönderilemedi.', 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleAccept = async (requestId) => {
    try {
      await socialService.acceptFriendRequest(requestId);
      showToast('Arkadaşlık isteği kabul edildi! 🎉');
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('İşlem başarısız.', 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleReject = async (requestId) => {
    try {
      await socialService.rejectFriendRequest(requestId);
      showToast('İstek reddedildi.');
      setRequests(prev => prev.filter(r => r.requestId !== requestId));
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('İşlem başarısız.', 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveFriend = async (friendshipId) => {
    if (!confirm('Bu arkadaşlığı sonlandırmak istediğine emin misin?')) return;
    try {
      await socialService.removeFriend(friendshipId);
      showToast('Arkadaşlık sonlandırıldı.');
      setFriends(prev => prev.filter(f => f.friendshipId !== friendshipId));
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('İşlem başarısız.', 'error');
    }
  };

  const openChallengeModal = (friend) => {
    setChallengeTarget(friend);
    setShowChallengeModal(true);
  };

  const handleCreateChallenge = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await challengeService.sendInvite({
        opponentId: challengeTarget.friendId,
        title: challengeForm.title,
        challengeType: challengeForm.challengeType,
        targetValue: challengeForm.targetValue,
        durationDays: challengeForm.durationDays,
        winnerXPBonus: challengeForm.winnerXPBonus,
        challengerMessage: challengeForm.challengerMessage,
      });
      showToast(`${challengeTarget.name}'e mücadele daveti gönderildi! ⚔️`);
      setShowChallengeModal(false);
      fetchChallenges();
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || 'Mücadele oluşturulamadı.', 'error');
    }
  };

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      {/* Toast */}
      {toast && (
        <div className={`fixed top-6 right-6 z-50 px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl font-bold text-sm shadow-2xl ${
          toast.type === 'success' ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-rose-600 text-white'
        }`}>
          {toast.message}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <section className="relative">
          <div className="absolute -left-10 -top-10 w-40 h-40 bg-violet-600/10 blur-[80px] rounded-full"></div>
          <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2 relative z-10">SOSYAL</h2>
          <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-violet-600 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(124,58,237,0.6)]"></div>
          <div className="flex gap-4 mt-4 flex-wrap">
            <div className="bg-slate-900/60 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
              <p className="text-2xl font-black text-white">{friends.length}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">Arkadaş</p>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-900/60 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/20 text-center">
              <p className="text-2xl font-black text-amber-400">{requests.length}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">Bekleyen İstek</p>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-900/60 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-500/20 text-center">
              <p className="text-2xl font-black text-rose-400">{challenges.filter(c => c.status === 'Active').length}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">Aktif Mücadele</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
          {tabs.map((tab, i) => (
            <button
              key={tab}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(i)}
              className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${
                activeTab === i
                  ? 'bg-violet-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-violet-500/30'
                  : 'bg-slate-900/60 text-slate-400 hover:text-white border border-slate-800'
              }`}
            >
              {tab}
              {i === 1 && requests.length > 0 && (
                <span className="ml-1.5 bg-amber-500 text-black text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-black">
                  {requests.length}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content */}
        {loading ? (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {[1, 2, 3].map(i => (
              <div key={i} className="h-24 bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl animate-pulse border border-slate-800"></div>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* ARKADAŞLARIM */}
            {activeTab === 0 && (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {friends.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="col-span-2 bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-700 p-12 text-center">
                    <p className="text-4xl mb-4">🤝</p>
                    <p className="text-slate-400 font-bold">Henüz arkadaşın yok.</p>
                    <p className="text-slate-600 text-sm mt-1">Kullanıcı Ara sekmesinden arkadaş ekleyebilirsin!</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  friends.map((f) => (
                    <div key={f.friendshipId} className="bg-slate-900/60 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 hover:border-violet-500/40 transition-colors group flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-600 to-indigo-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-black text-white text-lg shadow-lg">
                          {f.name.charAt(0)}{f.surname.charAt(0)}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-white font-bold">{f.name} {f.surname}</p>
                          <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{f.userName}</p>
                          <div className="flex gap-2 mt-1">
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-400 font-bold">Lv. {f.level}</span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-600">•</span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 font-bold">{f.totalXP?.toLocaleString()} XP</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex gap-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => openChallengeModal(f)}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-black rounded-lg bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-500 hover:text-white transition-all uppercase"
                        >
                          ⚔️ Mücadele
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleRemoveFriend(f.friendshipId)}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-black rounded-lg bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all uppercase"
                        >
                          Çıkar
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* BEKLEYEN İSTEKLER */}
            {activeTab === 1 && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {requests.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-700 p-12 text-center">
                    <p className="text-4xl mb-4">📬</p>
                    <p className="text-slate-400 font-bold">Bekleyen istek yok.</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  requests.map((r) => (
                    <div key={r.requestId} className="bg-slate-900/60 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-amber-500/20 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-500 to-orange-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-black text-white text-lg">
                          {r.requesterName.charAt(0)}{r.requesterSurname.charAt(0)}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-white font-bold">{r.requesterName} {r.requesterSurname}</p>
                          <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{r.requesterUserName} • Lv. {r.requesterLevel}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleAccept(r.requestId)}
                          className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-black rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-500 transition-all uppercase shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20"
                        >
                          Kabul
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleReject(r.requestId)}
                          className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-black rounded-xl bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all uppercase"
                        >
                          Reddet
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* SP-05: MÜCADELELER */}
            {activeTab === 2 && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {/* Status filter */}
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  {[['active','Aktif'],['invited','Davetler'],['completed','Tamamlanan']].map(([s, l]) => (
                    <button key={s}
                      onClick={() => { setChallengeStatus(s); }}
                      className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition-all ${
                        challengeStatus === s
                          ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white shadow-lg'
                          : 'bg-slate-900/60 text-slate-400 border border-slate-800 hover:text-white'
                      }`}>
                      {l}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>

                {challenges.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-700 p-12 text-center">
                    <p className="text-4xl mb-4">⚔️</p>
                    <p className="text-slate-400 font-bold">Henüz {challengeStatus === 'invited' ? 'bekleyen davet' : challengeStatus === 'completed' ? 'tamamlanan mücadele' : 'aktif mücadele'} yok.</p>
                    {challengeStatus === 'active' && <p className="text-slate-600 text-sm mt-1">Arkadaşlarına mücadele daveti gönder!</p>}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    {challenges.map(c => (
                      <ChallengeCard key={c.id} challenge={c} onUpdate={fetchChallenges} />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* KULLANICI ARA */}
            {activeTab === 3 && (
              <div className="space-y-6">
                <div className="flex gap-3">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={searchQuery}
                    onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSearch()}
                    placeholder="İsim veya kullanıcı adı ara..."
                    className="flex-1 bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-slate-200 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-violet-500 transition-colors placeholder:text-slate-600"
                  />
                  <button
                    onClick={handleSearch}
                    disabled={searching || searchQuery.length < 2}
                    className="px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-500 text-white font-bold text-sm transition-all disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                  >
                    {searching ? '...' : '🔍 Ara'}
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {searchResults.map((user) => (
                    <div key={user.id} className="bg-slate-900/60 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 hover:border-violet-500/30 transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-600 to-indigo-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-black text-white">
                          {user.name.charAt(0)}{user.surname.charAt(0)}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-white font-bold text-sm">{user.name} {user.surname}</p>
                          <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{user.userName} • Lv. {user.level}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleSendRequest(user.id)}
                        className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-violet-600/20 text-violet-400 hover:bg-violet-600 hover:text-white text-xs font-black transition-all uppercase"
                      >
                        + Arkadaş Ekle
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}

                  {searchResults.length === 0 && searchQuery.length >= 2 && !searching && (
                    <p className="text-slate-500 text-center py-8">Kullanıcı bulunamadı.</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* SP-05: Mücadele Modal */}
      {showChallengeModal && challengeTarget && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-8 w-full max-w-md shadow-2xl">
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-1">⚔️ Mücadele Başlat</h3>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mb-6">
              <span className="text-violet-400 font-bold">{challengeTarget.name} {challengeTarget.surname}</span>'e mücadele daveti
            </p>
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateChallenge} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Mücadele Adı *</label>
                <input required type="text" className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-xl text-white p-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500"
                  value={challengeForm.title} onChange={e => setChallengeForm({ ...challengeForm, title: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Örn: Haftalık Görev Mücadelesi" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Mücadele Tipi</label>
                <select className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-xl text-white p-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500"
                  value={challengeForm.challengeType}
                  onChange={e => setChallengeForm({ ...challengeForm, challengeType: e.target.value })}>
                  <option value="TaskCount">📋 Görev Sayısı</option>
                  <option value="XPRace">⭐ XP Yarışı</option>
                  <option value="StreakBattle">🔥 Seri Mücadelesi</option>
                  <option value="CategoryFocus">🎯 Kategori Odağı</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-4">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Hedef Sayı</label>
                  <input type="number" min="1" max="500" className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-xl text-white p-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500"
                    value={challengeForm.targetValue}
                    onChange={e => setChallengeForm({ ...challengeForm, targetValue: parseInt(e.target.value) })} />
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Süre (Gün)</label>
                  <input type="number" min="1" max="90" className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-xl text-white p-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500"
                    value={challengeForm.durationDays}
                    onChange={e => setChallengeForm({ ...challengeForm, durationDays: parseInt(e.target.value) })} />
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Ödül XP</label>
                  <input type="number" min="50" max="1000" step="50" className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-xl text-white p-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500"
                    value={challengeForm.winnerXPBonus}
                    onChange={e => setChallengeForm({ ...challengeForm, winnerXPBonus: parseInt(e.target.value) })} />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Mesaj (opsiyonel)</label>
                <input type="text" className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-xl text-white p-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500"
                  placeholder="Rakibe mesaj..."
                  value={challengeForm.challengerMessage}
                  onChange={e => setChallengeForm({ ...challengeForm, challengerMessage: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 mt-6">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowChallengeModal(false)} className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors text-sm">İptal</button>
                <button type="submit" className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-500 shadow-lg shadow-rose-900/50 text-sm transition-all">⚔️ Mücadele Başlat</button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

==================================================
DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\pages\TaskList.jsx
==================================================

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import MainLayout from "../layouts/MainLayout";
import TaskItem from "../components/TaskItem";
import taskService from "../services/taskService";
import categoryService from "../services/categoryService";

const TaskList = () => {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const currentCategoryName = searchParams.get("category");

  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState([]);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [requesting, setRequesting] = useState(false);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);

  const showToast = (message, type = "success") => {
    setToast({ message, type });
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchCategories = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await categoryService.getAllCategories();
        setCategories(Array.isArray(data) ? data : data?.categories || []);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
      }
    };
    fetchCategories();
  }, []);

  const fetchTasks = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const selectedCategory = categories.find((c) => c.name === currentCategoryName);
      const categoryId = selectedCategory ? selectedCategory.id : null;
      const data = await taskService.getAllTasks(categoryId);
      setTasks(Array.isArray(data) ? data : data?.tasks || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (categories.length > 0 || !currentCategoryName) {
      fetchTasks();
    }
  }, [currentCategoryName, categories]);

  const handleCategoryChange = (e) => {
    const selectedName = e.target.value;
    if (selectedName === "all") {
      setSearchParams({});
    } else {
      setSearchParams({ category: selectedName });
    }
  };

  const handleCompleteTask = async (taskId) => {
    try {
      const result = await taskService.completeTask(taskId);
      if (result.success) {
        setTasks((prevTasks) =>
          prevTasks.map((t) => (t.id === taskId ? { ...t, isCompleted: true } : t))
        );
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("userUpdated"));
        showToast(`🎉 Görev tamamlandı! +${result.earnedXp} XP kazandın!`, "success");
      } else {
        showToast(result.message || "Görev tamamlanamadı.", "error");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      showToast("Bir hata oluştu. Lütfen tekrar dene.", "error");
    }
  };

  const handleRequestNewQuests = async () => {
    setRequesting(true);
    try {
      const response = await taskService.requestNewQuests();
      if (response.success) {
        showToast(`✨ ${response.assignedCount} yeni görev eklendi!`, "success");
        fetchTasks();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || "Yeni görev alınamadı.", "error");
    } finally {
      setRequesting(false);
    }
  };

  const completedCount = tasks.filter((t) => t.isCompleted).length;
  const totalCount = tasks.length;
  const progress = totalCount > 0 ? Math.round((completedCount / totalCount) * 100) : 0;

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {toast && (
        <div className={`fixed top-6 right-6 z-50 px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl font-bold text-sm shadow-2xl transition-all animate-bounce ${
          toast.type === "success"
            ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-emerald-500/30"
            : "bg-rose-600 text-white shadow-rose-500/30"
        }`}>
          {toast.message}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-10">
        {/* Header */}
        <section className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-end gap-4">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2">
              GÖREVLER
            </h2>
            <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-indigo-600 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,70,229,0.5)]"></div>
            <p className="text-slate-500 mt-2 text-sm italic font-medium">
              {currentCategoryName
                ? `${currentCategoryName.toUpperCase()} KATEGORİSİ`
                : "TÜM GÖREVLERİN LİSTESİ"}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-4">
            <button
              onClick={handleRequestNewQuests}
              disabled={requesting}
              className="bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-indigo-600 hover:border-indigo-500 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              {requesting ? (
                <span className="animate-spin inline-block">↻</span>
              ) : (
                <span>✨ Yeni Görev İste</span>
              )}
            </button>

            <div className="relative">
              <select
                className="appearance-none bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-slate-300 text-sm rounded-xl py-3 pl-4 pr-10 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none cursor-pointer hover:border-slate-700 transition-colors"
                onChange={handleCategoryChange}
                value={currentCategoryName || "all"}
              >
                <option value="all">Tüm Kategoriler</option>
                {categories.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.name}>
                    {c.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <div className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none text-slate-500">▾</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Progress Bar */}
        {totalCount > 0 && !loading && (
          <div className="bg-slate-900/40 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2 uppercase tracking-wider">
              <span>Günlük İlerleme</span>
              <span className={progress === 100 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-indigo-400"}>
                {completedCount}/{totalCount} Görev — {progress}%
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-1000 ${
                  progress === 100
                    ? "bg-emerald-500 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)]"
                    : "bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-indigo-400"
                }`}
                style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Task List */}
        <div className="grid gap-4">
          {!loading ? (
            tasks.length > 0 ? (
              tasks.map((task) => (
                <TaskItem
                  key={task.id}
                  id={task.id}
                  title={task.title}
                  description={task.description}
                  xp={task.baseXP || task.xp}
                  difficulty={task.difficulty}
                  isCompleted={task.isCompleted}
                  onComplete={handleCompleteTask}
                />
              ))
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-16 border-2 border-slate-800/50 rounded-[2rem] bg-slate-900/20 border-dashed flex flex-col items-center gap-6">
                <div className="text-6xl">🎯</div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xl">Maceraya Hazır Mısın?</h3>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">
                    Şu an aktif bir görevin yok. Hemen yenilerini alabilirsin.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={handleRequestNewQuests}
                  disabled={requesting}
                  className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-2xl font-black uppercase tracking-widest shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/30 transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95"
                >
                  {requesting ? "Yükleniyor..." : "YENİ GÖREVLER GETİR"}
                </button>
              </div>
            )
          ) : (
            [1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
              <div
                key={i}
                className="h-20 bg-slate-900/50 rounded-2xl animate-pulse border border-slate-800"
              ></div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default TaskList;

import axios from "axios";

// Python AI Mikro Servis
const aiClient = axios.create({
  baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_AI_SERVICE_URL || "http://localhost:5001",
  headers: {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const aiService = {
  // Sağlık kontrolü
  healthCheck: async () => {
    const response = await aiClient.get("/health");
    return response.data;
  },

  // Chatbot — mesaj gönder
  chat: async (userId, message) => {
    const response = await aiClient.post("/api/chat", {
      user_id: userId,
      message: message,
    });
    return response.data;
  },

  // Yansıma metni doğrulama
  verifyReflection: async (text, minWordCount = 10, taskCategory = null) => {
    const response = await aiClient.post("/api/verify-reflection", {
      text,
      min_word_count: minWordCount,
      task_category: taskCategory,
    });
    return response.data;
  },

  // Görüntü doğrulama
  verifyImage: async (userId, taskId, taskCategory, imageBase64) => {
    const response = await aiClient.post("/api/verify-image", {
      user_id: userId,
      task_id: taskId,
      task_category: taskCategory,
      image_base64: imageBase64,
    });
    return response.data;
  },

  // Modelleri yeniden eğit (Admin)
  trainModels: async () => {
    const response = await aiClient.post("/api/train");
    return response.data;
  },
};

export default aiService;

import axiosClient from '../api/axiosClient';

const taskService = {
  getAllTasks: async (categoryId = null) => {
    const url = categoryId ? `/user-tasks?categoryId=${categoryId}` : '/user-tasks';
    const response = await axiosClient.get(url);
    return response.data.tasks || [];
  },

  completeTask: async (userTaskId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.patch(`/user-tasks/${userTaskId}/complete`);
    return response.data;
  },

  requestNewQuests: async () => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post('/user-tasks/request-new');
    return response.data;
  },

  assignSpecificTask: async (appTaskId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/assign/${appTaskId}`);
    return response.data;
  },

  createTask: async (taskData) => {
    return await axiosClient.post('/Tasks/create-task', taskData);
  },

  createBulkTasks: async (tasksArray) => {
    return await axiosClient.post('/Tasks/create-bulk-tasks', { tasks: tasksArray });
  },

  // ─── SP-01: Yeni Görev Aksiyonları ─────────────────────────────────────
  getDailyPool: async () => {
    const response = await axiosClient.get('/user-tasks/daily-pool');
    return response.data;
  },

  selectTask: async (taskId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${taskId}/select`);
    return response.data;
  },

  postponeTask: async (taskId, postponeTo, reason) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${taskId}/postpone`, {
      postponeTo,
      reason
    });
    return response.data;
  },

  pauseTask: async (taskId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${taskId}/pause`);
    return response.data;
  },

  resumeTask: async (taskId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${taskId}/resume`);
    return response.data;
  },

  abandonTask: async (taskId, reason) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${taskId}/abandon`, {
      reason
    });
    return response.data;
  }
};

export default taskService;

import axiosClient from "../api/axiosClient";

const userService = {

    return response.data;
  },

    return response.data;

};

export const getUserIdFromToken = () => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem("token");
  if (!token) return null;

  try {
    const base64Url = token.split(".")[1];
    const base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    const jsonPayload = decodeURIComponent(
      window
        .atob(base64)
        .split("")
        .map((c) => "%" + ("00" + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2))
        .join("")
    );
    const decoded = JSON.parse(jsonPayload);

    return decoded.nameid || decoded.sub || decoded.unique_name || null;
  } catch (error) {
    return null;
  }
};

export const getUserNameFromToken = () => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem("token");
  if (!token) return null;

  try {
    const base64Url = token.split(".")[1];
    const base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    const jsonPayload = decodeURIComponent(
      window
        .atob(base64)
        .split("")
        .map((c) => "%" + ("00" + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2))
        .join("")
    );
    const decoded = JSON.parse(jsonPayload);

    return (
      decoded.unique_name ||
      decoded.name ||
      decoded.email ||
      "Bilinmeyen Kullanıcı"
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return null;
  }
};

export const getUserRoleFromToken = () => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem("token");
  if (!token) return null;

  try {
    const base64Url = token.split(".")[1];
    const base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    const jsonPayload = decodeURIComponent(
      window
        .atob(base64)
        .split("")
        .map((c) => "%" + ("00" + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2))
        .join("")
    );
    const decoded = JSON.parse(jsonPayload);

    return (
      decoded["http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2008/06/identity/claims/role"] ||
      decoded.role ||
      null
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return null;
  }
};

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FluentValidation;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Behaviors;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application;

public static class ServiceRegistration
{
    public static void AddApplicationServices(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        services.AddMediatR(conf =>
        {
            conf.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(ServiceRegistration).Assembly);
        });
        services.AddValidatorsFromAssembly(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly());
        services.AddTransient(typeof(IPipelineBehavior<,>), typeof(ValidationBehavior<,>));
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Behaviors\ValidationBehavior.cs
==================================================

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FluentValidation;
using MediatR;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Behaviors;

public sealed class ValidationBehavior<TRequest, TResponse> : IPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>
        where TRequest : IRequest<TResponse>
{
    private readonly IEnumerable<IValidator<TRequest>> _validators;

    public ValidationBehavior(IEnumerable<IValidator<TRequest>> validators)
    {
        _validators = validators;
    }

    public async Task<TResponse> Handle(TRequest request, RequestHandlerDelegate<TResponse> next, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (!_validators.Any())
            return await next();

        var context = new ValidationContext<TRequest>(request);

        var validationResults = await Task.WhenAll(
            _validators.Select(v => v.ValidateAsync(context, cancellationToken)));

        var failures = validationResults
            .SelectMany(r => r.Errors)
            .Where(f => f != null)
            .ToList();

        if (failures.Count != 0)
            throw new ValidationException(failures);

        return await next();
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Common\Security\HashingHelper.cs
==================================================

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Common.Security;

public static class HashingHelper
{
    public static void CreatePasswordHash(string password, out byte[] passwordHash, out byte[] passwordSalt)
    {
        using var hmac = new HMACSHA512();
        passwordSalt = hmac.Key;
        passwordHash = hmac.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(password));
    }

    public static bool VerifyPasswordHash(string password, byte[] passwordHash, byte[] passwordSalt)
    {
        using var hmac = new HMACSHA512(passwordSalt);
        var computedHash = hmac.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(password));

        return computedHash.SequenceEqual(passwordHash);
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Token;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Common.Security;
