using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Auth.Commands.Login;

public sealed class LoginUserCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<LoginUserCommandRequest, LoginUserCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly ITokenService _tokenService;

    public LoginUserCommandHandler(IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository, ITokenService tokenService)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _tokenService = tokenService;
    }

    public async Task<LoginUserCommandResponse> Handle(LoginUserCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetAll(tracking: false)
                                     .Include(u => u.AppRole)
                                     .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == request.Email, cancellationToken);

        if (user == null)
            throw new Exception("Kullanıcı adı veya şifre hatalı.");

        if (!HashingHelper.VerifyPasswordHash(request.Password, user.PasswordHash, user.PasswordSalt))
            throw new Exception("Kullanıcı adı veya şifre hatalı.");

        string token = _tokenService.CreateToken(user);

        return new LoginUserCommandResponse
        {
            Token = token
        };
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\Auth\Commands\Register\RegisterUserCommandHandler.cs
==================================================

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Common.Security;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using MediatR;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Auth.Commands.Register;

public sealed class RegisterUserCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<RegisterUserCommandRequest, RegisterUserCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppRoleReadRepository _roleReadRepository;

    public RegisterUserCommandHandler(IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository, IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository, IAppRoleReadRepository roleReadRepository)
    {
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _roleReadRepository = roleReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<RegisterUserCommandResponse> Handle(RegisterUserCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var existingUser = await _userReadRepository.GetSingleAsync(u => u.Email == request.Email, tracking: false);
        if (existingUser != null)
            throw new Exception("Bu email adresi zaten kullanılıyor.");

        HashingHelper.CreatePasswordHash(request.Password, out byte[] passwordHash, out byte[] passwordSalt);

        var newUser = new AppUser
        {
            Name = request.Name,
            Surname = request.Surname,
            UserName = request.UserName,
            Email = request.Email,
            PasswordHash = passwordHash,
            PasswordSalt = passwordSalt,
            TotalXP = 0,
            GeneralLevel = 1,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        var defaultRole = await _roleReadRepository.GetSingleAsync(r => r.Name == "User", tracking: false);

        if (defaultRole != null)
        {
            newUser.AppRoleId = defaultRole.Id;
        }
        else
        {
            newUser.AppRole = new AppRole { Name = "User" };
        }

        await _userWriteRepository.AddAsync(newUser);
        await _userWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new RegisterUserCommandResponse
        {
            IsSuccess = true,
            Message = "Kullanıcı başarıyla oluşturuldu. Giriş yapabilirsiniz."
        };
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using MediatR;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Badges.Commands.CreateBulkBadges;

public sealed class CreateBulkBadgesCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateBulkBadgesCommandRequest, CreateBulkBadgesCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IBadgeWriteRepository _badgeWriteRepository;

    public CreateBulkBadgesCommandHandler(IBadgeWriteRepository badgeWriteRepository)
    {
        _badgeWriteRepository = badgeWriteRepository;
    }

    public async Task<CreateBulkBadgesCommandResponse> Handle(CreateBulkBadgesCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var badgesToAdd = new List<Badge>();

        foreach (var dto in request.Badges)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dto.Name))
                throw new Exception("HATA: Rozet listesindeki öğelerden birinin adı boş!");

            badgesToAdd.Add(new Badge
            {
                Name = dto.Name,
                Description = dto.Description,
                IconPath = string.IsNullOrEmpty(dto.IconPath) ? "default_badge.png" : dto.IconPath,
                RequiredLevel = dto.RequiredLevel,
                CategoryId = dto.CategoryId == Guid.Empty ? null : dto.CategoryId,
            });
        }

        await _badgeWriteRepository.AddRangeAsync(badgesToAdd);
        await _badgeWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new CreateBulkBadgesCommandResponse
        {
            IsSuccess = true,
            Message = $"{badgesToAdd.Count} adet rozet başarıyla eklendi.",
            AddedCount = badgesToAdd.Count
        };
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Categories.Queries.GetAllCategories;

public sealed class GetAllCategoriesQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetAllCategoriesQueryRequest, GetAllCategoriesQueryResponse>
{
    private readonly ICategoryReadRepository _categoryReadRepository;

    public GetAllCategoriesQueryHandler(ICategoryReadRepository categoryReadRepository)
    {
        _categoryReadRepository = categoryReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<GetAllCategoriesQueryResponse> Handle(GetAllCategoriesQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var categories = await _categoryReadRepository.GetAll(tracking: false)
            .Include(c => c.Tasks)
            .Select(c => new CategoryDto
            {
                Id = c.Id,
                Name = c.Name,
                Description = c.Description,
                IconPath = c.IconPath,
                TaskCount = c.Tasks.Count(t => t.IsActive)
            })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        return new GetAllCategoriesQueryResponse
        {
            Categories = categories
        };
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\Chat\Commands\ProcessChatAction\ProcessChatActionCommand.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.PostponeTask;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.PauseResumeTask;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Chat.Commands.ProcessChatAction;

public class ProcessChatActionCommandRequest : IRequest<ChatActionResultDto>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid? MessageId { get; set; }
    public string ActionType { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public Guid? TaskId { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, string>? Payload { get; set; }
}

public sealed class ProcessChatActionCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<ProcessChatActionCommandRequest, ChatActionResultDto>
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;
    private readonly IChatBotMessageWriteRepository _chatWriteRepository;
    private readonly IChatBotMessageReadRepository _chatReadRepository;

    public ProcessChatActionCommandHandler(
        IMediator mediator,
        IChatBotMessageWriteRepository chatWriteRepository,
        IChatBotMessageReadRepository chatReadRepository)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
        _chatWriteRepository = chatWriteRepository;
        _chatReadRepository = chatReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<ChatActionResultDto> Handle(
        ProcessChatActionCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            string resultMessage;

            switch (request.ActionType)
            {
                case "postpone_task":
                    if (!request.TaskId.HasValue)
                        return Fail("Görev ID eksik.");

                    var tomorrow = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(1));
                    await _mediator.Send(new PostponeTaskCommandRequest
                    {
                        UserId = request.UserId,
                        UserTaskId = request.TaskId.Value,
                        PostponeTo = tomorrow,
                        SkipReason = "Chatbot üzerinden ertelendi"
                    }, cancellationToken);
                    resultMessage = "✅ Görev yarına ertelendi (%70 XP).";
                    break;

                case "pause_task":
                    if (!request.TaskId.HasValue)
                        return Fail("Görev ID eksik.");
                    await _mediator.Send(new PauseTaskCommandRequest
                    {
                        UserId = request.UserId,
                        UserTaskId = request.TaskId.Value
                    }, cancellationToken);
                    resultMessage = "⏸️ Görev duraklatıldı.";
                    break;

                case "resume_task":
                    if (!request.TaskId.HasValue)
                        return Fail("Görev ID eksik.");
                    await _mediator.Send(new ResumeTaskCommandRequest
                    {
                        UserId = request.UserId,
                        UserTaskId = request.TaskId.Value
                    }, cancellationToken);
                    resultMessage = "▶️ Görev devam ediyor.";
                    break;

                case "activate_light_mode":
                    resultMessage = "💡 Hafif mod aktif! Sana en kolay görevi önerdim.";
                    break;

                default:
                    return Fail($"Bilinmeyen aksiyon: {request.ActionType}");
            }

            // Mesajı güncelle (ActionSelected)
            if (request.MessageId.HasValue)
            {
                var msg = await _chatReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(
                    request.MessageId.Value.ToString(), tracking: true);
                if (msg != null)
                {
                    msg.ActionSelected = request.ActionType;
                    msg.ActionTaken = request.TaskId.HasValue
                        ? $"{request.ActionType}:{request.TaskId}"
                        : request.ActionType;
                    msg.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    await _chatWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
                }
            }

            return new ChatActionResultDto
            {
                Success = true,
                Message = resultMessage,
                ActionType = request.ActionType,
                AffectedTaskId = request.TaskId
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return Fail($"Aksiyon işlenirken hata: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    private static ChatActionResultDto Fail(string msg) => new()
    {
        Success = false,
        Message = msg
    };
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\Chat\Commands\SendMessage\SendMessageCommandHandler.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.AI;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Chat.Commands.SendMessage;

public sealed class SendMessageCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<SendMessageCommandRequest, SendMessageCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IAIChatService _aiChatService;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppTaskReadRepository _appTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserDailyMoodReadRepository _moodReadRepository;
    private readonly IChatBotMessageWriteRepository _chatWriteRepository;

    public SendMessageCommandHandler(
        IAIChatService aiChatService,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IAppTaskReadRepository appTaskReadRepository,
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IUserDailyMoodReadRepository moodReadRepository,
        IChatBotMessageWriteRepository chatWriteRepository)
    {
        _aiChatService = aiChatService;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _appTaskReadRepository = appTaskReadRepository;
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _moodReadRepository = moodReadRepository;
        _chatWriteRepository = chatWriteRepository;
    }

    public async Task<SendMessageCommandResponse> Handle(
        SendMessageCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Message))
            return new SendMessageCommandResponse { Success = false, Response = "Mesaj boş olamaz." };

        // ── Bağlam toplama ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString());
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);

        var todayTasks = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask).ThenInclude(t => t!.Category)
            .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId
                && (ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Suggested
                    || ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Selected
                    || ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.InProgress
                    || ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Paused))
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var completedToday = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
            .CountAsync(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId
                && ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed
                && ut.CompletedAt.HasValue
                && DateOnly.FromDateTime(ut.CompletedAt.Value) == today, cancellationToken);

        var todayMood = await _moodReadRepository
            .GetWhere(m => m.AppUserId == request.UserId && m.Date == today, tracking: false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        var context = new ChatContextDto
        {
            UserName = user?.Name ?? "Kullanıcı",
            Personality = user?.ChatPersonality ?? "friendly",
            TodayTasks = todayTasks.Select(ut => new TaskContextDto
            {
                Id = ut.Id,
                Title = ut.AppTask?.Title ?? string.Empty,
                Status = ut.Status.ToString(),
                Category = ut.AppTask?.Category?.Name ?? string.Empty,
                EstimatedMinutes = ut.AppTask?.EstimatedMinutes
            }).ToList(),
            CompletedToday = completedToday,
            CurrentStreak = 0,
            TotalXP = user?.TotalXP ?? 0,
            TodayMood = todayMood?.MoodMode.ToString(),
            AvailableMinutes = todayMood?.AvailableMinutes ?? 30
        };

        // ── AI Servisi çağır ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        var aiResult = await _aiChatService.ProcessMessageWithContextAsync(
            request.UserId, request.Message, context);

        // ── Mesajı kaydet ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
        var chatMessage = new ChatBotMessage
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            AppUserId = request.UserId,
            Content = request.Message,
            SenderType = SenderType.User,
            Intent = aiResult.Intent,
            IntentConfidence = aiResult.IntentConfidence,
            Sentiment = aiResult.Sentiment,
            SentimentConfidence = aiResult.SentimentConfidence,
            UrgencyLevel = aiResult.UrgencyLevel,
            ActionsOfferedJson = aiResult.Actions.Select(a => a.Type).ToList(),
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        await _chatWriteRepository.AddAsync(chatMessage);
        await _chatWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        // ── Öneri intent'i (eski davranış korunuyor) ──────────────────────
        if (aiResult.Intent is "oneri" or "oneri_iste" && aiResult.SuggestedTasks == null)
        {
            var userTaskIds = todayTasks.Select(ut => ut.AppTaskId).ToList();
            var userLevel = user != null ? user.GeneralLevel : 1.0;
            var suggestedTask = await _appTaskReadRepository.Table
                .Where(t => t.IsActive && t.MinLevel <= userLevel && !userTaskIds.Contains(t.Id))
                .OrderBy(_ => Guid.NewGuid())
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

            if (suggestedTask != null)
            {
                return new SendMessageCommandResponse
                {
                    Success = true,
                    Intent = aiResult.Intent,
                    Confidence = aiResult.IntentConfidence,
                    Response = $"Sana çok güzel bir görev buldum: '{suggestedTask.Title}'\n\nBu görev seviyene çok uygun. Aşağıdaki butona tıklayarak hemen listene ekleyebilirsin!",
                    Sentiment = aiResult.Sentiment,
                    SentimentConfidence = aiResult.SentimentConfidence,
                    UrgencyLevel = aiResult.UrgencyLevel,
                    Suggestions = aiResult.Suggestions,
                    Actions = aiResult.Actions,
                    SuggestedTaskId = suggestedTask.Id,
                    SuggestedTaskTitle = suggestedTask.Title,
                    SuggestedTaskXp = suggestedTask.BaseXP,
                    SuggestedTaskDifficulty = suggestedTask.Difficulty.ToString()
                };
            }
        }

        return new SendMessageCommandResponse
        {
            Success = true,
            Intent = aiResult.Intent,
            Confidence = aiResult.IntentConfidence,
            Response = aiResult.Response,
            Sentiment = aiResult.Sentiment,
            SentimentConfidence = aiResult.SentimentConfidence,
            UrgencyLevel = aiResult.UrgencyLevel,
            Suggestions = aiResult.Suggestions,
            Actions = aiResult.Actions,
            SuggestedTasks = aiResult.SuggestedTasks,
            ShouldShowMoodSelector = aiResult.ShouldShowMoodSelector
        };
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Goals.Commands.UpdateGoalProgress;

public class UpdateGoalProgressCommandRequest : IRequest<UpdateGoalProgressCommandResponse>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid GoalId { get; set; }
    public int IncrementBy { get; set; } = 1;
    public string? Note { get; set; }
}

public class UpdateGoalProgressCommandResponse
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int CurrentValue { get; set; }
    public int TargetValue { get; set; }
    public bool IsCompleted { get; set; }
    public int? EarnedXp { get; set; }
}

public sealed class UpdateGoalProgressCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<UpdateGoalProgressCommandRequest, UpdateGoalProgressCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserGoalReadRepository _goalReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserGoalWriteRepository _goalWriteRepository;
    private readonly IGoalMilestoneReadRepository _milestoneReadRepository;
    private readonly IGoalMilestoneWriteRepository _milestoneWriteRepository;
    private readonly Abstractions.Gamification.IGamificationService _gamificationService;
    private readonly Abstractions.Notifications.IAppNotificationService _notificationService;

    public UpdateGoalProgressCommandHandler(
        IUserGoalReadRepository goalReadRepository,
        IUserGoalWriteRepository goalWriteRepository,
        IGoalMilestoneReadRepository milestoneReadRepository,
        IGoalMilestoneWriteRepository milestoneWriteRepository,
        Abstractions.Gamification.IGamificationService gamificationService,
        Abstractions.Notifications.IAppNotificationService notificationService)
    {
        _goalReadRepository = goalReadRepository;
        _goalWriteRepository = goalWriteRepository;
        _milestoneReadRepository = milestoneReadRepository;
        _milestoneWriteRepository = milestoneWriteRepository;
        _gamificationService = gamificationService;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
    }

    public async Task<UpdateGoalProgressCommandResponse> Handle(
        UpdateGoalProgressCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var goal = await _goalReadRepository
            .GetWhere(g => g.Id == request.GoalId && g.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: true)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new Exception("Hedef bulunamadı.");

        if (goal.IsCompleted)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Bu hedef zaten tamamlanmış." };

        goal.CurrentValue += request.IncrementBy;
        int? earnedXp = null;

        // Tamamlandı mı?
        if (goal.CurrentValue >= goal.TargetValue)
        {
            goal.IsCompleted = true;
            goal.CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            earnedXp = goal.CompletionXP;

            await _gamificationService.AddExperienceAsync(request.UserId, goal.CompletionXP);
            await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                request.UserId,
                "Hedef Tamamlandı! 🏆",
                $"Tebrikler! '{goal.Title}' hedefini tamamladın! +{goal.CompletionXP} XP",
                "GoalCompleted");
        }
        else
        {
            // Milestone kontrolü
            var milestones = await _milestoneReadRepository
                .GetWhere(m => m.UserGoalId == goal.Id && !m.IsCompleted, tracking: true)
                .OrderBy(m => m.OrderIndex)
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            foreach (var ms in milestones.Where(m => goal.CurrentValue >= m.TargetValue))
            {
                ms.IsCompleted = true;
                ms.CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                await _gamificationService.AddExperienceAsync(request.UserId, ms.BonusXP);
                await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    request.UserId, "Milestone! 🎯",
                    $"'{ms.Title}' adımını geçtin! +{ms.BonusXP} XP", "MilestoneCompleted");
            }
            await _milestoneWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
        }

        _goalWriteRepository.Update(goal);
        await _goalWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new()
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = goal.IsCompleted ? "Hedef tamamlandı! 🎉" : "İlerleme güncellendi.",
            CurrentValue = goal.CurrentValue,
            TargetValue = goal.TargetValue,
            IsCompleted = goal.IsCompleted,
            EarnedXp = earnedXp
        };
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Goals.Queries.GetGoalDashboard;

public class GetGoalDashboardQueryRequest : IRequest<GetGoalDashboardQueryResponse>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
}

public class GoalDashboardItem
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string? Icon { get; set; }
    public string? Color { get; set; }
    public int CurrentValue { get; set; }
    public int TargetValue { get; set; }
    public int ProgressPercent => TargetValue > 0 ? (int)((double)CurrentValue / TargetValue * 100) : 0;
    public string ProgressUnit { get; set; } = "görev";
    public bool IsCompleted { get; set; }
    public DateTime EndDate { get; set; }
    public int DaysRemaining => Math.Max(0, (int)(EndDate - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalDays);
    public bool IsOnLag { get; set; }
    public int MilestoneCount { get; set; }
    public int CompletedMilestoneCount { get; set; }
    public string? Why { get; set; }
    public string Type { get; set; } = string.Empty;
}

public class GetGoalDashboardQueryResponse
{
    public List<GoalDashboardItem> ActiveGoals { get; set; } = new();
    public List<GoalDashboardItem> CompletedGoals { get; set; } = new();
    public List<GoalDashboardItem> ArchivedGoals { get; set; } = new();
    public int TotalActiveGoals { get; set; }
    public int TotalCompletedThisMonth { get; set; }
}

public sealed class GetGoalDashboardQueryHandler
    : IRequestHandler<GetGoalDashboardQueryRequest, GetGoalDashboardQueryResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserGoalReadRepository _goalReadRepository;
    private readonly IGoalMilestoneReadRepository _milestoneReadRepository;

    public GetGoalDashboardQueryHandler(
        IUserGoalReadRepository goalReadRepository,
        IGoalMilestoneReadRepository milestoneReadRepository)
    {
        _goalReadRepository = goalReadRepository;
        _milestoneReadRepository = milestoneReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<GetGoalDashboardQueryResponse> Handle(
        GetGoalDashboardQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var goals = await _goalReadRepository
            .GetWhere(g => g.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: false)
            .Include(g => g.Milestones)
            .OrderByDescending(g => g.StartDate)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var startOfMonth = new DateTime(now.Year, now.Month, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        var mapGoal = (Domain.Entities.UserGoal g) =>
        {
            var elapsed = (now - g.StartDate).TotalDays;
            var total = (g.EndDate - g.StartDate).TotalDays;
            var expected = total > 0 ? elapsed / total : 0;
            var actual = g.TargetValue > 0 ? (double)g.CurrentValue / g.TargetValue : 0;
            var isOnLag = actual < expected * 0.8;

            return new GoalDashboardItem
            {
                Id = g.Id,
                Title = g.Title,
                Icon = g.Icon,
                Color = g.Color,
                CurrentValue = g.CurrentValue,
                TargetValue = g.TargetValue,
                ProgressUnit = g.ProgressUnit,
                IsCompleted = g.IsCompleted,
                EndDate = g.EndDate,
                IsOnLag = !g.IsCompleted && isOnLag,
                MilestoneCount = g.Milestones?.Count ?? 0,
                CompletedMilestoneCount = g.Milestones?.Count(m => m.IsCompleted) ?? 0,
                Why = g.Why,
                Type = g.Type.ToString()
            };
        };

        var activeGoals = goals.Where(g => !g.IsCompleted && !g.IsArchived).Select(mapGoal).ToList();
        var completedGoals = goals.Where(g => g.IsCompleted).Select(mapGoal).ToList();
        var archivedGoals = goals.Where(g => g.IsArchived && !g.IsCompleted).Select(mapGoal).ToList();

        return new GetGoalDashboardQueryResponse
        {
            ActiveGoals = activeGoals,
            CompletedGoals = completedGoals,
            ArchivedGoals = archivedGoals,
            TotalActiveGoals = activeGoals.Count,
            TotalCompletedThisMonth = goals.Count(g => g.IsCompleted && g.CompletedAt >= startOfMonth)
        };
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Mood.Commands.RecordDailyMood;

public class RecordDailyMoodCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<RecordDailyMoodCommandRequest, UserDailyMoodDto>
{
    private readonly IUserDailyMoodReadRepository _moodReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserDailyMoodWriteRepository _moodWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;

    public RecordDailyMoodCommandHandler(
        IUserDailyMoodReadRepository moodReadRepository,
        IUserDailyMoodWriteRepository moodWriteRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository,
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository)
    {
        _moodReadRepository = moodReadRepository;
        _moodWriteRepository = moodWriteRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<UserDailyMoodDto> Handle(RecordDailyMoodCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);

        // UPSERT — bugün zaten kayıt varsa güncelle
        var existing = await _moodReadRepository
            .GetWhere(m => m.AppUserId == request.UserId && m.Date == today, tracking: true)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (existing != null)
        {
            existing.MoodMode = request.MoodMode;
            existing.AvailableMinutes = request.AvailableMinutes;
            existing.EnergyLevel = request.EnergyLevel;
            existing.RecordedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            _moodWriteRepository.Update(existing);
        }
        else
        {
            existing = new UserDailyMood
            {
                AppUserId = request.UserId,
                Date = today,
                MoodMode = request.MoodMode,
                AvailableMinutes = request.AvailableMinutes,
                EnergyLevel = request.EnergyLevel,
                RecordedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };
            await _moodWriteRepository.AddAsync(existing);
        }

        // Kullanıcının LastActiveAt alanını güncelle
        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString(), tracking: true);
        if (user != null)
        {
            user.LastActiveAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
        }

        await _moodWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new UserDailyMoodDto
        {
            Id = existing.Id,
            AppUserId = existing.AppUserId,
            Date = existing.Date,
            MoodMode = existing.MoodMode,
            AvailableMinutes = existing.AvailableMinutes,
            EnergyLevel = existing.EnergyLevel,
            RecordedAt = existing.RecordedAt
        };
    }
}

{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }

    // Adım 1 — Karşılama
    public string? DisplayName { get; set; }
    public int? AvatarId { get; set; }

    // Adım 2 — Yaşam tarzı
    public string? LifestyleType { get; set; }
    public string? WakeUpTime { get; set; }  // "07:00"
    public List<int>? WorkDays { get; set; }

    // Adım 3 — Hedefler
    public string? PrimaryFocusArea { get; set; }
    public List<string>? SecondaryGoals { get; set; }

    // Adım 4 — Kapasite
    public int? DailyAvailableMinutes { get; set; }
    public string? PreferredTaskDuration { get; set; }
    public int? PreferredTasksPerWeek { get; set; }

    // Adım 5 — Motivasyon
    public string? MotivationFactor { get; set; }
    public List<string>? MotivationKillers { get; set; }

    // Adım 6 — Zorluk
    public string? DifficultyPreference { get; set; }
    public string? AgeRange { get; set; }
}

public class CompleteOnboardingCommandResponse
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public Guid? FirstTaskId { get; set; }
    public string? FirstTaskTitle { get; set; }
    public int DailyTaskLimit { get; set; }
    public string? PrimaryFocusArea { get; set; }
    public int? AvatarId { get; set; }
    public string? DisplayName { get; set; }
}

public sealed class CompleteOnboardingCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<CompleteOnboardingCommandRequest, CompleteOnboardingCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;
    private readonly IOnboardingResponseWriteRepository _onboardingWriteRepository;
    private readonly ITaskRecommendationService _taskRecommendationService;

    public CompleteOnboardingCommandHandler(
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository,
        IOnboardingResponseWriteRepository onboardingWriteRepository,
        ITaskRecommendationService taskRecommendationService)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
        _onboardingWriteRepository = onboardingWriteRepository;
        _taskRecommendationService = taskRecommendationService;
    }

    public async Task<CompleteOnboardingCommandResponse> Handle(
        CompleteOnboardingCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString(), tracking: true)
            ?? throw new Exception("Kullanıcı bulunamadı.");

        // AppUser alanlarını güncelle
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.DisplayName))
            user.Name = request.DisplayName;

        user.AvatarId = request.AvatarId;
        user.LifestyleType = request.LifestyleType;
        user.AgeRange = request.AgeRange;
        user.PrimaryFocusArea = request.PrimaryFocusArea;
        user.PreferredTaskDuration = request.PreferredTaskDuration;
        user.DifficultyPreference = request.DifficultyPreference;
        user.MotivationFactor = request.MotivationFactor;
        user.MotivationKillers = request.MotivationKillers;
        user.WorkDays = request.WorkDays;

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.WakeUpTime) &&
            TimeOnly.TryParse(request.WakeUpTime, out var wakeTime))
            user.WakeUpTime = wakeTime;

        if (request.DailyAvailableMinutes.HasValue)
            user.DailyAvailableMinutes = request.DailyAvailableMinutes;

        if (request.PreferredTasksPerWeek.HasValue)
        {
            user.PreferredTasksPerWeek = request.PreferredTasksPerWeek;
            user.WeeklyTaskLimit = request.PreferredTasksPerWeek.Value;
            // DailyTaskLimit = max(1, haftada / 7)
            user.DailyTaskLimit = Math.Max(1, request.PreferredTasksPerWeek.Value / 7);
        }

        user.OnboardingCompleted = true;
        user.OnboardingCompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        user.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
        await _userWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        // Onboarding ham cevaplarını kaydet
        var answers = new Dictionary<string, object?>
        {
            ["display_name"] = request.DisplayName,
            ["avatar_id"] = request.AvatarId,
            ["lifestyle_type"] = request.LifestyleType,
            ["wake_up_time"] = request.WakeUpTime,
            ["work_days"] = request.WorkDays,
            ["primary_focus_area"] = request.PrimaryFocusArea,
            ["secondary_goals"] = request.SecondaryGoals,
            ["daily_available_minutes"] = request.DailyAvailableMinutes,
            ["preferred_task_duration"] = request.PreferredTaskDuration,
            ["preferred_tasks_per_week"] = request.PreferredTasksPerWeek,
            ["motivation_factor"] = request.MotivationFactor,
            ["motivation_killers"] = request.MotivationKillers,
            ["difficulty_preference"] = request.DifficultyPreference,
            ["age_range"] = request.AgeRange,
        };

        foreach (var (key, value) in answers)
        {
            if (value == null) continue;
            await _onboardingWriteRepository.AddAsync(new OnboardingResponse
            {
                AppUserId = request.UserId,
                QuestionKey = key,
                Answer = JsonSerializer.Serialize(value),
                AnsweredAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            });
        }
        await _onboardingWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        // İlk görev önerisi al (1 adet, Easy, PrimaryFocusArea)
        Guid? firstTaskId = null;
        string? firstTaskTitle = null;

        try
        {
            var recommendations = await _taskRecommendationService.GetContextualRecommendationsAsync(
                request.UserId,
                Domain.Enums.MoodMode.Normal,
                Domain.Enums.DayTimeSlot.Morning,
                energyLevel: 3,
                availableMinutes: request.DailyAvailableMinutes ?? 30,
                count: 1);

            if (recommendations.Count > 0)
            {
                firstTaskId = recommendations[0].UserTaskId;
                firstTaskTitle = recommendations[0].Title;
            }
        }
        catch { /* İlk görev alınamazsa sessizce geç */ }

        return new CompleteOnboardingCommandResponse
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = "Onboarding tamamlandı! Hoş geldin! 🎉",
            FirstTaskId = firstTaskId,
            FirstTaskTitle = firstTaskTitle,
            DailyTaskLimit = user.DailyTaskLimit,
            PrimaryFocusArea = user.PrimaryFocusArea,
            AvatarId = user.AvatarId,
            DisplayName = user.Name
        };
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using MediatR;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Roles.Commands.AssignRoleToUser;

public sealed class AssignRoleToUserCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AssignRoleToUserCommandRequest, AssignRoleToUserCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAppRoleReadRepository _roleReadRepository;

    public AssignRoleToUserCommandHandler(
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository,
        IAppRoleReadRepository roleReadRepository)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
        _roleReadRepository = roleReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<AssignRoleToUserCommandResponse> Handle(AssignRoleToUserCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString(), tracking: true);
        if (user == null) throw new Exception("Kullanıcı bulunamadı.");

        var role = await _roleReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.RoleId.ToString());
        if (role == null) throw new Exception("Belirtilen rol sistemde bulunamadı.");

        user.AppRoleId = request.RoleId;

        _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
        await _userWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new AssignRoleToUserCommandResponse
        {
            IsSuccess = true,
            Message = $"'{user.UserName}' adlı kullanıcının rolü başarıyla '{role.Name}' olarak değiştirildi."
        };
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Social.Commands.RespondToChallenge;

public class RespondToChallengeCommandRequest : IRequest<RespondToChallengeCommandResponse>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid ChallengeId { get; set; }
    public bool Accept { get; set; }
    public string? Message { get; set; }
}

public class RespondToChallengeCommandResponse
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public ChallengeStatus NewStatus { get; set; }
}

public sealed class RespondToChallengeCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<RespondToChallengeCommandRequest, RespondToChallengeCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IChallengeReadRepository _challengeReadRepository;
    private readonly IChallengeWriteRepository _challengeWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notificationService;

    public RespondToChallengeCommandHandler(
        IChallengeReadRepository challengeReadRepository,
        IChallengeWriteRepository challengeWriteRepository,
        IAppNotificationService notificationService)
    {
        _challengeReadRepository = challengeReadRepository;
        _challengeWriteRepository = challengeWriteRepository;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
    }

    public async Task<RespondToChallengeCommandResponse> Handle(
        RespondToChallengeCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var challenge = await _challengeReadRepository
            .GetWhere(c => c.Id == request.ChallengeId && c.OpponentId == request.UserId, tracking: true)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new Exception("Mücadele bulunamadı veya bu davete cevap verme yetkiniz yok.");

        if (challenge.Status != ChallengeStatus.Invited)
            throw new Exception("Bu davete artık cevap verilemez.");

        if (request.Accept)
        {
            challenge.Status = ChallengeStatus.Active;
            challenge.AcceptedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            challenge.StartDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
            challenge.EndDate = DateTime.UtcNow.Add(challenge.EndDate - challenge.StartDate);

            // Her iki kullanıcıya bildirim
            await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                challenge.ChallengerId, "Mücadele Başladı! ⚔️",
                $"'{challenge.Title}' mücadeleniz başladı!", "ChallengeAccepted");
            await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                challenge.OpponentId, "Mücadele Başladı! ⚔️",
                $"'{challenge.Title}' mücadelesini kabul ettin!", "ChallengeAccepted");
        }
        else
        {
            challenge.Status = ChallengeStatus.Declined;

            // Davet edene bildirim
            await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                challenge.ChallengerId, "Mücadele Reddedildi",
                $"'{challenge.Title}' mücadele davetin reddedildi.", "ChallengeDeclined");
        }

        _challengeWriteRepository.Update(challenge);
        await _challengeWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new RespondToChallengeCommandResponse
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = request.Accept ? "Mücadele kabul edildi, başladı!" : "Mücadele reddedildi.",
            NewStatus = challenge.Status
        };
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\Social\Commands\SendChallengeInvite\SendChallengeInviteCommandHandler.cs

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Social.Commands.SendChallengeInvite;

public class SendChallengeInviteCommandRequest : IRequest<SendChallengeInviteCommandResponse>
{
    public Guid ChallengerId { get; set; }
    public Guid OpponentId { get; set; }
    public ChallengeType ChallengeType { get; set; } = ChallengeType.TaskCount;
    public string? Title { get; set; }
    public string? Description { get; set; }
    public int DurationDays { get; set; } = 7;
    public int? TargetValue { get; set; }
    public Guid? TargetCategoryId { get; set; }
    public Guid? TargetAppTaskId { get; set; }
    public string? ChallengerMessage { get; set; }
    public int WinnerXPBonus { get; set; } = 100;
    public bool IsPublic { get; set; } = false;
}

public class SendChallengeInviteCommandResponse
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public Guid ChallengeId { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
}

public sealed class SendChallengeInviteCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<SendChallengeInviteCommandRequest, SendChallengeInviteCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IChallengeWriteRepository _challengeWriteRepository;
    private readonly IChallengeReadRepository _challengeReadRepository;
    private readonly IChallengeParticipantWriteRepository _participantWriteRepository;
    private readonly IFriendshipReadRepository _friendshipReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notificationService;

    public SendChallengeInviteCommandHandler(
        IChallengeWriteRepository challengeWriteRepository,
        IChallengeReadRepository challengeReadRepository,
        IChallengeParticipantWriteRepository participantWriteRepository,
        IFriendshipReadRepository friendshipReadRepository,
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppNotificationService notificationService)
    {
        _challengeWriteRepository = challengeWriteRepository;
        _challengeReadRepository = challengeReadRepository;
        _participantWriteRepository = participantWriteRepository;
        _friendshipReadRepository = friendshipReadRepository;
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
    }

    public async Task<SendChallengeInviteCommandResponse> Handle(
        SendChallengeInviteCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // Arkadaşlık kontrolü
        var areFriends = await _friendshipReadRepository.GetWhere(
            f => ((f.RequesterId == request.ChallengerId && f.AddresseeId == request.OpponentId) ||
                  (f.RequesterId == request.OpponentId && f.AddresseeId == request.ChallengerId)) &&
                 f.Status == FriendshipStatus.Accepted,
            tracking: false)
            .AnyAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (!areFriends)
            throw new Exception("Mücadele daveti göndermek için karşı tarafın arkadaşın olması gerekir.");

        // Aktif mücadele çakışma kontrolü
        var hasActiveChallenge = await _challengeReadRepository.GetWhere(
            c => (c.ChallengerId == request.ChallengerId && c.OpponentId == request.OpponentId ||
                  c.ChallengerId == request.OpponentId && c.OpponentId == request.ChallengerId) &&
                 (c.Status == ChallengeStatus.Active || c.Status == ChallengeStatus.Invited),
            tracking: false)
            .AnyAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (hasActiveChallenge)
            throw new Exception("Bu kullanıcı ile zaten aktif bir mücadeleniz var.");

        // Rakip kullanıcıyı bul
        var opponent = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.OpponentId.ToString())
            ?? throw new Exception("Rakip kullanıcı bulunamadı.");

        // Başlık oluştur
        var title = request.Title ?? $"{request.ChallengeType} Mücadelesi";

        var challenge = new Challenge
        {
            ChallengerId = request.ChallengerId,
            OpponentId = request.OpponentId,
            ChallengeType = request.ChallengeType,
            Status = ChallengeStatus.Invited,
            Title = title,
            Description = request.Description,
            TargetCategoryId = request.TargetCategoryId,
            TargetAppTaskId = request.TargetAppTaskId,
            TargetValue = request.TargetValue,
            StartDate = DateTime.UtcNow,
            EndDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(request.DurationDays),
            InvitedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            ChallengerMessage = request.ChallengerMessage,
            WinnerXPBonus = request.WinnerXPBonus,
            IsPublic = request.IsPublic
        };

        await _challengeWriteRepository.AddAsync(challenge);
        await _challengeWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        // ChallengeParticipants kayıtları
        await _participantWriteRepository.AddAsync(new ChallengeParticipant
        {
            ChallengeId = challenge.Id,
            UserId = request.ChallengerId,
            Role = 0, // Challenger
            JoinedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        });
        await _participantWriteRepository.AddAsync(new ChallengeParticipant
        {
            ChallengeId = challenge.Id,
            UserId = request.OpponentId,
            Role = 1, // Opponent
            JoinedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        });
        await _participantWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        // Karşı tarafa bildirim
        await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
            request.OpponentId,
            "Mücadele Daveti! ⚔️",
            $"'{title}' mücadelesine davet edildin! {request.ChallengerMessage ?? ""}",
            "ChallengeInvitation");

        return new SendChallengeInviteCommandResponse
        {
            Success = true,
            ChallengeId = challenge.Id,
            Message = "Mücadele daveti gönderildi!"
        };
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Social.Queries.GetActiveChallenges;

public class GetActiveChallengesQueryRequest : IRequest<List<ChallengeDto>>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    /// <summary>active | invited | completed | all</summary>
    public string StatusFilter { get; set; } = "active";
}

public class ChallengeDto
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string? Description { get; set; }
    public string ChallengeType { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Status { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int MyProgress { get; set; }
    public int OpponentProgress { get; set; }
    public int? TargetValue { get; set; }
    public Guid OpponentId { get; set; }
    public string OpponentName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int? OpponentAvatarId { get; set; }
    public DateTime StartDate { get; set; }
    public DateTime EndDate { get; set; }
    public int DaysRemaining { get; set; }
    public bool IAmChallenger { get; set; }
    public int WinnerXPBonus { get; set; }
    public string? ChallengerMessage { get; set; }
    public Guid? WinnerId { get; set; }
}

public sealed class GetActiveChallengesQueryHandler
    : IRequestHandler<GetActiveChallengesQueryRequest, List<ChallengeDto>>
{
    private readonly IChallengeReadRepository _challengeReadRepository;

    public GetActiveChallengesQueryHandler(IChallengeReadRepository challengeReadRepository)
        => _challengeReadRepository = challengeReadRepository;

    public async Task<List<ChallengeDto>> Handle(
        GetActiveChallengesQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        IQueryable<LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Challenge> query = _challengeReadRepository.GetWhere(
            c => c.ChallengerId == request.UserId || c.OpponentId == request.UserId,
            tracking: false)
            .Include(c => c.Challenger)
            .Include(c => c.Opponent);

        query = request.StatusFilter switch
        {
            "invited" => query.Where(c => c.Status == ChallengeStatus.Invited),
            "completed" => query.Where(c => c.Status == ChallengeStatus.Completed),
            "all" => query,
            _ => query.Where(c => c.Status == ChallengeStatus.Active)
        };

        var challenges = await query.OrderByDescending(c => c.InvitedAt).ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

        return challenges.Select(c =>
        {
            bool iAmChallenger = c.ChallengerId == request.UserId;
            var opponent = iAmChallenger ? c.Opponent : c.Challenger;

            return new ChallengeDto
            {
                Id = c.Id,
                Title = c.Title,
                Description = c.Description,
                ChallengeType = c.ChallengeType.ToString(),
                Status = c.Status.ToString(),
                MyProgress = iAmChallenger ? c.ChallengerProgress : c.OpponentProgress,
                OpponentProgress = iAmChallenger ? c.OpponentProgress : c.ChallengerProgress,
                TargetValue = c.TargetValue,
                OpponentId = opponent?.Id ?? Guid.Empty,
                OpponentName = opponent?.FullName ?? "Bilinmiyor",
                OpponentAvatarId = opponent?.AvatarId,
                StartDate = c.StartDate,
                EndDate = c.EndDate,
                DaysRemaining = Math.Max(0, (int)(c.EndDate - now).TotalDays),
                IAmChallenger = iAmChallenger,
                WinnerXPBonus = c.WinnerXPBonus,
                ChallengerMessage = c.ChallengerMessage,
                WinnerId = c.WinnerId
            };
        }).ToList();
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Tasks.Commands.CreateBulkTasks;

public sealed class CreateBulkTasksCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateBulkTasksCommandRequest, CreateBulkTasksCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IAppTaskWriteRepository _taskWriteRepository;

    public CreateBulkTasksCommandHandler(IAppTaskWriteRepository taskWriteRepository)
    {
        _taskWriteRepository = taskWriteRepository;
    }

    public async Task<CreateBulkTasksCommandResponse> Handle(CreateBulkTasksCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var tasks = request.Tasks.Select(t => new AppTask
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),

            Title = t.Title,
            Description = t.Description,
            CategoryId = t.CategoryId,
            BaseXP = t.BaseXP,
            MinLevel = t.MinLevel,
            Difficulty = (DifficultyLevel)t.Difficulty,
            IsActive = true,
        }).ToList();

        try
        {
            await _taskWriteRepository.AddRangeAsync(tasks);
            await _taskWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            var errorMessage = ex.InnerException != null ? ex.InnerException.Message : ex.Message;
            throw new Exception($"Veritabanı Kayıt Hatası: {errorMessage}");
        }

        return new CreateBulkTasksCommandResponse
        {
            IsSuccess = true,
            Message = $"{tasks.Count} adet görev başarıyla eklendi.",
            AddedCount = tasks.Count
        };
    }

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Tasks.Queries.GetAll;

public sealed class GetAllTasksQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetAllTasksQueryRequest, List<GetAllTasksQueryResponse>>
{
    private readonly IAppTaskReadRepository _taskReadRepository;

    public GetAllTasksQueryHandler(IAppTaskReadRepository taskReadRepository)
    {
        _taskReadRepository = taskReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<List<GetAllTasksQueryResponse>> Handle(GetAllTasksQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var tasks = await _taskReadRepository.GetAll(tracking: false)
                                             .Include(t => t.Category)
                                             .Where(t => t.IsActive)
                                             .OrderBy(t => t.MinLevel)
                                             .ThenBy(t => t.Title)
                                             .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        return tasks.Select(t => new GetAllTasksQueryResponse
        {
            Id = t.Id,
            Title = t.Title,
            Description = t.Description,
            CategoryName = t.Category != null ? t.Category.Name : "Kategorisiz",
            CategoryId = t.CategoryId,
            Difficulty = t.Difficulty.ToString(),
            BaseXP = t.BaseXP,
            MinLevel = t.MinLevel,
            MaxLevel = t.MaxLevel,
            IsDaily = t.IsDaily,
            IsActive = t.IsActive
        }).ToList();
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.User.Commands.UpdateGoals;

// ─── Request ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class UpdateUserGoalsCommandRequest : IRequest<UpdateUserGoalsCommandResponse>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public List<string> NewGoals { get; set; } = new();
    public List<string> RemovedGoals { get; set; } = new();
}

public class UpdateUserGoalsCommandResponse
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public List<string> UpdatedGoals { get; set; } = new();
}

// ─── Handler ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public sealed class UpdateUserGoalsCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<UpdateUserGoalsCommandRequest, UpdateUserGoalsCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userRead;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWrite;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notifService;

    public UpdateUserGoalsCommandHandler(
        IAppUserReadRepository userRead,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWrite,
        IAppNotificationService notifService)
    {
        _userRead = userRead;
        _userWrite = userWrite;
        _notifService = notifService;
    }

    public async Task<UpdateUserGoalsCommandResponse> Handle(
        UpdateUserGoalsCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var user = await _userRead.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString(), tracking: true);
        if (user == null)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Kullanıcı bulunamadı." };

        var goals = user.UserGoals ?? new List<string>();

        // Kaldırılanları sil
        foreach (var r in request.RemovedGoals)
            goals.Remove(r);

        // Yenileri ekle (duplicate yok)
        foreach (var n in request.NewGoals)
            if (!goals.Contains(n, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                goals.Add(n);

        user.UserGoals = goals;
        user.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        _userWrite.Update(user);
        await _userWrite.SaveAsync();

        // Bildirim gönder
        await _notifService.SendNotificationAsync(
            user.Id,
            "Hedeflerin güncellendi! 🎯",
            "Yeni hedeflerine uygun görevler hazırlanıyor.",
            "SystemMessage");

        return new()
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = "Hedeflerin başarıyla güncellendi.",
            UpdatedGoals = goals
        };
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.User.Commands.Vacation;

// ─── Request ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class EndVacationCommandRequest : IRequest<VacationCommandResponse>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
}

// ─── Handler ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public sealed class EndVacationCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<EndVacationCommandRequest, VacationCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userRead;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWrite;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notifService;

    public EndVacationCommandHandler(
        IAppUserReadRepository userRead,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWrite,
        IAppNotificationService notifService)
    {
        _userRead = userRead;
        _userWrite = userWrite;
        _notifService = notifService;
    }

    public async Task<VacationCommandResponse> Handle(
        EndVacationCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var user = await _userRead.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString(), tracking: true);
        if (user == null)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Kullanıcı bulunamadı." };

        if (!user.IsOnVacation)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Tatil modunda değilsin." };

        int restoredStreak = user.FrozenStreak;

        user.IsOnVacation      = false;
        user.VacationEndDate   = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);
        user.FrozenStreak      = 0;
        user.UpdatedAt         = DateTime.UtcNow;

        _userWrite.Update(user);
        await _userWrite.SaveAsync();

        // Chatbot hoşgeldin mesajı (SignalR push)
        await _notifService.SendNotificationAsync(
            user.Id,
            "Hoş geldin! 🎉",
            $"Tatilden döndün! Streak'in ({restoredStreak} gün) hâlâ yerinde. Hazır mısın?",
            "SystemMessage");

        return new()
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = $"Tatil modu kapatıldı. Streak'in ({restoredStreak} gün) korundu! 🔥"
        };
    }
}

    public string? Reason { get; set; } // Tatil / Hastalık / Çok yoğunum
}

public class VacationCommandResponse
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
}

// ─── Handler ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    : IRequestHandler<StartVacationCommandRequest, VacationCommandResponse>
{

    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWrite;

        IAppUserReadRepository userRead,

        _userWrite = userWrite;

    public async Task<VacationCommandResponse> Handle(

==================================================

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.User.Queries.GetUserActivities;

public sealed class GetUserActivitiesQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetUserActivitiesQueryRequest, GetUserActivitiesQueryResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserBadgeReadRepository _userBadgeReadRepository;

    public GetUserActivitiesQueryHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository, IUserBadgeReadRepository userBadgeReadRepository)
    {
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _userBadgeReadRepository = userBadgeReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<GetUserActivitiesQueryResponse> Handle(GetUserActivitiesQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var tasksData = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId && ut.CompletedAt.HasValue, tracking: false)
            .OrderByDescending(ut => ut.CompletedAt)
            .Take(5)
            .Select(ut => new
            {
                ut.Id,
                Title = ut.AppTask.Title,
                ut.EarnedXp,
                OriginalDate = ut.CompletedAt!.Value
            })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var badgesData = await _userBadgeReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ub => ub.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: false)
            .OrderByDescending(ub => ub.EarnedAt)
            .Take(5)
            .Select(ub => new
            {
                ub.Id,
                Name = ub.Badge.Name,
                OriginalDate = ub.EarnedAt
            })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var taskDtos = tasksData.Select(t => {
            var trTime = t.OriginalDate.AddHours(3);
            var cleanTrTime = DateTime.SpecifyKind(trTime, DateTimeKind.Unspecified);

            return new ActivityDto
            {
                Id = t.Id,
                Type = "TASK",
                Text = $"\"{t.Title}\" görevini tamamladın",
                Xp = $"+{t.EarnedXp} XP",
                Time = cleanTrTime.ToString("dd MMM HH:mm"),
                RawDate = cleanTrTime
            };
        });

        var badgeDtos = badgesData.Select(b => {
            var trTime = b.OriginalDate.AddHours(3);
            var cleanTrTime = DateTime.SpecifyKind(trTime, DateTimeKind.Unspecified);

            return new ActivityDto
            {
                Id = b.Id,
                Type = "BADGE",
                Text = $"\"{b.Name}\" rozetini kazandın!",
                Xp = "",
                Time = cleanTrTime.ToString("dd MMM HH:mm"),
                RawDate = cleanTrTime
            };
        });

        var allActivities = taskDtos
            .Concat(badgeDtos)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.RawDate)
            .Take(5)
            .ToList();

        return new GetUserActivitiesQueryResponse
        {
            Activities = allActivities
        };
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.User.Queries.GetUserProfile;

public sealed class GetUserProfileQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetUserProfileQueryRequest, GetUserProfileQueryResponse>
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserBadgeReadRepository _userBadgeReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;

    public GetUserProfileQueryHandler(
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IUserBadgeReadRepository userBadgeReadRepository,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userBadgeReadRepository = userBadgeReadRepository;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<GetUserProfileQueryResponse> Handle(GetUserProfileQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var user = await _userReadRepository.Table
            .Include(u => u.CategoryProgresses)
            .ThenInclude(cp => cp.Category)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == request.UserId, cancellationToken);

        if (user == null) throw new Exception("Kullanıcı bulunamadı.");

        var userBadges = await _userBadgeReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ub => ub.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: false)
            .Include(ub => ub.Badge)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var completedTaskCount = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId && ut.CompletedAt.HasValue, tracking: false)
            .CountAsync(cancellationToken);

        return new GetUserProfileQueryResponse
        {
            Name = user.Name,
            Surname = user.Surname,
            UserName = user.UserName,
            TotalXP = user.TotalXP,
            GeneralLevel = user.GeneralLevel,
            CreatedAt = user.CreatedAt,
            CompletedTaskCount = completedTaskCount,

            EarnedBadges = userBadges.Select(ub => new UserBadgeDto
            {
                BadgeName = ub.Badge.Name,
                IconPath = ub.Badge.IconPath,
                Description = ub.Badge.Description,
                EarnedAt = ub.EarnedAt
            }).ToList(),

            CategoryStats = user.CategoryProgresses.Select(cp => new CategoryProgressDto
            {
                CategoryName = cp.Category.Name,
                IconPath = cp.Category.IconPath,
                Level = cp.Level,
                CurrentXp = cp.CurrentXp,
                XpToNextLevel = cp.XpToNextLevel
            }).ToList()
        };
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\User\Queries\GetUserStats\GetUserStatsQueryHandler.cs
==================================================

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.User.Queries.GetUserStats;

public sealed class GetUserStatsQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetUserStatsQueryRequest, GetUserStatsQueryResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;

    public GetUserStatsQueryHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository)
    {
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<GetUserStatsQueryResponse> Handle(GetUserStatsQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var completedDates = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId && ut.CompletedAt.HasValue, tracking: false)
            .Select(ut => ut.CompletedAt!.Value)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var completedDateStrings = completedDates
            .Select(d => d.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"))
            .ToHashSet();

        var totalCompleted = completedDates.Count;
        var now = DateTime.Now;

        var lastWeekCount = completedDates.Count(d => d >= now.AddDays(-7));
        var previousWeekCount = completedDates.Count(d => d >= now.AddDays(-14) && d < now.AddDays(-7));

        int growth = 0;
        if (previousWeekCount > 0)
            growth = ((lastWeekCount - previousWeekCount) * 100) / previousWeekCount;
        else if (lastWeekCount > 0)
            growth = 100;

        var streakList = new List<bool>();
        for (int i = 6; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            var checkDateStr = now.AddDays(-i).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
            streakList.Add(completedDateStrings.Contains(checkDateStr));
        }

        int currentStreak = 0;
        for (int i = streakList.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            if (streakList[i]) currentStreak++;
            else if (i == streakList.Count - 1) continue;
            else break;
        }

        return new GetUserStatsQueryResponse
        {
            TotalCompleted = totalCompleted,
            WeeklyGrowth = growth,
            Streak = streakList,
            StreakCount = currentStreak
        };
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserBadges.Queries.GetBadgeGallery;


public sealed class GetBadgeGalleryQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetBadgeGalleryQueryRequest, GetBadgeGalleryQueryResponse>
{
    private readonly IBadgeReadRepository _badgeReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserBadgeReadRepository _userBadgeReadRepository;

    public GetBadgeGalleryQueryHandler(
        IBadgeReadRepository badgeReadRepository,
        IUserBadgeReadRepository userBadgeReadRepository)
    {
        _badgeReadRepository = badgeReadRepository;
        _userBadgeReadRepository = userBadgeReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<GetBadgeGalleryQueryResponse> Handle(GetBadgeGalleryQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var allBadges = await _badgeReadRepository.GetAll(tracking: false)
            .OrderBy(b => b.RequiredLevel)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var userEarnedBadges = await _userBadgeReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ub => ub.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: false)
            .Select(ub => new { ub.BadgeId, ub.EarnedAt })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var badgeDtos = allBadges.Select(badge =>
        {
            var earnedRecord = userEarnedBadges.FirstOrDefault(ub => ub.BadgeId == badge.Id);
            return new BadgeGalleryDto
            {
                Id = badge.Id,
                Name = badge.Name,
                Description = badge.Description,
                IconPath = badge.IconPath,
                RequiredLevel = badge.RequiredLevel,
                IsEarned = earnedRecord != null,
                EarnedAt = earnedRecord?.EarnedAt
            };
        }).ToList();

        return new GetBadgeGalleryQueryResponse
        {
            Badges = badgeDtos
        };
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.AssignSpecificTask;

public class AssignSpecificTaskCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AssignSpecificTaskCommandRequest, AssignSpecificTaskCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWriteRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppTaskReadRepository _appTaskReadRepository;

    public AssignSpecificTaskCommandHandler(
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWriteRepository,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IAppTaskReadRepository appTaskReadRepository)
    {
        _userTaskWriteRepository = userTaskWriteRepository;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _appTaskReadRepository = appTaskReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<AssignSpecificTaskCommandResponse> Handle(AssignSpecificTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var taskExists = await _appTaskReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.AppTaskId.ToString());
        if (taskExists == null)
        {
            return new AssignSpecificTaskCommandResponse { Success = false, Message = "Görev bulunamadı." };
        }

        var alreadyAssigned = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
            .AnyAsync(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId && ut.AppTaskId == request.AppTaskId
                && ut.Status != AppTaskStatus.Expired && ut.Status != AppTaskStatus.Abandoned, cancellationToken);
            
        if (alreadyAssigned)
        {
            return new AssignSpecificTaskCommandResponse { Success = false, Message = "Bu görev sana zaten atanmış durumda." };
        }

        var newUserTask = new UserTask
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            AppUserId = request.UserId,
            AppTaskId = request.AppTaskId,
            Status = AppTaskStatus.Selected,
            AssignedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            DueDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(24),
            EarnedXp = 0
        };

        await _userTaskWriteRepository.AddAsync(newUserTask);
        await _userTaskWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new AssignSpecificTaskCommandResponse
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = "Görev başarıyla eklendi!",
            AssignedUserTaskId = newUserTask.Id
        };
    }
}
