DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\UserTasks\Commands\CompleteUserTask\CompleteUserTaskCommandHandler.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Social;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.CompleteUserTask;

public sealed class CompleteUserTaskCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<CompleteUserTaskCommandRequest, CompleteUserTaskCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWriteRepository;
    private readonly IGamificationService _gamificationService;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;
    private readonly IUserGoalReadRepository _goalReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserGoalWriteRepository _goalWriteRepository;
    private readonly IGoalMilestoneReadRepository _milestoneReadRepository;
    private readonly IGoalMilestoneWriteRepository _milestoneWriteRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskInteractionWriteRepository _interactionWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAchievementService _achievementService;
    private readonly IChallengeService _challengeService;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notificationService;

    public CompleteUserTaskCommandHandler(
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWriteRepository,
        IGamificationService gamificationService,
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository,
        IUserGoalReadRepository goalReadRepository,
        IUserGoalWriteRepository goalWriteRepository,
        IGoalMilestoneReadRepository milestoneReadRepository,
        IGoalMilestoneWriteRepository milestoneWriteRepository,
        IUserTaskInteractionWriteRepository interactionWriteRepository,
        IAchievementService achievementService,
        IChallengeService challengeService,
        IAppNotificationService notificationService)
    {
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _userTaskWriteRepository = userTaskWriteRepository;
        _gamificationService = gamificationService;
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
        _goalReadRepository = goalReadRepository;
        _goalWriteRepository = goalWriteRepository;
        _milestoneReadRepository = milestoneReadRepository;
        _milestoneWriteRepository = milestoneWriteRepository;
        _interactionWriteRepository = interactionWriteRepository;
        _achievementService = achievementService;
        _challengeService = challengeService;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
    }

    public async Task<CompleteUserTaskCommandResponse> Handle(
        CompleteUserTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // 1. Görev kontrolü
        var userTask = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
                .ThenInclude(t => t!.Category)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId, cancellationToken);

        if (userTask == null)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Görev bulunamadı." };

        if (userTask.AppUserId != request.UserId)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Bu görev size ait değil." };

        if (userTask.CompletedAt.HasValue)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Bu görev zaten tamamlanmış." };

        var task = userTask.AppTask;
        if (task == null)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Görev detayları bulunamadı." };

        // 2. Görev tamamlama + XP kazanma
        int xpToEarn = task.BaseXP;
        userTask.CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        userTask.Status = AppTaskStatus.Completed;

        await _gamificationService.AddExperienceWithTaskAsync(request.UserId, xpToEarn, userTask, task.CategoryId);
        await _userTaskWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        // 3. Kullanıcı sayaçlarını güncelle (SP-05)
        var user = await _userReadRepository.Table
            .Include(u => u.CategoryProgresses)
            .Include(u => u.UserTasks)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == request.UserId, cancellationToken);

        if (user != null)
        {
            // SP-05: ActiveTaskCount ve WeeklyCompletedCount güncelle
            if (user.ActiveTaskCount > 0) user.ActiveTaskCount--;
            user.WeeklyCompletedCount++;
            _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
            await _userWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

            // SP-05: Hedef otomatik ilerleme güncelleme
            await UpdateGoalProgressAsync(request.UserId, task.CategoryId, xpToEarn, cancellationToken);

            // ML modeli için etkileşim verisini kaydet
            var userCatLevelObj = user.CategoryProgresses?.FirstOrDefault(c => c.CategoryId == task.CategoryId);
            int userCatLevel = userCatLevelObj?.Level ?? 1;

            var interaction = new UserTaskInteraction
            {
                AppUserId = request.UserId,
                AppTaskId = task.Id,
                UserLevel = (int)user.GeneralLevel,
                UserCategoryLevel = userCatLevel,
                TaskDifficulty = (int)task.Difficulty,
                TaskBaseXP = task.BaseXP,
                DayOfWeek = (int)DateTime.UtcNow.DayOfWeek,
                HourOfDay = DateTime.UtcNow.Hour,
                UserCompletedTaskCount = user.UserTasks?.Count(ut => ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed) ?? 0,
                UserStreakDays = 0,
                WasCompleted = true,
                CompletionTimeHours = (float)(DateTime.UtcNow - userTask.AssignedAt).TotalHours,
                Rating = 5.0f
            };

            await _interactionWriteRepository.AddAsync(interaction);
            await _interactionWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
        }

        // 4. Başarımları ve Mücadeleleri kontrol et
        await _achievementService.CheckAchievementsAsync(request.UserId);
        await _challengeService.UpdateChallengeProgressAsync(request.UserId, task.CategoryId);

        return new()
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = "Görev başarıyla tamamlandı! 🎉",
            EarnedXp = xpToEarn
        };
    }

    /// <summary>SP-05: Görev tamamlandığında ilgili aktif hedeflerin ilerlemesini günceller.</summary>
    private async Task UpdateGoalProgressAsync(Guid userId, Guid? categoryId, int earnedXp, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var activeGoals = await _goalReadRepository.GetWhere(
            g => g.AppUserId == userId && !g.IsCompleted && !g.IsArchived, tracking: true)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        foreach (var goal in activeGoals)
        {
            bool updated = false;

            // AutoTrackByCategory: Kategori eşleşiyorsa CurrentValue++
            if (goal.AutoTrackByCategory && categoryId.HasValue &&
                goal.LinkedCategoryIds != null && goal.LinkedCategoryIds.Contains(categoryId.Value))
            {
                goal.CurrentValue++;
                updated = true;
            }

            // AutoTrackByXP: CurrentValue += kazanılan XP
            if (goal.AutoTrackByXP)
            {
                goal.CurrentValue += earnedXp;
                updated = true;
            }

            if (!updated) continue;

            // Hedef tamamlandı mı?
            if (goal.CurrentValue >= goal.TargetValue && !goal.IsCompleted)
            {
                goal.IsCompleted = true;
                goal.CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                await _gamificationService.AddExperienceAsync(userId, goal.CompletionXP);

                await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    userId,
                    "Hedef Tamamlandı! 🏆",
                    $"Tebrikler! '{goal.Title}' hedefini tamamladın! +{goal.CompletionXP} XP",
                    "GoalCompleted");
            }
            else
            {
                // Milestone kontrolü
                var milestones = await _milestoneReadRepository
                    .GetWhere(m => m.UserGoalId == goal.Id && !m.IsCompleted, tracking: true)
                    .OrderBy(m => m.OrderIndex)
                    .ToListAsync(ct);

                foreach (var milestone in milestones.Where(m => goal.CurrentValue >= m.TargetValue))
                {
                    milestone.IsCompleted = true;
                    milestone.CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    await _gamificationService.AddExperienceAsync(userId, milestone.BonusXP);

                    await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                        userId,
                        "Milestone Tamamlandı! 🎯",
                        $"'{goal.Title}' hedefinde '{milestone.Title}' adımını geçtin! +{milestone.BonusXP} XP",
                        "MilestoneCompleted");
                }
                await _milestoneWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
            }

            _goalWriteRepository.Update(goal);
        }

        await _goalWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\UserTasks\Commands\PostponeTask\PostponeTaskCommand.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.PostponeTask;

public class PostponeTaskCommandRequest : IRequest<PostponeResultDto>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid UserTaskId { get; set; }
    public DateOnly PostponeTo { get; set; } = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(1));
    public string? SkipReason { get; set; }
}

public class PostponeTaskCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<PostponeTaskCommandRequest, PostponeResultDto>
{
    private const int MaxPostponeCount = 3;
    private const decimal PostponeXpRate = 0.70m;

    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;

    public PostponeTaskCommandHandler(
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWriteRepository,
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository)
    {
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _userTaskWriteRepository = userTaskWriteRepository;
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
    }

    public async Task<PostponeResultDto> Handle(PostponeTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userTask = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId && ut.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: true)
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new Exception("Görev bulunamadı.");

        if (userTask.PostponeCount >= MaxPostponeCount)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Bu görevi artık erteleyemezsin (maks {MaxPostponeCount} erteleme). Vazgeç ya da tamamla.");

        userTask.IsPostponed = true;
        userTask.PostponeCount++;
        userTask.PostponedTo = request.PostponeTo;
        userTask.Status = AppTaskStatus.Postponed;
        userTask.SkipReason = request.SkipReason;
        userTask.XpCompensationRate = PostponeXpRate;

        _userTaskWriteRepository.Update(userTask);

        // Kullanıcının toplam erteleme sayısını artır
        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString(), tracking: true);
        if (user != null)
        {
            user.TotalPostponeCount++;
            _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
        }

        // Yarın için aynı görevi Suggested statüsüyle yeni UserTask oluştur
        var tomorrowTask = new UserTask
        {
            AppUserId = request.UserId,
            AppTaskId = userTask.AppTaskId,
            Status = AppTaskStatus.Suggested,
            DueDate = request.PostponeTo.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue),
            IsPostponed = true,
            PostponeCount = userTask.PostponeCount,
            XpCompensationRate = PostponeXpRate
        };
        await _userTaskWriteRepository.AddAsync(tomorrowTask);
        await _userTaskWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new PostponeResultDto
        {
            UserTaskId = userTask.Id,
            PostponedTo = request.PostponeTo,
            PostponeCount = userTask.PostponeCount,
            RemainingPostpones = MaxPostponeCount - userTask.PostponeCount,
            XpCompensationRate = PostponeXpRate,
            Message = $"{userTask.AppTask.Title} {request.PostponeTo:dd.MM}'e ertelendi. Tamamlarsan {(int)(userTask.AppTask.BaseXP * PostponeXpRate)} XP kazanacaksın!"
        };
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\UserTasks\Commands\SelectTask\SelectTaskCommand.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.SelectTask;

public class SelectTaskCommandRequest : IRequest<UserTaskDto>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid UserTaskId { get; set; }
    /// <summary>SP-05: Kullanıcı limit uyarısını onaylayıp aşmak istiyorsa true.</summary>
    public bool ForceOverLimit { get; set; } = false;
}

public class SelectTaskCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<SelectTaskCommandRequest, UserTaskDto>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWriteRepository;
    private readonly IUserDailyMoodReadRepository _moodReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notificationService;

    public SelectTaskCommandHandler(
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWriteRepository,
        IUserDailyMoodReadRepository moodReadRepository,
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository,
        IAppNotificationService notificationService)
    {
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _userTaskWriteRepository = userTaskWriteRepository;
        _moodReadRepository = moodReadRepository;
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
    }

    public async Task<UserTaskDto> Handle(SelectTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // Kullanıcıyı çek
        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString(), tracking: true)
            ?? throw new Exception("Kullanıcı bulunamadı.");

        // ─── SP-05: DailyLimitRule ─────────────────────────────────────────
        if (user.TodayTaskCount >= user.DailyTaskLimit)
        {
            if (!request.ForceOverLimit || user.OverLimitWarningShown)
                throw new Exception($"Bugün için görev limitine ({user.DailyTaskLimit}) ulaştın. Yarın yeni görev alabilirsin veya limitini ayarlardan değiştirebilirsin.");

            // İlk kez aşıyor, uyarı flag'ini set et
            user.OverLimitWarningShown = true;
        }

        // ─── SP-05: ActiveLimitRule ────────────────────────────────────────
        if (user.ActiveTaskCount >= user.DailyTaskLimit * 2)
            throw new Exception($"Henüz tamamlanmamış {user.ActiveTaskCount} görevin var. Önce mevcut görevlerini tamamla veya ertele.");

        var userTask = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId && ut.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: true)
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new Exception("Görev bulunamadı.");

        if (userTask.Status != AppTaskStatus.Suggested)
            throw new Exception("Yalnızca önerilmiş görevler seçilebilir.");

        // Bugünkü mood'dan energy ve mood snapshot al
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);
        var todayMood = await _moodReadRepository
            .GetWhere(m => m.AppUserId == request.UserId && m.Date == today, tracking: false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        userTask.Status = AppTaskStatus.Selected;
        userTask.UserEnergyAtStart = todayMood?.EnergyLevel;
        userTask.UserMoodAtStart = todayMood?.MoodMode;

        // SP-05: Sayaçları güncelle
        user.TodayTaskCount++;
        user.ActiveTaskCount++;
        user.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        _userTaskWriteRepository.Update(userTask);
        _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
        await _userTaskWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
            request.UserId,
            "Görev seçildi!",
            $"'{userTask.AppTask?.Title}' görevini seçtin. Hadi başlayalım!",
            "TaskSelected");

        return new UserTaskDto
        {
            Id = userTask.Id,
            Title = userTask.AppTask?.Title ?? string.Empty,
            Description = userTask.AppTask?.Description ?? string.Empty,
            Xp = userTask.EarnedXp,
            BaseXP = userTask.AppTask?.BaseXP ?? 0,
            Difficulty = userTask.AppTask?.Difficulty.ToString() ?? string.Empty,
            IsCompleted = userTask.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed,
            AssignedAt = userTask.AssignedAt
        };
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\UserTasks\Commands\TaskActions\TaskActionsCommands.cs

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.PauseResumeTask;

// ─── Pause ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
public class PauseTaskCommandRequest : IRequest<UserTaskDto>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid UserTaskId { get; set; }
}

public class PauseTaskCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<PauseTaskCommandRequest, UserTaskDto>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _readRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _writeRepository;

    public PauseTaskCommandHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository readRepository, IUserTaskWriteRepository writeRepository)
    {
        _readRepository = readRepository;
        _writeRepository = writeRepository;
    }

    public async Task<UserTaskDto> Handle(PauseTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userTask = await _readRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId && ut.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: true)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new Exception("Görev bulunamadı.");

        if (userTask.Status != AppTaskStatus.InProgress)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Yalnızca devam eden görevler duraklatılabilir.");

        userTask.Status = AppTaskStatus.Paused;
        userTask.PausedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        _writeRepository.Update(userTask);
        await _writeRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new UserTaskDto { Id = userTask.Id, IsCompleted = false, Xp = userTask.EarnedXp, AssignedAt = userTask.AssignedAt };
    }
}

// ─── Resume ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
public class ResumeTaskCommandRequest : IRequest<UserTaskDto>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid UserTaskId { get; set; }
}

public class ResumeTaskCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<ResumeTaskCommandRequest, UserTaskDto>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _readRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _writeRepository;

    public ResumeTaskCommandHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository readRepository, IUserTaskWriteRepository writeRepository)
    {
        _readRepository = readRepository;
        _writeRepository = writeRepository;
    }

    public async Task<UserTaskDto> Handle(ResumeTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userTask = await _readRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId && ut.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: true)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new Exception("Görev bulunamadı.");

        if (userTask.Status != AppTaskStatus.Paused)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Yalnızca duraklatılmış görevler devam ettirilebilir.");

        if (userTask.PausedAt.HasValue)
        {
            var pausedMinutes = (int)(DateTime.UtcNow - userTask.PausedAt.Value).TotalMinutes;
            userTask.TotalPausedMinutes += pausedMinutes;
        }

        userTask.Status = AppTaskStatus.InProgress;
        userTask.PausedAt = null;

        _writeRepository.Update(userTask);
        await _writeRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new UserTaskDto { Id = userTask.Id, IsCompleted = false, Xp = userTask.EarnedXp, AssignedAt = userTask.AssignedAt };
    }
}

// ─── Abandon ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
public class AbandonTaskCommandRequest : IRequest<bool>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid UserTaskId { get; set; }
    public string? Reason { get; set; }
}

public class AbandonTaskCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AbandonTaskCommandRequest, bool>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _readRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _writeRepository;

    public AbandonTaskCommandHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository readRepository, IUserTaskWriteRepository writeRepository)
    {
        _readRepository = readRepository;
        _writeRepository = writeRepository;
    }

    public async Task<bool> Handle(AbandonTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userTask = await _readRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId && ut.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: true)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new Exception("Görev bulunamadı.");

        userTask.Status = AppTaskStatus.Abandoned;
        userTask.SkipReason = request.Reason;

        _writeRepository.Update(userTask);
        await _writeRepository.SaveAsync();

        return true;
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\UserTasks\Queries\GetDailyTaskPool\GetDailyTaskPoolQuery.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Queries.GetDailyTaskPool;

public class GetDailyTaskPoolQueryRequest : IRequest<DailyTaskPoolDto>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public int Count { get; set; } = 6;
}

public class GetDailyTaskPoolQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetDailyTaskPoolQueryRequest, DailyTaskPoolDto>
{
    private readonly IUserDailyMoodReadRepository _moodReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly ITaskRecommendationService _recommendationService;

    public GetDailyTaskPoolQueryHandler(
        IUserDailyMoodReadRepository moodReadRepository,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        ITaskRecommendationService recommendationService)
    {
        _moodReadRepository = moodReadRepository;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _recommendationService = recommendationService;
    }

    public async Task<DailyTaskPoolDto> Handle(GetDailyTaskPoolQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);

        // Bugün zaten önerilmiş görevler varsa onları döndür
        var existingSuggested = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId
                && ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Suggested
                && ut.DueDate.HasValue
                && DateOnly.FromDateTime(ut.DueDate.Value) == today, tracking: false)
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
                .ThenInclude(t => t.Category)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        // Bugünkü mood kaydını çek (yoksa default)
        var todayMood = await _moodReadRepository
            .GetWhere(m => m.AppUserId == request.UserId && m.Date == today, tracking: false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        var moodMode = todayMood?.MoodMode ?? MoodMode.Normal;
        var availableMinutes = todayMood?.AvailableMinutes ?? 30;
        var energyLevel = todayMood?.EnergyLevel ?? 3;
        var timeSlot = DayTimeSlotExtensions.FromHour(DateTime.UtcNow.Hour);

        if (existingSuggested.Count >= request.Count)
        {
            return new DailyTaskPoolDto
            {
                Tasks = existingSuggested.Select(ut => new TaskRecommendationDto
                {
                    UserTaskId = ut.Id,
                    AppTaskId = ut.AppTaskId,
                    Title = ut.AppTask.Title,
                    Description = ut.AppTask.Description,
                    CategoryName = ut.AppTask.Category?.Name ?? string.Empty,
                    EstimatedMinutes = ut.AppTask.EstimatedMinutes,
                    BaseXP = ut.AppTask.BaseXP,
                    Difficulty = ut.AppTask.Difficulty.ToString(),
                    WhyThisTask = ut.AppTask.WhyThisTask,
                    BadgeHint = ut.AppTask.BadgeHint,
                    MatchScore = 0.8,
                    RecommendationReason = "Bugün için daha önce önerildi"
                }).ToList(),
                TodayMood = moodMode,
                AvailableMinutes = availableMinutes,
                EnergyLevel = energyLevel,
                TimeSlot = timeSlot,
                PoolGeneratedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };
        }

        // Yeni öneri oluştur
        var recommendations = await _recommendationService.GetContextualRecommendationsAsync(
            request.UserId, moodMode, timeSlot, energyLevel, availableMinutes, request.Count);

        return new DailyTaskPoolDto
        {
            Tasks = recommendations,
            TodayMood = moodMode,
            AvailableMinutes = availableMinutes,
            EnergyLevel = energyLevel,
            TimeSlot = timeSlot,
            PoolGeneratedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
    }
}


==================================================
DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\UserTasks\Queries\GetUserTasks\GetUserTasksQueryHandler.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Queries.GetUserTasks;

public sealed class GetUserTasksQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetUserTasksQueryRequest, GetUserTasksQueryResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;

    public GetUserTasksQueryHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository)
    {
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<GetUserTasksQueryResponse> Handle(GetUserTasksQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        IQueryable<UserTask> query = _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: false)
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
                .ThenInclude(t => t.Category);

        if (request.CategoryId.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Where(ut => ut.AppTask.CategoryId == request.CategoryId.Value);
        }

        var tasks = await query
            .OrderBy(ut => ut.CompletedAt.HasValue)
            .ThenByDescending(ut => ut.AssignedAt)
            .Select(ut => new UserTaskDto
            {
                Id = ut.Id,
                Title = ut.AppTask.Title,
                Description = ut.AppTask.Description,
                Xp = ut.AppTask.BaseXP,
                BaseXP = ut.AppTask.BaseXP,
                Difficulty = ut.AppTask.Difficulty.ToString(),
                IsCompleted = ut.CompletedAt.HasValue,
                AssignedAt = ut.AssignedAt,
                CategoryName = ut.AppTask.Category != null ? ut.AppTask.Category.Name : null
            })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        return new GetUserTasksQueryResponse
        {
            Tasks = tasks
        };
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Common;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;

public sealed class AppTask : BaseEntity
{
    public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public Guid CategoryId { get; set; }
    public Category Category { get; set; } = default!;

    public int MinLevel { get; set; }
    public int MaxLevel { get; set; }
    public int BaseXP { get; set; }

    public DifficultyLevel Difficulty { get; set; }
    public bool IsDaily { get; set; }
    public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;

    // ─── SP-01: Yeni Alanlar ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    /// <summary>Görevin tahmini süresi (dakika)</summary>
    public int? EstimatedMinutes { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Hangi zaman dilimlerinde önerilsin — jsonb (ör: ["Morning","Noon"])</summary>
    [Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<DayTimeSlot>? RecommendedTimeSlots { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Görev küçük parçalara bölünebilir mi?</summary>
    public bool IsChunkable { get; set; } = false;

    /// <summary>Parçalanabilir görevlerde minimum parça süresi (dakika)</summary>
    public int? ChunkMinutes { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Görevi yapabilmek için minimum enerji seviyesi (1-5)</summary>
    public int MinEnergyLevel { get; set; } = 1;

    /// <summary>Görevi yapabilmek için maksimum enerji seviyesi (1-5)</summary>
    public int MaxEnergyLevel { get; set; } = 5;

    /// <summary>Görevin neden önerildiğini açıklayan metin</summary>
    public string? WhyThisTask { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Rozet ipucu metni (ör: "3 gün üst üste yaparsan Demir İrade rozetini açarsın!")</summary>
    public string? BadgeHint { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Hangi zayıflıkları hedefliyor — jsonb</summary>
    [Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<string>? TargetedWeaknesses { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Hangi hedefleri destekliyor — jsonb</summary>
    [Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<string>? TargetedGoals { get; set; }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Common;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;

public sealed class Challenge : BaseEntity
{
    public Guid ChallengerId { get; set; }
    public AppUser Challenger { get; set; } = default!;

    public Guid OpponentId { get; set; }
    public AppUser Opponent { get; set; } = default!;

    // ─── SP-05: Mücadele Tipi ve Durum ───────────────────────────────────
    public ChallengeType ChallengeType { get; set; } = ChallengeType.TaskCount;
    public ChallengeStatus Status { get; set; } = ChallengeStatus.Invited;

    public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string? Description { get; set; }

    /// <summary>CategoryFocus tipinde hedeflenen kategori.</summary>
    public Guid? TargetCategoryId { get; set; }
    public Category? TargetCategory { get; set; }

    /// <summary>SpecificTask tipinde hedeflenen görev.</summary>
    public Guid? TargetAppTaskId { get; set; }
    public AppTask? TargetAppTask { get; set; }

    /// <summary>TaskCount: kaç görev, XPRace: kaç XP. Null ise süre sonunda en yüksek kazanır.</summary>
    public int? TargetValue { get; set; }

    // ─── İlerleme ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public int ChallengerProgress { get; set; } = 0;
    public int OpponentProgress { get; set; } = 0;

    // ─── Sonuç ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public Guid? WinnerId { get; set; }
    public int WinnerXPBonus { get; set; } = 100;
    public int LoserXPPenalty { get; set; } = 0;

    // ─── Tarihler ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public DateTime StartDate { get; set; }
    public DateTime EndDate { get; set; }
    public DateTime InvitedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime? AcceptedAt { get; set; }

    // ─── Davet ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public string? ChallengerMessage { get; set; }
    public bool IsPublic { get; set; } = false;

    // ─── Geriye Dönük Uyumluluk (Eski alanları eşliyoruz) ─────────────────
    [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema.NotMapped]
    public bool IsActive => Status == ChallengeStatus.Active;

    [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema.NotMapped]
    public int TargetTaskCount => TargetValue ?? 0;

    [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema.NotMapped]
    public int WinnerBonusXP => WinnerXPBonus;

    // ─── Eski alanlar (CategoryFocus için hâlâ kullanılıyor) ──────────────
    public Guid? CategoryId { get; set; }
    public Category? Category { get; set; }

    // ─── Navigation Properties ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    public ICollection<ChallengeParticipant> Participants { get; set; } = default!;
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Common;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;

public sealed class UserGoal : BaseEntity
{
    public Guid AppUserId { get; set; }
    public AppUser AppUser { get; set; } = default!;

    public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public GoalType Type { get; set; }
    public int TargetValue { get; set; }
    public int CurrentValue { get; set; } = 0;

    public Guid? CategoryId { get; set; }
    public Category? Category { get; set; }

    public DateTime StartDate { get; set; }
    public DateTime EndDate { get; set; }
    public bool IsCompleted { get; set; } = false;
    public DateTime? CompletedAt { get; set; }
    public int BonusXP { get; set; } = 0;

    // ─── SP-05: Hedefler Sistemi Yeniden Tasarımı ─────────────────────────
    /// <summary>Emoji icon — kullanıcı seçer. Örn: 💪</summary>
    public string? Icon { get; set; }

    /// <summary>HEX renk kodu. Örn: #a78bfa</summary>
    public string? Color { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Bu hedef neden önemli? Kullanıcı yazar. Max 300 karakter.</summary>
    public string? Why { get; set; }

    /// <summary>İlerleme birimi: görev / km / sayfa / dakika / kez</summary>
    public string ProgressUnit { get; set; } = "görev";

    /// <summary>Hedef tamamlanınca kazanılacak bonus XP.</summary>
    public int CompletionXP { get; set; } = 500;

    /// <summary>Hedef tamamlanınca açılacak rozet (opsiyonel).</summary>
    public Guid? CompletionBadgeId { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Bu hedefle ilişkili kategori ID'leri — jsonb. Görev tamamlandığında bu hedef etkilenir.</summary>
    [Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<Guid>? LinkedCategoryIds { get; set; }

    /// <summary>True ise bu kategorideki her görev tamamlandığında CurrentValue++ artar.</summary>
    public bool AutoTrackByCategory { get; set; } = false;

    /// <summary>True ise XP kazandığında CurrentValue += kazanılan XP.</summary>
    public bool AutoTrackByXP { get; set; } = false;

    /// <summary>Hatırlatma aktif mi?</summary>
    public bool ReminderEnabled { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>Hatırlatma frekansı: daily / weekly / on_lag</summary>
    public string ReminderFrequency { get; set; } = "weekly";

    public DateTime? LastReminderAt { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Silinmez, arşivlenir.</summary>
    public bool IsArchived { get; set; } = false;

    public DateTime? ArchivedAt { get; set; }

    // ─── Navigation Properties ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    public ICollection<GoalMilestone> Milestones { get; set; } = default!;
}

    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public string FullName => $"{Name} {Surname}";
    public string UserName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Email { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public byte[] PasswordHash { get; set; } = default!;
    public byte[] PasswordSalt { get; set; } = default!;
    public Guid AppRoleId { get; set; }
    public AppRole AppRole { get; set; } = default!;

    // ─── Gamification ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public int TotalXP { get; set; } = 0;
    public double GeneralLevel { get; set; } = 1.0;

    // ─── Anket / Profil Alanları (SP-01) ──────────────────────────────────
    /// <summary>Kullanıcının hedefleri — jsonb (ör: ["fitness","career"])</summary>
    [Column("UserGoals", TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<string>? UserGoals { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Günlük ortalama müsait süre (dakika)</summary>
    public int? DailyAvailableMinutes { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Güçlü yönler — jsonb (ör: ["technology","writing"])</summary>
    [Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<string>? Strengths { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Zayıf yönler — jsonb (ör: ["discipline","focus"])</summary>
    [Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<string>? Weaknesses { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Motivasyon faktörü: leveling/badges/social/streaks/reports</summary>
    public string? MotivationFactor { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Haftada kaç görev tercih ediyor</summary>
    public int? PreferredTasksPerWeek { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Zorluk tercihi: easy/medium/hard/mixed</summary>
    public string? DifficultyPreference { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Profil anketi tamamlandı mı?</summary>
    public bool ProfileCompleted { get; set; } = false;

    /// <summary>Son 30 günün ortalama aktif dakikası (sistem hesaplar)</summary>
    public int AverageDailyActiveMinutes { get; set; } = 0;

    /// <summary>Toplam erteleme sayısı (tüm zamanlar)</summary>

    /// <summary>En çok atlanan kategori adı</summary>
    public string? MostSkippedCategory { get; set; }

    /// <summary>En verimli olunan sabah saati (ör: 07:00)</summary>
    public TimeOnly? PreferredMorningTime { get; set; }

    // ─── Chatbot & Bildirim Ayarları (SP-01) ──────────────────────────────
    /// <summary>Proaktif nudge bildirimleri aktif mi?</summary>
    public bool NudgeEnabled { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>Chatbot kişiliği: friendly/motivator/coach</summary>
    public string ChatPersonality { get; set; } = "friendly";

    /// <summary>Son aktif olma zamanı</summary>
    public DateTime? LastActiveAt { get; set; }

    // ─── SP-04: Tatil / Mola Modu ─────────────────────────────────────────
    /// <summary>Kullanıcı tatil/mola modunda mı? Bu sürede görev gelmez, streak korunur.</summary>
    public bool IsOnVacation { get; set; } = false;

    /// <summary>Tatil/mola başlangıç tarihi</summary>
    public DateOnly? VacationStartDate { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Tatil/mola bitiş tarihi</summary>

    /// <summary>Tatil nedeni: Tatil / Hastalık / Çok yoğunum</summary>
    public string? VacationReason { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Tatile girmeden önceki streak değeri (tatil sonrası geri yüklenir)</summary>
    public int FrozenStreak { get; set; } = 0;

    // ─── SP-05: Kontrollü Görev Alma Sistemi ──────────────────────────────
    /// <summary>Günde alabileceği maksimum görev sayısı. Varsayılan 3, kullanıcı 1-10 arası değiştirebilir.</summary>
    public int DailyTaskLimit { get; set; } = 3;

    /// <summary>Haftada alabileceği maksimum görev. PreferredTasksPerWeek'ten hesaplanır.</summary>
    public int WeeklyTaskLimit { get; set; } = 7;

    /// <summary>Şu an Selected + InProgress + Paused durumundaki görev sayısı. Her alım/tamamlamada güncellenir.</summary>
    public int ActiveTaskCount { get; set; } = 0;

    /// <summary>Bugün seçilen görev sayısı. Gece 00:00'de DailyQuestWorker tarafından sıfırlanır.</summary>
    public int TodayTaskCount { get; set; } = 0;

    /// <summary>Bu hafta tamamlanan görev sayısı. Pazartesi sabahı sıfırlanır.</summary>
    public int WeeklyCompletedCount { get; set; } = 0;

    /// <summary>Günlük limit dolduğunda uyarının bugün gösterilip gösterilmediği. Gece sıfırlanır.</summary>
    public bool OverLimitWarningShown { get; set; } = false;

    // ─── SP-05: Onboarding Sistemi ────────────────────────────────────────
    /// <summary>Onboarding tamamlandı mı?</summary>
    public bool OnboardingCompleted { get; set; } = false;

    public DateTime? OnboardingCompletedAt { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Onboarding versiyonu — ileride re-onboard için.</summary>
    public int OnboardingVersion { get; set; } = 1;

    /// <summary>Uyanış saati — nudge zamanlaması için.</summary>
    public TimeOnly? WakeUpTime { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Uyku saati — gece mesajlarını engelle.</summary>
    public TimeOnly? SleepTime { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Çalışma günleri jsonb — [1,2,3,4,5] (0=Pazar, 6=Cumartesi).</summary>
    [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema.Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<int>? WorkDays { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Yaşam tarzı: student/professional/freelancer/homemaker/retired/other</summary>
    public string? LifestyleType { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Yaş aralığı: 18-24/25-34/35-44/45-54/55+</summary>
    public string? AgeRange { get; set; }

    /// <summary>En çok odaklanmak istediği alan: health/career/education/social/mindfulness/finance</summary>
    public string? PrimaryFocusArea { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Motivasyonu öldüren faktörler — jsonb: ["boring_tasks","too_long"]</summary>
    [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema.Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<string>? MotivationKillers { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Tercih edilen görev süresi: micro_5/short_15/medium_30/long_60/any</summary>
    public string? PreferredTaskDuration { get; set; }

    /// <summary>İlk görev tamamlama deneyimi yaşandı mı?</summary>

    /// <summary>Seçilen avatar ID'si (1-20 predefined avatar).</summary>

    public ICollection<UserCategoryProgress> CategoryProgresses { get; set; } = default!;

}

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;

/// <summary>
/// Görev durum enum'u — SP-01 ile genişletildi.
/// Migration notu: eski Assigned=0 → Suggested=0 (otomatik uyumlu),
/// eski Completed=1 → Completed=4 (veri migration'ı gerekli).
/// </summary>
public enum AppTaskStatus
{
    Pending = 0,      // Bekliyor
    InProgress = 1,   // Timer çalışıyor
    Completed = 2,    // Tamamlandı
    Failed = 3,       // Başarısız
    Expired = 4,      // Süresi doldu
    Suggested = 5,    // Sistem tarafından önerildi, kullanıcı henüz seçmedi
    Selected = 6,     // Kullanıcı seçti, henüz başlamadı
    Paused = 7,       // Duraklat
    Postponed = 8,    // Ertelendi
    Compensated = 9,  // Ertelenmiş görev telafi edildi
    Abandoned = 10    // Vazgeçildi
}

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;

public enum DayTimeSlot
{
    Morning = 0,   // 06:00 - 11:00
    Noon = 1,      // 11:00 - 14:00
    Afternoon = 2, // 14:00 - 18:00
    Evening = 3,   // 18:00 - 22:00
    Night = 4      // 22:00 - 06:00
}

public static class DayTimeSlotExtensions
{
    public static DayTimeSlot FromHour(int hour)
    {
        return hour switch
        {
            >= 6 and < 11 => DayTimeSlot.Morning,
            >= 11 and < 14 => DayTimeSlot.Noon,
            >= 14 and < 18 => DayTimeSlot.Afternoon,
            >= 18 and < 22 => DayTimeSlot.Evening,
            _ => DayTimeSlot.Night
        };
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.AI;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.DailyQuest;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Social;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Token;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.AI;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.BehaviorAnalysis;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.DailyQuest;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Social;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Token;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure;

public static class ServiceRegistration
{
    public static void AddInfrastructureServices(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        // Mevcut servisler
        services.AddScoped<ITokenService, JwtTokenService>();
        services.AddScoped<IGamificationService, GamificationService>();
        services.AddScoped<IAchievementService, AchievementService>();
        services.AddScoped<IDailyQuestService, DailyQuestService>();
        services.AddScoped<IChallengeService, ChallengeService>();

        // SP-01: Bağlam-duyarlı görev öneri servisi (explicit namespace - isim çakışması önleme)
        services.AddScoped<LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.ITaskRecommendationService,
            LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.DailyQuest.TaskRecommendationService>();

        // SP-03: Davranış analizi servisi
        services.AddScoped<IUserBehaviorAnalysisService, UserBehaviorAnalysisService>();

        // AI Chat servisi — Python mikro servise bağlanır
        var aiServiceBaseUrl = configuration["AIService:BaseUrl"] ?? "http://localhost:5001";

        services.AddHttpClient<IAIChatService, AIChatService>(client =>
        {
            client.BaseAddress = new Uri(aiServiceBaseUrl);
            client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
        }).ConfigurePrimaryHttpMessageHandler(() => new HttpClientHandler
        {
            ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback = (sender, cert, chain, sslPolicyErrors) => true
        });
    }
}


==================================================
DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Infrastructure\LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure\Services\AI\AIChatService.cs
==================================================

using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.AI;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.AI;

/// <summary>
/// Python AI mikro servisine HTTP isteği atarak chatbot işlevselliği sağlar.
/// SP-02: Context-aware yanıt + action desteği eklendi.
/// </summary>
public class AIChatService : IAIChatService
{
    private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
    private readonly ILogger<AIChatService> _logger;

    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions _jsonOptions = new()
    {
        PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower,
        DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull
    };

    public AIChatService(HttpClient httpClient, ILogger<AIChatService> logger)
    {
        _httpClient = httpClient;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    // SP-01 uyumluluk — eski çağrılar için
    public async Task<ChatBotResponse> ProcessMessageAsync(Guid userId, string message)
    {
        try
        {
            var request = new AIChatRequest { UserId = userId.ToString(), Message = message };
            var response = await _httpClient.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/chat", request);
            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

            var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<AIChatApiResponse>();
            if (result == null) return GetFallbackResponse();

            return new ChatBotResponse
            {
                Intent = result.Intent,
                Confidence = result.Confidence,
                Response = result.Response,
                Sentiment = result.Sentiment,
                SentimentConfidence = result.SentimentConfidence,
                Suggestions = result.Suggestions
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "AI chat hatası. UserId: {UserId}", userId);
            return GetFallbackResponse();
        }
    }

    // SP-02: Context-aware yanıt
    public async Task<ChatResponseDto> ProcessMessageWithContextAsync(Guid userId, string message, ChatContextDto context)
    {
        try
        {
            var request = new AIChatContextRequest
            {
                UserId = userId.ToString(),
                Message = message,
                Context = new AIChatContextPayload
                {
                    UserName = context.UserName,
                    Personality = context.Personality,
                    TodayTasks = context.TodayTasks.Select(t => new AIChatTaskContext
                    {
                        Id = t.Id.ToString(),
                        Title = t.Title,
                        Status = t.Status,
                        Category = t.Category,
                        EstimatedMinutes = t.EstimatedMinutes
                    }).ToList(),
                    CompletedToday = context.CompletedToday,
                    CurrentStreak = context.CurrentStreak,
                    TotalXp = context.TotalXP,
                    TodayMood = context.TodayMood,
                    AvailableMinutes = context.AvailableMinutes
                }
            };

            var response = await _httpClient.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/chat", request, _jsonOptions);
            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

            var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<AIChatContextApiResponse>(_jsonOptions);
            if (result == null) return GetFallbackContextResponse();

            return new ChatResponseDto
            {
                Intent = result.Intent,
                IntentConfidence = result.IntentConfidence,
                Sentiment = result.Sentiment,
                SentimentConfidence = result.SentimentConfidence,
                UrgencyLevel = result.UrgencyLevel,
                Response = result.Response,
                Suggestions = result.Suggestions ?? new(),
                Actions = (result.Actions ?? new()).Select(a => new ChatActionDto
                {
                    Type = a.Type,
                    Label = a.Label,
                    TaskId = a.TaskId.HasValue ? a.TaskId : null,
                    Payload = a.Payload
                }).ToList(),
                SuggestedTasks = result.SuggestedTasks?.Select(t => new MiniTaskDto
                {
                    TaskId = Guid.TryParse(t.TaskId, out var tid) ? tid : Guid.Empty,
                    Title = t.Title,
                    CategoryName = t.CategoryName,
                    EstimatedMinutes = t.EstimatedMinutes,
                    BaseXP = t.BaseXp,
                    Difficulty = t.Difficulty,
                    WhyThisTask = t.WhyThisTask
                }).ToList(),
                ShouldShowMoodSelector = result.ShouldShowMoodSelector
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "AI context chat hatası. UserId: {UserId}", userId);
            return GetFallbackContextResponse();
        }
    }

    private static ChatBotResponse GetFallbackResponse() => new()
    {
        Intent = "unknown",
        Confidence = 0,
        Response = "Şu anda AI asistanına ulaşamıyorum. Lütfen daha sonra tekrar dene! 🔄",
        Sentiment = "neutral",
        SentimentConfidence = 0,
        Suggestions = new() { "Görevlerim", "Profilim", "Yardım" }
    };

    private static ChatResponseDto GetFallbackContextResponse() => new()
    {
        Intent = "unknown",
        IntentConfidence = 0,
        Sentiment = "neutral",
        SentimentConfidence = 0,
        UrgencyLevel = 0,
        Response = "Şu anda AI asistanına ulaşamıyorum. Lütfen daha sonra tekrar dene! 🔄",
        Suggestions = new() { "Görevlerim", "Profilim", "Yardım" },
        Actions = new()
    };

    // ─── Request/Response iç modelleri ───────────────────────────────────────

    private class AIChatRequest
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("user_id")] public string UserId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("message")] public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private class AIChatContextRequest
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("user_id")] public string UserId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("message")] public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("context")] public AIChatContextPayload? Context { get; set; }
    }

    private class AIChatContextPayload
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("user_name")] public string UserName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("personality")] public string Personality { get; set; } = "friendly";
        [JsonPropertyName("today_tasks")] public List<AIChatTaskContext> TodayTasks { get; set; } = new();
        [JsonPropertyName("completed_today")] public int CompletedToday { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("current_streak")] public int CurrentStreak { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("total_xp")] public int TotalXp { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("today_mood")] public string? TodayMood { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("available_minutes")] public int AvailableMinutes { get; set; }
    }

    private class AIChatTaskContext
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("id")] public string Id { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("title")] public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("status")] public string Status { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("category")] public string Category { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("estimated_minutes")] public int? EstimatedMinutes { get; set; }
    }

    private class AIChatApiResponse
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("intent")] public string Intent { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("confidence")] public float Confidence { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("response")] public string Response { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("sentiment")] public string Sentiment { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("sentiment_confidence")] public float SentimentConfidence { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("suggestions")] public List<string> Suggestions { get; set; } = new();
    }

    private class AIChatContextApiResponse
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("intent")] public string Intent { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("intent_confidence")] public float IntentConfidence { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("sentiment")] public string Sentiment { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("sentiment_confidence")] public float SentimentConfidence { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("urgency_level")] public int UrgencyLevel { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("response")] public string Response { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("suggestions")] public List<string>? Suggestions { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("actions")] public List<AIChatActionItem>? Actions { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("suggested_tasks")] public List<AIChatMiniTask>? SuggestedTasks { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("should_show_mood_selector")] public bool ShouldShowMoodSelector { get; set; }
    }

    private class AIChatActionItem
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("type")] public string Type { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("label")] public string Label { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("task_id")] public Guid? TaskId { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("payload")] public Dictionary<string, string>? Payload { get; set; }
    }

    private class AIChatMiniTask
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("task_id")] public string TaskId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("title")] public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("category_name")] public string CategoryName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("estimated_minutes")] public int? EstimatedMinutes { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("base_xp")] public int BaseXp { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("difficulty")] public string Difficulty { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("why_this_task")] public string? WhyThisTask { get; set; }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.AI;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.ML;
using Microsoft.ML.Data;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.AI;

public class TaskRecommendationService : ITaskRecommendationService
{
    private readonly MLContext _mlContext;
    private readonly ILogger<TaskRecommendationService> _logger;
    private ITransformer? _model;
    
    // Uygulama kök dizininde Models klasörü
    private readonly string _modelPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "Models", "task_recommendation_model.zip");

    public bool IsModelReady => _model != null;

    public TaskRecommendationService(ILogger<TaskRecommendationService> logger)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _mlContext = new MLContext(seed: 42);
        LoadModel();
    }

    private void LoadModel()
    {
        try
        {
            if (File.Exists(_modelPath))
            {
                _model = _mlContext.Model.Load(_modelPath, out var schema);
                _logger.LogInformation("ML.NET görev öneri modeli başarıyla yüklendi.");
            }
            else
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("ML.NET görev öneri modeli bulunamadı: {ModelPath}. Model eğitilene kadar kural tabanlı öneri kullanılacak.", _modelPath);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "ML.NET görev öneri modeli yüklenirken hata oluştu.");
        }
    }

    public async Task<List<Guid>> GetRecommendedTasksAsync(AppUser user, List<AppTask> availableTasks, int count = 3)
    {
        if (availableTasks == null || !availableTasks.Any())
            return new List<Guid>();

        // Eğer model yoksa Kural Tabanlı Fallback kullan
        if (!IsModelReady)
        {
            return GetRuleBasedRecommendations(user, availableTasks, count);
        }

        try 
        {
            var predEngine = _mlContext.Model.CreatePredictionEngine<TaskInteractionData, TaskPrediction>(_model);

            var scoredTasks = availableTasks.Select(task =>
            {
                var userCatLevelObj = user.CategoryProgresses?.FirstOrDefault(c => c.CategoryId == task.CategoryId);
                float userCatLevel = userCatLevelObj != null ? userCatLevelObj.Level : 1f;

                var inputData = new TaskInteractionData
                {
                    UserLevel = (float)user.GeneralLevel,
                    UserCategoryLevel = userCatLevel,
                    TaskDifficulty = (float)task.Difficulty,
                    TaskBaseXP = task.BaseXP,
                    DayOfWeek = (float)DateTime.Now.DayOfWeek,
                    HourOfDay = DateTime.Now.Hour,
                    UserCompletedTaskCount = user.UserTasks?.Count(ut => ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed) ?? 0,
                    UserStreakDays = 0 // Eğer streak prop'u varsa kullanılabilir, şu an sabit
                };

                var prediction = predEngine.Predict(inputData);

                return new 
                {
                    Task = task,
                    Score = prediction.Probability
                };
            })
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.Score)
            .Take(count)
            .Select(x => x.Task.Id)
            .ToList();

            return scoredTasks.Any() ? scoredTasks : GetRuleBasedRecommendations(user, availableTasks, count);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "ML modeli ile görev tahmini yapılırken hata, fallback kullanılacak.");
            return GetRuleBasedRecommendations(user, availableTasks, count);
        }
    }

    private List<Guid> GetRuleBasedRecommendations(AppUser user, List<AppTask> availableTasks, int count)
    {
        return availableTasks.Where(task => 
        {
            if (task.MinLevel > user.GeneralLevel) return false;

            if (task.CategoryId != Guid.Empty && user.CategoryProgresses != null)
            {
                var userCatProgress = user.CategoryProgresses.FirstOrDefault(cp => cp.CategoryId == task.CategoryId);
                int userCatLevel = userCatProgress?.Level ?? 1;

                switch (task.Difficulty)
                {
                    case DifficultyLevel.Medium:
                        if (userCatLevel < 2) return false;
                        break;
                    case DifficultyLevel.Hard:
                        if (userCatLevel < 4) return false;
                        break;
                }
            }
            return true;
        })
        .OrderBy(x => Guid.NewGuid()) // Geçici kural: randomize et
        .Take(count)
        .Select(t => t.Id)
        .ToList();
    }

    public async Task<bool> TrainModelAsync(List<UserTaskInteraction> trainingData)
    {
        if (trainingData == null || trainingData.Count < 50)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Model eğitmek için yetersiz veri. En az 50 kayıt gerekli. Mevcut: {Count}", trainingData?.Count ?? 0);
            return false;
        }

        try
        {
            var dataMapped = trainingData.Select(x => new TaskInteractionData
            {
                UserLevel = x.UserLevel,
                UserCategoryLevel = x.UserCategoryLevel,
                TaskDifficulty = x.TaskDifficulty,
                TaskBaseXP = x.TaskBaseXP,
                DayOfWeek = x.DayOfWeek,
                HourOfDay = x.HourOfDay,
                UserCompletedTaskCount = x.UserCompletedTaskCount,
                UserStreakDays = x.UserStreakDays,
                WasCompleted = x.WasCompleted
            }).ToList();

            var dataView = _mlContext.Data.LoadFromEnumerable(dataMapped);

            var pipeline = _mlContext.Transforms.Concatenate("Features",
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.UserLevel),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.UserCategoryLevel),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.TaskDifficulty),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.TaskBaseXP),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.DayOfWeek),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.HourOfDay),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.UserCompletedTaskCount),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.UserStreakDays))
                .Append(_mlContext.Transforms.NormalizeMinMax("Features"))
                .Append(_mlContext.BinaryClassification.Trainers.FastTree(labelColumnName: "WasCompleted", featureColumnName: "Features"));

            _model = pipeline.Fit(dataView);

            var dir = Path.GetDirectoryName(_modelPath);
            if (dir != null && !Directory.Exists(dir))
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
            }

            _mlContext.Model.Save(_model, dataView.Schema, _modelPath);
            _logger.LogInformation("ML.NET modeli başarıyla eğitildi ve {Path} konumuna kaydedildi.", _modelPath);

            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Model eğitilirken bir hata oluştu.");
            return false;
        }
    }

    // --- ML.NET Data Models ---
    public class TaskInteractionData
    {
        public float UserLevel { get; set; }
        public float UserCategoryLevel { get; set; }
        public float TaskDifficulty { get; set; }
        public float TaskBaseXP { get; set; }
        public float DayOfWeek { get; set; }
        public float HourOfDay { get; set; }
        public float UserCompletedTaskCount { get; set; }
        public float UserStreakDays { get; set; }
        public bool WasCompleted { get; set; }
    }

    public class TaskPrediction
    {
        [ColumnName("PredictedLabel")]
        public bool WillComplete { get; set; }
        public float Probability { get; set; }
        public float Score { get; set; }
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.BehaviorAnalysis;

/// <summary>
/// SP-03: Son 30 günün UserTask davranışını analiz eder.
/// Haftalık rapor sonrası WeeklyReportWorker tarafından tetiklenir.
/// </summary>
public sealed class UserBehaviorAnalysisService : IUserBehaviorAnalysisService
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly ILogger<UserBehaviorAnalysisService> _logger;

    public UserBehaviorAnalysisService(
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        ILogger<UserBehaviorAnalysisService> logger)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task AnalyzeAndUpdateUserBehaviorAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var cutoff = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-30);

            var tasks = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
                .Include(ut => ut.AppTask).ThenInclude(t => t!.Category)
                .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == userId && ut.AssignedAt >= cutoff)
                .ToListAsync(ct);

            if (!tasks.Any()) return;

            var user = await _userReadRepository
                .GetWhere(u => u.Id == userId, tracking: true)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);
            if (user == null) return;

            // ── AverageDailyActiveMinutes — EstimatedMinutes proxy olarak kullan ──
            var completedTasks = tasks.Where(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed).ToList();
            user.AverageDailyActiveMinutes = completedTasks.Any()
                ? (int)completedTasks
                    .Where(t => t.AppTask?.EstimatedMinutes > 0)
                    .DefaultIfEmpty()
                    .Average(t => t?.AppTask?.EstimatedMinutes ?? 0)
                : 0;

            // ── MostSkippedCategory ────────────────────────────────────────
            var skippedByCategory = tasks
                .Where(t => t.Status is AppTaskStatus.Abandoned or AppTaskStatus.Expired)
                .GroupBy(t => t.AppTask?.Category?.Name ?? "Diğer")
                .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
                .FirstOrDefault();
            user.MostSkippedCategory = skippedByCategory?.Key;

            // ── TotalPostponeCount ─────────────────────────────────────────
            user.TotalPostponeCount = tasks.Sum(t => t.PostponeCount);

            // ── PreferredMorningTime — en çok tamamlanan saat dilimi ───────
            var bestSlot = completedTasks
                .Where(t => t.DayTimeSlot.HasValue)
                .GroupBy(t => t.DayTimeSlot!.Value)
                .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
                .Select(g => g.Key)
                .FirstOrDefault();
            user.PreferredMorningTime = SlotToTime(bestSlot);

            _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
            await _userWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

            _logger.LogInformation("SP-03: Davranış analizi güncellendi — UserId: {UserId}", userId);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "SP-03: Davranış analizi hatası — UserId: {UserId}", userId);
        }
    }

    public async Task<UserBehaviorSummaryDto> GetBehaviorSummaryAsync(
        Guid userId, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var cutoff = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-30);
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);

        var tasks = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask).ThenInclude(t => t!.Category)
            .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == userId && ut.AssignedAt >= cutoff)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        var completed = tasks.Where(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed).ToList();
        var abandoned = tasks.Where(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Abandoned).ToList();

        // ── Tamamlama oranı ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        double completionRate = tasks.Count > 0
            ? (double)completed.Count / tasks.Count
            : 0.0;

        // ── En çok tamamlanan / atlanan kategori ──────────────────────────
        var mostCompleted = completed
            .GroupBy(t => t.AppTask?.Category?.Name ?? "Diğer")
            .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
            .FirstOrDefault()?.Key;

        var mostSkipped = tasks
            .Where(t => t.Status is AppTaskStatus.Abandoned or AppTaskStatus.Expired)
            .GroupBy(t => t.AppTask?.Category?.Name ?? "Diğer")
            .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
            .FirstOrDefault()?.Key;

        // ── En verimli saat dilimi ─────────────────────────────────────────
        var bestSlot = completed
            .Where(t => t.DayTimeSlot.HasValue)
            .GroupBy(t => t.DayTimeSlot!.Value)
            .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
            .Select(g => g.Key)
            .FirstOrDefault();
        string bestTimeLabel = SlotToLabel(bestSlot);

        // ── Ortalama aktif dakika (EstimatedMinutes proxy) ─────────────────
        int avgMinutes = completed.Any(t => t.AppTask?.EstimatedMinutes > 0)
            ? (int)completed.Where(t => t.AppTask?.EstimatedMinutes > 0)
                .Average(t => t.AppTask!.EstimatedMinutes!.Value)
            : 0;

        // ── Streak hesaplama ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        var (current, longest) = CalculateStreaks(completed, today);

        // ── Son 7 gün günlük özet ──────────────────────────────────────────
        var weeklyProgress = Enumerable.Range(0, 7)
            .Select(i =>
            {
                var date = today.AddDays(-6 + i);
                // AssignedAt her zaman non-nullable DateTime
                var dayTasks = tasks.Where(t =>
                    DateOnly.FromDateTime(t.AssignedAt) == date).ToList();
                return new DayProgressDto
                {
                    Date = date,
                    DayName = date.DayOfWeek switch
                    {
                        DayOfWeek.Monday    => "Pzt",
                        DayOfWeek.Tuesday   => "Sal",
                        DayOfWeek.Wednesday => "Çar",
                        DayOfWeek.Thursday  => "Per",
                        DayOfWeek.Friday    => "Cum",
                        DayOfWeek.Saturday  => "Cmt",
                        DayOfWeek.Sunday    => "Paz",
                        _                   => "?"
                    },
                    CompletedCount  = dayTasks.Count(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed),
                    PostponedCount  = dayTasks.Count(t => t.PostponeCount > 0),
                    AbandonedCount  = dayTasks.Count(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Abandoned),
                    TotalXpEarned   = dayTasks
                        .Where(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed)
                        .Sum(t => (int)((t.AppTask?.BaseXP ?? 0) * (double)t.XpCompensationRate))
                };
            })
            .ToList();

        // ── Insight mesajı ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
        string? insight = BuildInsightMessage(completionRate, mostSkipped, bestTimeLabel, current);

        return new UserBehaviorSummaryDto
        {
            AverageDailyActiveMinutes  = avgMinutes,
            BestTimeOfDay              = bestTimeLabel,
            MostCompletedCategory      = mostCompleted,
            MostSkippedCategory        = mostSkipped,
            CompletionRateLast30Days   = Math.Round(completionRate, 2),
            TotalCompletedLast30Days   = completed.Count,
            TotalPostponeCount         = tasks.Sum(t => t.PostponeCount),
            AbandonedTaskCount         = abandoned.Count,
            CurrentStreak              = current,
            LongestStreak              = longest,
            WeeklyProgress             = weeklyProgress,
            InsightMessage             = insight
        };
    }

    // ─── Yardımcı ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static (int current, int longest) CalculateStreaks(
        List<Domain.Entities.UserTask> completed, DateOnly today)
    {
        var completedDays = completed
            .Where(t => t.CompletedAt.HasValue)
            .Select(t => DateOnly.FromDateTime(t.CompletedAt!.Value))
            .Distinct()
            .OrderByDescending(d => d)
            .ToList();

        if (!completedDays.Any()) return (0, 0);

        int current = 0;
        var check = today;
        foreach (var day in completedDays)
        {
            if (day == check) { current++; check = check.AddDays(-1); }
            else if (day < check) break;
        }

        int longest = 0, streak = 1;
        var sorted = completedDays.OrderBy(d => d).ToList();
        for (int i = 1; i < sorted.Count; i++)
        {
            streak = sorted[i] == sorted[i - 1].AddDays(1) ? streak + 1 : 1;
            if (streak > longest) longest = streak;
        }

        return (current, Math.Max(longest, current));
    }

    private static TimeOnly? SlotToTime(DayTimeSlot? slot) => slot switch
    {
        DayTimeSlot.Morning   => new TimeOnly(7, 0),
        DayTimeSlot.Noon      => new TimeOnly(12, 0),
        DayTimeSlot.Afternoon => new TimeOnly(15, 0),
        DayTimeSlot.Evening   => new TimeOnly(19, 0),
        DayTimeSlot.Night     => new TimeOnly(22, 0),
        _                     => null
    };

    private static string SlotToLabel(DayTimeSlot? slot) => slot switch
    {
        DayTimeSlot.Morning   => "Sabah",
        DayTimeSlot.Noon      => "Öğle",
        DayTimeSlot.Afternoon => "Öğleden Sonra",
        DayTimeSlot.Evening   => "Akşam",
        DayTimeSlot.Night     => "Gece",
        _                     => "Bilinmiyor"
    };

    private static string? BuildInsightMessage(
        double completionRate, string? mostSkipped, string bestTime, int streak)
    {
        if (completionRate >= 0.8)
            return $"Harika! Son 30 günde %{(int)(completionRate * 100)} tamamlama oranıyla mükemmel gidiyorsun. 🏆";
        if (completionRate < 0.4 && mostSkipped != null)
            return $"'{mostSkipped}' kategorisinde zorlanıyorsun. Bu hafta oradan 1 küçük görev dene. 💪";
        if (streak >= 7)
            return $"{streak} günlük serine devam et! Yarın da bir görev tamamla. 🔥";
        if (bestTime != "Bilinmiyor")
            return $"En verimli zamanın {bestTime}. Görevlerini bu saate planlamayı dene. ⏰";
        return null;
    }
}
