using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.DailyQuest;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.DailyQuest;
public class DailyQuestService : IDailyQuestService
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppTaskReadRepository _taskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWriteRepository;
    private readonly ILogger<DailyQuestService> _logger;
    private readonly ITaskRecommendationService _taskRecommendationService;
    private readonly IUserDailyMoodReadRepository _moodReadRepository;

    public DailyQuestService(
        ILogger<DailyQuestService> logger,
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWriteRepository,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IAppTaskReadRepository taskReadRepository,
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IUserDailyMoodReadRepository moodReadRepository,
        ITaskRecommendationService taskRecommendationService)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _taskReadRepository = taskReadRepository;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _userTaskWriteRepository = userTaskWriteRepository;
        _logger = logger;
        _moodReadRepository = moodReadRepository;
        _taskRecommendationService = taskRecommendationService;
    }

    public async Task DistributeDailyQuestsAsync()
    {
        _logger.LogInformation($"Toplu görev dağıtımı başlıyor... {DateTime.UtcNow}");

        var users = await _userReadRepository.GetAll(false)
            .Include(u => u.CategoryProgresses)
            .ToListAsync();

        foreach (var user in users)
        {
            // SP-04: Tatil modundaki kullanıcılara görev atama
            if (user.IsOnVacation)
            {
                _logger.LogDebug("DailyQuestWorker: {UserId} tatil modunda, görev atlanıyor.", user.Id);
                continue;
            }

            var hasTasksToday = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
                .AnyAsync(ut => ut.AppUserId == user.Id && ut.AssignedAt.Date == DateTime.UtcNow.Date);

            if (!hasTasksToday)
            {
                await AssignTasksToSpecificUser(user);
            }
        }
    }

    public async Task<List<Guid>> AssignQuestsToUserAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var user = await _userReadRepository.Table
            .Include(u => u.CategoryProgresses)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == userId);

        if (user == null) throw new Exception("Kullanıcı bulunamadı.");

        var hasActiveTasks = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
            .AnyAsync(ut => ut.AppUserId == userId
                && (ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Suggested || ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Selected || ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.InProgress));

        if (hasActiveTasks)
        {
            throw new Exception("Mevcut görevlerini tamamlamadan yeni görev alamazsın!");
        }

        return await AssignTasksToSpecificUser(user);
    }

    private async Task<List<Guid>> AssignTasksToSpecificUser(AppUser user)
    {
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);
        var todayMood = await _moodReadRepository
            .GetWhere(m => m.AppUserId == user.Id && m.Date == today, tracking: false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        // SP-01: Akıllı öneri motorunu (ML.NET tabanlı) kullanarak en uygun 6 görevi seç
        // Bu servis kendi içinde UserTask kayıtlarını Suggested olarak oluşturur ve kaydeder.
        var recommendations = await _taskRecommendationService.GetContextualRecommendationsAsync(
            user.Id,
            todayMood?.MoodMode ?? MoodMode.Normal,
            DayTimeSlot.Morning, // Default değer, gerekirse saate göre hesaplanabilir
            todayMood?.EnergyLevel ?? 3,
            todayMood?.AvailableMinutes ?? 30,
            6);

        _logger.LogInformation($"✅ {user.UserName} kullanıcısına {recommendations.Count} akıllı görev önerildi.");

        return recommendations.Select(r => r.UserTaskId).ToList();
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.DailyQuest;

/// <summary>
/// SP-01 + SP-03: Bağlam-duyarlı görev öneri servisi.
/// SP-01: 6 faktörlü scoring: GoalMatch, TimeMatch, EnergyMatch, DifficultyMatch, WeaknessTarget, StrengthMatch
/// SP-03: +3 faktör: BehaviorBonus, MostSkippedPenalty, TimeOfDayBonus
/// </summary>
public sealed class TaskRecommendationService : ITaskRecommendationService
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppTaskReadRepository _taskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWriteRepository;

    public TaskRecommendationService(
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppTaskReadRepository taskReadRepository,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWriteRepository)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _taskReadRepository = taskReadRepository;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _userTaskWriteRepository = userTaskWriteRepository;
    }

    public async Task<List<TaskRecommendationDto>> GetContextualRecommendationsAsync(
        Guid userId,
        MoodMode mood,
        DayTimeSlot timeSlot,
        int energyLevel,
        int availableMinutes,
        int count = 6)
    {
        // Mood override: Overwhelmed ise max 1 görev
        if (mood == MoodMode.Overwhelmed) count = 1;

        // Kullanıcı profilini al
        var user = await _userReadRepository
            .GetWhere(u => u.Id == userId, tracking: false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        if (user == null) throw new Exception("Kullanıcı bulunamadı.");

        // Bugün zaten görev atanmış AppTaskId'leri bul (hariç tut)
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);
        var assignedTaskIds = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.AppUserId == userId
                && ut.Status != AppTaskStatus.Expired
                && ut.Status != AppTaskStatus.Abandoned
                && (ut.DueDate == null || DateOnly.FromDateTime(ut.DueDate.Value) == today),
                tracking: false)
            .Select(ut => ut.AppTaskId)
            .ToListAsync();

        // Uygun görevleri çek
        var candidateTasks = await _taskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(t => t.IsActive
                && !assignedTaskIds.Contains(t.Id)
                && t.MinLevel <= (int)Math.Floor(user.GeneralLevel),
                tracking: false)
            .Include(t => t.Category)
            .ToListAsync();

        // Her görev için puan hesapla
        var scored = candidateTasks
            .Select(task => new
            {
                Task = task,
                Score = CalculateScore(task, user, mood, timeSlot, energyLevel, availableMinutes),
                Reason = BuildReason(task, user, mood, timeSlot, energyLevel)
            })
            .Where(x => x.Score > 0)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.Score)
            .Take(count)
            .ToList();

        // UserTask olarak kaydet (Status=Suggested)
        var result = new List<TaskRecommendationDto>();
        foreach (var item in scored)
        {
            var userTask = new Domain.Entities.UserTask
            {
                AppUserId = userId,
                AppTaskId = item.Task.Id,
                Status = AppTaskStatus.Suggested,
                DayTimeSlot = timeSlot,
                DueDate = DateTime.UtcNow.Date.AddDays(1).AddTicks(-1) // gün sonu
            };
            await _userTaskWriteRepository.AddAsync(userTask);

            result.Add(new TaskRecommendationDto
            {
                UserTaskId = userTask.Id,
                AppTaskId = item.Task.Id,
                Title = item.Task.Title,
                Description = item.Task.Description,
                CategoryName = item.Task.Category?.Name ?? string.Empty,
                EstimatedMinutes = item.Task.EstimatedMinutes,
                BaseXP = item.Task.BaseXP,
                Difficulty = item.Task.Difficulty.ToString(),
                WhyThisTask = item.Task.WhyThisTask,
                BadgeHint = item.Task.BadgeHint,
                MatchScore = Math.Round(item.Score, 2),
                RecommendationReason = item.Reason
            });
        }

        await _userTaskWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
        return result;
    }

    private static double CalculateScore(
        Domain.Entities.AppTask task,
        Domain.Entities.Identity.AppUser user,
        MoodMode mood,
        DayTimeSlot timeSlot,
        int energyLevel,
        int availableMinutes)
    {
        double score = 0.0;

        // 1. GoalMatch (0.25) — kullanıcının hedefleriyle görev kategorisi eşleşiyor mu?
        var userGoals = user.UserGoals ?? new List<string>();
        var taskGoals = task.TargetedGoals ?? new List<string>();
        if (userGoals.Any() && (userGoals.Contains(task.Category?.Name?.ToLower() ?? "") || taskGoals.Any(g => userGoals.Contains(g))))
            score += 0.25;

        // 2. TimeMatch (0.20) — görev müsait süreye sığıyor mu?
        bool timeSlotMatch = task.RecommendedTimeSlots == null || !task.RecommendedTimeSlots.Any()
            || task.RecommendedTimeSlots.Contains(timeSlot);
        bool durationFits = !task.EstimatedMinutes.HasValue || task.EstimatedMinutes.Value <= availableMinutes;
        if (timeSlotMatch && durationFits) score += 0.20;

        // 3. EnergyMatch (0.20) — enerji seviyesi görevin gereksinimlerine uyuyor mu?
        if (energyLevel >= task.MinEnergyLevel && energyLevel <= task.MaxEnergyLevel)
            score += 0.20;

        // 4. DifficultyMatch (0.15)
        var diffPref = user.DifficultyPreference?.ToLower() ?? "mixed";
        bool diffMatch = diffPref == "mixed" || task.Difficulty.ToString().ToLower() == diffPref;
        if (diffMatch) score += 0.15;

        // 5. WeaknessTarget (0.10) — görev kullanıcının zayıflıklarını hedefliyor mu?
        var userWeaknesses = user.Weaknesses ?? new List<string>();
        var taskWeaknesses = task.TargetedWeaknesses ?? new List<string>();
        if (userWeaknesses.Any() && taskWeaknesses.Any(w => userWeaknesses.Contains(w)))
            score += 0.10;

        // 6. StrengthMatch (0.10)
        var userStrengths = user.Strengths ?? new List<string>();
        if (userStrengths.Any() && userStrengths.Any(s =>
            task.Description.Contains(s, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            task.Title.Contains(s, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            score += 0.10;

        // ── SP-03: Davranış Faktörleri ──────────────────────────────────

        // 7. BehaviorBonus (0.10) — Bu kategoride geçmişte başarılıysa bonus
        //    user.MostSkippedCategory dolu ve bu görev o kategoride değilse bonus
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(user.MostSkippedCategory))
        {
            bool isMostSkipped = string.Equals(
                task.Category?.Name, user.MostSkippedCategory,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            // 8. MostSkippedPenalty (-0.15)
            if (isMostSkipped)
                score -= 0.15;
            else
                score += 0.10; // BehaviorBonus — farklı kategori başarı şansı daha yüksek
        }

        // 9. TimeOfDayBonus (0.05) — Kullanıcının en verimli saat dilimiyle eşleşiyorsa bonus
        if (user.PreferredMorningTime.HasValue)
        {
            var preferredSlot = user.PreferredMorningTime.Value.Hour switch
            {
                >= 6 and < 11 => DayTimeSlot.Morning,
                >= 11 and < 14 => DayTimeSlot.Noon,
                >= 14 and < 18 => DayTimeSlot.Afternoon,
                >= 18 and < 22 => DayTimeSlot.Evening,
                _ => DayTimeSlot.Night
            };
            bool slotMatch = task.RecommendedTimeSlots == null || !task.RecommendedTimeSlots.Any()
                || task.RecommendedTimeSlots.Contains(preferredSlot);
            if (slotMatch && preferredSlot == timeSlot)
                score += 0.05;
        }

        // Mood override bonus'lar
        if (mood == MoodMode.Energetic && task.MinEnergyLevel >= 4)
            score += 0.10;
        if (mood == MoodMode.LimitedTime && task.EstimatedMinutes <= 15)
            score += 0.10;
        if (mood == MoodMode.Tired && task.MaxEnergyLevel <= 2)
            score += 0.05;
        if ((mood == MoodMode.Tired || mood == MoodMode.Overwhelmed) && task.MinEnergyLevel > 3)
            score -= 0.20; // Yorgunken zorlu görevleri alt sıralara it

        return Math.Max(0, score);
    }

    private static string BuildReason(
        Domain.Entities.AppTask task,
        Domain.Entities.Identity.AppUser user,
        MoodMode mood,
        DayTimeSlot timeSlot,
        int energyLevel)
    {
        var parts = new List<string>();

        var userGoals = user.UserGoals ?? new List<string>();
        if (userGoals.Any(g => task.Category?.Name?.ToLower().Contains(g) == true))
            parts.Add($"{task.Category?.Name} hedefine uygun");

        if (task.EstimatedMinutes.HasValue)
            parts.Add($"{task.EstimatedMinutes} dk içinde tamamlanabilir");

        var slotLabel = timeSlot switch
        {
            DayTimeSlot.Morning => "sabah verimliliğini artırır",
            DayTimeSlot.Noon => "öğle molasında yapılabilir",
            DayTimeSlot.Afternoon => "öğleden sonra enerjini kullanır",
            DayTimeSlot.Evening => "akşam rutinine uygun",
            DayTimeSlot.Night => "gece sessizliğinde odaklanmana yardımcı olur",
            _ => string.Empty
        };
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(slotLabel)) parts.Add(slotLabel);

        if (mood == MoodMode.LimitedTime) parts.Add("az vaktinle yapılabilir");
        if (mood == MoodMode.Tired && task.MaxEnergyLevel <= 2) parts.Add("yorgunken bile kaldırabilirsin");

        return parts.Count > 0
            ? string.Join(", ", parts)
            : "Senin için önerilen bir görev";
    }
}

using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Gamification;

public class AchievementService : IAchievementService
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAchievementReadRepository _achievementReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserAchievementReadRepository _userAchievementReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserAchievementWriteRepository _userAchievementWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notificationService;
    private readonly ILogger<AchievementService> _logger;

    public AchievementService(
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAchievementReadRepository achievementReadRepository,
        IUserAchievementReadRepository userAchievementReadRepository,
        IUserAchievementWriteRepository userAchievementWriteRepository,
        IAppNotificationService notificationService,
        ILogger<AchievementService> logger)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _achievementReadRepository = achievementReadRepository;
        _userAchievementReadRepository = userAchievementReadRepository;
        _userAchievementWriteRepository = userAchievementWriteRepository;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task CheckAchievementsAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var user = await _userReadRepository.Table
            .Include(u => u.UserTasks)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == userId);

        if (user == null) return;

        var allAchievements = await _achievementReadRepository.GetAll(false).ToListAsync();
        var userAchievementIds = await _userAchievementReadRepository.Table
            .Where(ua => ua.AppUserId == userId)
            .Select(ua => ua.AchievementId)
            .ToListAsync();

        var completedTasksCount = user.UserTasks?.Count(ut => ut.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Completed) ?? 0;

        foreach (var ach in allAchievements)
        {
            // Eger onceden acildiysa atla
            if (userAchievementIds.Contains(ach.Id)) continue;

            bool isEarned = false;

            // Simple rule checks (Based on enum string or logic)
            // Varsayılarak AchievementType enum veya isimlendirme:
            if (ach.Title.Contains("Seviye") && user.GeneralLevel >= ach.RequiredCount)
            {
                isEarned = true;
            }
            else if (ach.Title.Contains("Görev") && completedTasksCount >= ach.RequiredCount)
            {
                isEarned = true;
            }
            // Dilersen burada AchievementType Enum'una göre net kontroller yapılabilir.

            if (isEarned)
            {
                var newUserAchievement = new UserAchievement
                {
                    AppUserId = userId,
                    AchievementId = ach.Id,
                    EarnedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    IsCompleted = true
                };

                await _userAchievementWriteRepository.AddAsync(newUserAchievement);
                
                // Anlık Bildirim (SignalR + veritabanı)
                await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    userId, 
                    $"🏆 Yeni Başarım: {ach.Title}!", 
                    $"Tebrikler! {ach.Description} görevini başarıyla tamamladın.", 
                    "Achievement");
                
                _logger.LogInformation($"Kullanıcı {userId} yeni başarım kazandı: {ach.Title}");
            }
        }
        
        await _userAchievementWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Gamification;

public sealed class GamificationService : IGamificationService
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;
    private readonly IBadgeReadRepository _badgeReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserBadgeReadRepository _userBadgeReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserBadgeWriteRepository _userBadgeWriteRepository;
    private readonly IUserCategoryProgressReadRepository _categoryProgressReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserCategoryProgressWriteRepository _categoryProgressWriteRepository;

    public GamificationService(
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository,
        IBadgeReadRepository badgeReadRepository,
        IUserBadgeReadRepository userBadgeReadRepository,
        IUserBadgeWriteRepository userBadgeWriteRepository,
        IUserCategoryProgressReadRepository categoryProgressReadRepository,
        IUserCategoryProgressWriteRepository categoryProgressWriteRepository)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
        _badgeReadRepository = badgeReadRepository;
        _userBadgeReadRepository = userBadgeReadRepository;
        _userBadgeWriteRepository = userBadgeWriteRepository;
        _categoryProgressReadRepository = categoryProgressReadRepository;
        _categoryProgressWriteRepository = categoryProgressWriteRepository;
    }

    public async Task<AppUser> AddExperienceAsync(Guid userId, int xpAmount, Guid? categoryId = null)
    {
        return await AddExperienceWithTaskAsync(userId, xpAmount, null, categoryId);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// SP-01: XpCompensationRate ve IsCompensated bonus destekli XP ekleme.
    /// Ertelenen görevlerde rate=0.70, normal tamamlamada rate=1.0, telafi tamamlamada +%10 bonus.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<AppUser> AddExperienceWithTaskAsync(Guid userId, int baseXpAmount, UserTask? userTask, Guid? categoryId = null)
    {
        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(userId.ToString(), tracking: true);
        if (user == null) throw new Exception("Kullanıcı bulunamadı!");

        // XP hesabı: CompensationRate uygula
        decimal compensationRate = userTask?.XpCompensationRate ?? 1.0m;
        // Telafi bonusu: Postponed görev tamamlanıyorsa +%10
        if (userTask?.IsCompensated == true)
            compensationRate = Math.Min(compensationRate + 0.10m, 1.0m);

        int finalXp = (int)(baseXpAmount * compensationRate);

        if (userTask != null)
            userTask.EarnedXp = finalXp;

        user.TotalXP += finalXp;
        user.GeneralLevel = 1 + (user.TotalXP / 1000.0);
        user.LastActiveAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        _userWriteRepository.Update(user);

        if (categoryId.HasValue)
            await HandleCategoryProgression(userId, categoryId.Value, finalXp);

        await _userWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
        await CheckAndAwardBadges(user.Id, (int)user.GeneralLevel);

        return user;
    }

    private async Task HandleCategoryProgression(Guid userId, Guid categoryId, int xpAmount)
    {
        var progress = await _categoryProgressReadRepository.Table
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cp => cp.AppUserId == userId && cp.CategoryId == categoryId);

        if (progress == null)
        {
            progress = new UserCategoryProgress
            {
                AppUserId = userId,
                CategoryId = categoryId,
                Level = 1,
                CurrentXp = 0,
                XpToNextLevel = 100
            };
            await _categoryProgressWriteRepository.AddAsync(progress);
        }

        progress.CurrentXp += xpAmount;

        while (progress.CurrentXp >= progress.XpToNextLevel)
        {
            progress.CurrentXp -= progress.XpToNextLevel;
            progress.Level++;
            progress.XpToNextLevel += 50;
        }

        await _categoryProgressWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
    }

    private async Task CheckAndAwardBadges(Guid userId, int currentLevel)
    {
        var eligibleBadges = await _badgeReadRepository
            .GetWhere(b => b.RequiredLevel <= currentLevel, tracking: false)
            .ToListAsync();

        var ownedBadges = await _userBadgeReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ub => ub.AppUserId == userId, tracking: false)
            .Select(ub => ub.BadgeId)
            .ToListAsync();

        foreach (var badge in eligibleBadges)
        {
            if (!ownedBadges.Contains(badge.Id))
            {
                var newUserBadge = new UserBadge
                {
                    AppUserId = userId,
                    BadgeId = badge.Id,
                    EarnedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                };
                await _userBadgeWriteRepository.AddAsync(newUserBadge);
            }
        }

        await _userBadgeWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Social;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Social;

public sealed class ChallengeService : IChallengeService
{
    private readonly IChallengeReadRepository _challengeReadRepository;
    private readonly IChallengeWriteRepository _challengeWriteRepository;
    private readonly IGamificationService _gamificationService;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notificationService;

    public ChallengeService(
        IChallengeReadRepository challengeReadRepository,
        IChallengeWriteRepository challengeWriteRepository,
        IGamificationService gamificationService,
        IAppNotificationService notificationService)
    {
        _challengeReadRepository = challengeReadRepository;
        _challengeWriteRepository = challengeWriteRepository;
        _gamificationService = gamificationService;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
    }

    public async Task UpdateChallengeProgressAsync(Guid userId, Guid? categoryId)
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // SP-05: Status enum ile aktif mücadeleleri getir
        var activeChallenges = await _challengeReadRepository.Table
            .Where(c => c.Status == ChallengeStatus.Active &&
                        c.StartDate <= now &&
                        c.EndDate >= now &&
                        (c.ChallengerId == userId || c.OpponentId == userId))
            .ToListAsync();

        if (!activeChallenges.Any()) return;

        foreach (var challenge in activeChallenges)
        {
            // CategoryFocus: Sadece hedef kategoride tamamlanan görevler sayılır
            if (challenge.ChallengeType == ChallengeType.CategoryFocus)
            {
                var targetCat = challenge.TargetCategoryId ?? challenge.CategoryId;
                if (targetCat.HasValue && categoryId.HasValue && targetCat != categoryId)
                    continue;
            }

            bool isWinnerDetermined = false;
            bool isChallenger = challenge.ChallengerId == userId;

            if (isChallenger)
                challenge.ChallengerProgress++;
            else
                challenge.OpponentProgress++;

            // TargetValue varsa — kazanan kontrolü
            if (challenge.TargetValue.HasValue)
            {
                int myProgress = isChallenger ? challenge.ChallengerProgress : challenge.OpponentProgress;
                if (myProgress >= challenge.TargetValue.Value)
                {
                    challenge.WinnerId = userId;
                    challenge.Status = ChallengeStatus.Completed;
                    isWinnerDetermined = true;
                }
            }

            if (isWinnerDetermined)
            {
                await _gamificationService.AddExperienceAsync(userId, challenge.WinnerXPBonus);

                var loserId = isChallenger ? challenge.OpponentId : challenge.ChallengerId;
                await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    userId, "Mücadele Kazandın! 🏆",
                    $"'{challenge.Title}' mücadelesini kazandın! +{challenge.WinnerXPBonus} XP",
                    "ChallengeCompleted");
                await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    loserId, "Mücadele Sona Erdi",
                    $"'{challenge.Title}' mücadelesinde rakibin seni geçti. Bir dahaki sefere!",
                    "ChallengeCompleted");
            }
            else
            {
                // Canlı ilerleme bildirimi (her 25% de bir)
                int myProg = isChallenger ? challenge.ChallengerProgress : challenge.OpponentProgress;
                int target = challenge.TargetValue ?? 100;
                int pct = (int)((double)myProg / target * 100);
                if (pct > 0 && pct % 25 == 0)
                {
                    var opponentId = isChallenger ? challenge.OpponentId : challenge.ChallengerId;
                    await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                        opponentId, "Rakibin İlerliyor! ⚠️",
                        $"'{challenge.Title}' mücadelesinde rakibin %{pct} tamamladı!",
                        "ChallengeProgressUpdated");
                }
            }
        }

        await _challengeWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Token;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Token;

public class JwtTokenService : ITokenService
{
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;

    public JwtTokenService(IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        _configuration = configuration;
    }

    public string CreateToken(AppUser user)
    {
        var claims = new List<Claim>
            {
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, user.Id.ToString()),
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Email, user.Email),
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, user.UserName),
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, user.AppRole?.Name ?? "User")
            };

        var key = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(
            _configuration.GetSection("AppSettings:Token").Value!));

        var creds = new SigningCredentials(key, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha512Signature);

        var tokenDescriptor = new SecurityTokenDescriptor
        {
            Subject = new ClaimsIdentity(claims),
            Expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(1),
            SigningCredentials = creds
        };

        var tokenHandler = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler();
        var token = tokenHandler.CreateToken(tokenDescriptor);

        return tokenHandler.WriteToken(token);
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Contexts;
using LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Repositories;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using System;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Persistence;

public static class ServiceRegistration
{
    public static void AddPersistenceServices(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        var dataSourceBuilder = new Npgsql.NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder(configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection"));
        dataSourceBuilder.EnableDynamicJson();
        var dataSource = dataSourceBuilder.Build();

        services.AddDbContext<LifeQuestDbContext>(options =>
            options.UseNpgsql(dataSource, npgsqlOptions => 
            {
                npgsqlOptions.EnableRetryOnFailure(
                    maxRetryCount: 5,
                    maxRetryDelay: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10),
                    errorCodesToAdd: null);
            }));

        services.AddScoped<IAppUserReadRepository, AppUserReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAppUserWriteRepository, AppUserWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAppRoleReadRepository, AppRoleReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAppRoleWriteRepository, AppRoleWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAppTaskReadRepository, AppTaskReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAppTaskWriteRepository, AppTaskWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserTaskReadRepository, UserTaskReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserTaskWriteRepository, UserTaskWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IBadgeReadRepository, BadgeReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IBadgeWriteRepository, BadgeWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserBadgeReadRepository, UserBadgeReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserBadgeWriteRepository, UserBadgeWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<ICategoryReadRepository, CategoryReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<ICategoryWriteRepository, CategoryWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserCategoryProgressReadRepository, UserCategoryProgressReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserCategoryProgressWriteRepository, UserCategoryProgressWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserGoalReadRepository, UserGoalReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserGoalWriteRepository, UserGoalWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAchievementReadRepository, AchievementReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAchievementWriteRepository, AchievementWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserAchievementReadRepository, UserAchievementReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserAchievementWriteRepository, UserAchievementWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<INotificationReadRepository, NotificationReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<INotificationWriteRepository, NotificationWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IWeeklyReportReadRepository, WeeklyReportReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IWeeklyReportWriteRepository, WeeklyReportWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IFriendshipReadRepository, FriendshipReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IFriendshipWriteRepository, FriendshipWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IChallengeReadRepository, ChallengeReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IChallengeWriteRepository, ChallengeWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserTaskInteractionReadRepository, UserTaskInteractionReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserTaskInteractionWriteRepository, UserTaskInteractionWriteRepository>();

using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Contexts;

public sealed class LifeQuestDbContext : DbContext
{
    public LifeQuestDbContext(DbContextOptions<LifeQuestDbContext> options) : base(options)
    {
    }

    public DbSet<AppUser> AppUsers { get; set; }
    public DbSet<AppRole> AppRoles { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Category> Categories { get; set; }
    public DbSet<AppTask> AppTasks { get; set; }
    public DbSet<UserCategoryProgress> UserCategoryProgresses { get; set; }
    public DbSet<UserTask> UserTasks { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Badge> Badges { get; set; }
    public DbSet<UserBadge> UserBadges { get; set; }
    public DbSet<ChatBotMessage> ChatBotMessages { get; set; }
    public DbSet<UserGoal> UserGoals { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Achievement> Achievements { get; set; }
    public DbSet<UserAchievement> UserAchievements { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Notification> Notifications { get; set; }
    public DbSet<WeeklyReport> WeeklyReports { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Friendship> Friendships { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Challenge> Challenges { get; set; }
    public DbSet<UserTaskInteraction> UserTaskInteractions { get; set; }
    public DbSet<UserDailyMood> UserDailyMoods { get; set; }

    // SP-05 Yeni Entity'ler
    public DbSet<OnboardingResponse> OnboardingResponses { get; set; }
    public DbSet<GoalMilestone> GoalMilestones { get; set; }
    public DbSet<ChallengeParticipant> ChallengeParticipants { get; set; }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.Entity<UserCategoryProgress>()
            .HasIndex(u => new { u.AppUserId, u.CategoryId })
            .IsUnique();

        modelBuilder.Entity<AppUser>()
            .HasOne(u => u.AppRole)
            .WithMany()
            .HasForeignKey(u => u.AppRoleId);

        // Friendship - self-referencing
        modelBuilder.Entity<Friendship>()
            .HasOne(f => f.Requester)
            .WithMany()
            .HasForeignKey(f => f.RequesterId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

        modelBuilder.Entity<Friendship>()
            .HasOne(f => f.Addressee)
            .WithMany()
            .HasForeignKey(f => f.AddresseeId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

        modelBuilder.Entity<Friendship>()
            .HasIndex(f => new { f.RequesterId, f.AddresseeId })
            .IsUnique();

        // Challenge - self-referencing
        modelBuilder.Entity<Challenge>()
            .HasOne(c => c.Challenger)
            .WithMany()
            .HasForeignKey(c => c.ChallengerId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

        modelBuilder.Entity<Challenge>()
            .HasOne(c => c.Opponent)
            .WithMany()
            .HasForeignKey(c => c.OpponentId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

        // SP-05: ChallengeParticipants
        modelBuilder.Entity<ChallengeParticipant>()
            .HasOne(cp => cp.Challenge)
            .WithMany(c => c.Participants)
            .HasForeignKey(cp => cp.ChallengeId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

        modelBuilder.Entity<ChallengeParticipant>()
            .HasOne(cp => cp.User)
            .WithMany()
            .HasForeignKey(cp => cp.UserId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

        // UserAchievement unique constraint
        modelBuilder.Entity<UserAchievement>()
            .HasIndex(ua => new { ua.AppUserId, ua.AchievementId })
            .IsUnique();

        // UserTaskInteraction indexes for ML queries
        modelBuilder.Entity<UserTaskInteraction>()
            .HasIndex(uti => uti.AppUserId);

        modelBuilder.Entity<UserTaskInteraction>()
            .HasIndex(uti => uti.WasCompleted);

        // Notification index
        modelBuilder.Entity<Notification>()
            .HasIndex(n => new { n.AppUserId, n.IsRead });

        // WeeklyReport index
        modelBuilder.Entity<WeeklyReport>()
            .HasIndex(wr => new { wr.AppUserId, wr.WeekStartDate })
            .IsUnique();

        // UserDailyMood — UNIQUE(AppUserId, Date) + indexes
        modelBuilder.Entity<UserDailyMood>()
            .HasIndex(m => new { m.AppUserId, m.Date })
            .IsUnique();

        modelBuilder.Entity<UserDailyMood>()
            .HasIndex(m => m.Date);

        // AppUser jsonb kolonları
        modelBuilder.Entity<AppUser>()
            .Property(u => u.UserGoals)
            .HasColumnType("jsonb")
            .HasColumnName("UserGoals");

        modelBuilder.Entity<AppUser>()
            .Property(u => u.Strengths)
            .HasColumnType("jsonb");

        modelBuilder.Entity<AppUser>()
            .Property(u => u.Weaknesses)
            .HasColumnType("jsonb");

        // AppUser.Goals → UserGoalsList navigation
        modelBuilder.Entity<AppUser>()
            .HasMany(u => u.UserGoalsList)
            .WithOne(g => g.AppUser)
            .HasForeignKey(g => g.AppUserId);

        // AppTask jsonb kolonları
        modelBuilder.Entity<AppTask>()
            .Property(t => t.RecommendedTimeSlots)
            .HasColumnType("jsonb");

        modelBuilder.Entity<AppTask>()
            .Property(t => t.TargetedWeaknesses)
            .HasColumnType("jsonb");

        modelBuilder.Entity<AppTask>()
            .Property(t => t.TargetedGoals)
            .HasColumnType("jsonb");

        modelBuilder.Entity<ChatBotMessage>()
            .HasIndex(m => m.AppUserId);

        modelBuilder.Entity<ChatBotMessage>()
            .Property(m => m.ActionsOfferedJson)
            .HasColumnType("jsonb");

        // Migration Fix: Defaults
        modelBuilder.Entity<AppUser>()
            .Property(u => u.NudgeEnabled)
            .HasDefaultValue(true);

        modelBuilder.Entity<UserTask>()
            .Property(ut => ut.XpCompensationRate)
            .HasDefaultValue(1.0m);

        // SP-05: Task Limit defaults
        modelBuilder.Entity<AppUser>()
            .Property(u => u.DailyTaskLimit)
            .HasDefaultValue(3);

        modelBuilder.Entity<AppUser>()
            .Property(u => u.WeeklyTaskLimit)
            .HasDefaultValue(7);

        // SP-05: AppUser yeni jsonb kolonlari
        modelBuilder.Entity<AppUser>()
            .Property(u => u.WorkDays)
            .HasColumnType("jsonb");

        modelBuilder.Entity<AppUser>()
            .Property(u => u.MotivationKillers)
            .HasColumnType("jsonb");

        // SP-05: OnboardingResponse
        modelBuilder.Entity<OnboardingResponse>()
            .HasOne(o => o.AppUser)
            .WithMany(u => u.OnboardingResponses)
            .HasForeignKey(o => o.AppUserId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

        modelBuilder.Entity<OnboardingResponse>()
            .HasIndex(o => new { o.AppUserId, o.QuestionKey });

        // SP-05: GoalMilestone
        modelBuilder.Entity<GoalMilestone>()
            .HasOne(gm => gm.UserGoal)
            .WithMany(g => g.Milestones)
            .HasForeignKey(gm => gm.UserGoalId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

        modelBuilder.Entity<GoalMilestone>()
            .HasIndex(gm => new { gm.UserGoalId, gm.OrderIndex });

        // SP-05: UserGoal jsonb
        modelBuilder.Entity<UserGoal>()
            .Property(g => g.LinkedCategoryIds)
            .HasColumnType("jsonb");

        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
    }

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Common;
using LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Contexts;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Repositories;

public class ReadRepository<T> : IReadRepository<T> where T : BaseEntity
{
    private readonly LifeQuestDbContext _context;

    public ReadRepository(LifeQuestDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public DbSet<T> Table => _context.Set<T>();

    public IQueryable<T> GetAll(bool tracking = true)
    {
        var query = Table.AsQueryable();
        if (!tracking)
            query = query.AsNoTracking();
        return query;
    }

    public async Task<T?> GetByIdAsync(string id, bool tracking = true)
    {
        var query = Table.AsQueryable();
        if (!tracking)
            query = query.AsNoTracking();
        return await query.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == Guid.Parse(id));
    }

    public async Task<T?> GetSingleAsync(Expression<Func<T, bool>> method, bool tracking = true)
    {
        var query = Table.AsQueryable();
        if (!tracking)
            query = query.AsNoTracking();
        return await query.FirstOrDefaultAsync(method);
    }

    public IQueryable<T> GetWhere(Expression<Func<T, bool>> method, bool tracking = true)
    {
        var query = Table.Where(method);
        if (!tracking)
            query = query.AsNoTracking();
        return query;
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Infrastructure\LifeQuestAPI.Persistence\Repositories\WriteRepository.cs
==================================================

﻿using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Common;
using LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Contexts;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.ChangeTracking;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Repositories;

public class WriteRepository<T> : IWriteRepository<T> where T : BaseEntity
{
    private readonly LifeQuestDbContext _context;

    public WriteRepository(LifeQuestDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public DbSet<T> Table => _context.Set<T>();

    public async Task<bool> AddAsync(T entity)
    {
        EntityEntry<T> entityEntry = await Table.AddAsync(entity);
        return entityEntry.State == EntityState.Added;
    }

    public async Task<bool> AddRangeAsync(List<T> entities)
    {
        await Table.AddRangeAsync(entities);
        return true;
    }

    public bool Remove(T entity)
    {
        EntityEntry<T> entityEntry = Table.Remove(entity);
        return entityEntry.State == EntityState.Deleted;
    }

    public async Task<bool> RemoveAsync(string id)
    {
        T? t = await Table.FindAsync(Guid.Parse(id));
        if (t == null)
        {
            return false;
        }
        Table.Remove(t);
        return true;
    }


    public bool Update(T model)
    {
        EntityEntry<T> entityEntry = Table.Update(model);
        return entityEntry.State == EntityState.Modified;
    }
    public async Task<int> SaveAsync() => await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
}

using System.Text;
using System.Threading.RateLimiting;
using LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure;
using LifeQuestAPI.Persistence;
using LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Contexts.SeedData;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddApplicationServices();
builder.Services.AddPersistenceServices(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddInfrastructureServices(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddHostedService<DailyQuestWorker>();
builder.Services.AddHostedService<LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices.WeeklyReportWorker>();
builder.Services.AddHostedService<NudgeWorker>(); // SP-03
builder.Services.AddHostedService<GoalRevisionWorker>(); // SP-04
builder.Services.AddHostedService<GoalReminderWorker>(); // SP-05
builder.Services.AddHostedService<ChallengeExpiryWorker>(); // SP-05

builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen(c =>
{
    c.SwaggerDoc("v1", new Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.OpenApiInfo { Title = "LifeQuest API", Version = "v1" });
    c.AddSecurityDefinition("Bearer", new Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.OpenApiSecurityScheme
    {
        Name = "Authorization",
        Type = Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.SecuritySchemeType.ApiKey,
        Scheme = "Bearer",
        BearerFormat = "JWT",
        In = Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.ParameterLocation.Header,
        Description = "JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. \r\n\r\n Enter 'Bearer' [space] and then your token in the text input below.\r\n\r\nExample: \"Bearer 1safsfsdfdfd\""
    });
    c.AddSecurityRequirement(new Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.OpenApiSecurityRequirement
    {
        {
            new Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.OpenApiSecurityScheme
            {
                Reference = new Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.OpenApiReference
                {
                    Type = Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.ReferenceType.SecurityScheme,
                    Id = "Bearer"
                }
            },
            new string[] {}
        }
    });
});
builder.Services.AddSignalR();
builder.Services.AddScoped<LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications.IAppNotificationService, LifeQuestAPI.API.Services.AppNotificationService>();

// CORS Politikası
builder.Services.AddCors(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("AllowFrontend",
        policy =>
        {
            policy.SetIsOriginAllowed(origin => true) // Tüm originlere izin ver
                  .AllowAnyMethod()
                  .AllowAnyHeader()
                  .AllowCredentials(); // SignalR için gerekli
        });
});

// Rate Limiting
builder.Services.AddRateLimiter(options =>
{
    options.GlobalLimiter = PartitionedRateLimiter.Create<HttpContext, string>(httpContext =>
        RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(
            partitionKey: httpContext.User.Identity?.Name ?? httpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "global",
            factory: partition => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
            {
                AutoReplenishment = true,
                PermitLimit = 500,
                QueueLimit = 0,
                Window = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
            }));
    options.RejectionStatusCode = 429;
});

builder.Services.AddAuthentication(options =>
{
    options.DefaultAuthenticateScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
    options.DefaultChallengeScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
})
.AddJwtBearer(options =>
{
    options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
    {
        ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
        IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(builder.Configuration["AppSettings:Token"] ?? "bu_proje_icin_cok_gizli_ve_cok_uzun_bir_anahtar_olusturdum_en_az_64_karakter_olmali_ki_sha512_calissin_lifequest_2025")),
        ValidateIssuer = false,
        ValidateAudience = false,
        ValidateLifetime = true,
        ClockSkew = TimeSpan.Zero
    };
});

var app = builder.Build();
app.UseMiddleware<LifeQuestAPI.API.Middlewares.GlobalExceptionMiddleware>();

app.UseSwagger();
app.UseSwaggerUI(c => c.SwaggerEndpoint("/swagger/v1/swagger.json", "LifeQuest API v1"));

// app.UseHttpsRedirection(); // Dev ortamında (Docker) localhost mixed-content ve sertifika sorunlarını önlemek için kapatıldı
app.UseCors("AllowFrontend");
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

// Statik dosyalar (uploads klasoru icin)
app.UseStaticFiles();

app.MapControllers();
app.MapHub<LifeQuestAPI.API.Hubs.NotificationHub>("/hubs/notification");

using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())
{
    var services = scope.ServiceProvider;
    try
    {
        await SeedData.Initialize(services);
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        var logger = services.GetRequiredService<ILogger<Program>>();
        logger.LogError(ex, "Veritabanina seed data eklenirken bir hata olustu.");
    }
}

app.Run();

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\BackgroundServices\ChallengeExpiryWorker.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;

/// <summary>SP-05: Süresi dolan mücadeleler için saatlik kontrol.</summary>
public class ChallengeExpiryWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly ILogger<ChallengeExpiryWorker> _logger;

    public ChallengeExpiryWorker(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, ILogger<ChallengeExpiryWorker> logger)
    {
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("ChallengeExpiryWorker başlatıldı.");

        using PeriodicTimer timer = new(TimeSpan.FromHours(1));
        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested && await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stoppingToken))
        {
            try
            {
                using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
                await ProcessExpiredChallengesAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, stoppingToken);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "ChallengeExpiryWorker hata aldı.");
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task ProcessExpiredChallengesAsync(IServiceProvider services, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var challengeReadRepo = services.GetRequiredService<IChallengeReadRepository>();
        var challengeWriteRepo = services.GetRequiredService<IChallengeWriteRepository>();
        var gamificationService = services.GetRequiredService<IGamificationService>();
        var notificationService = services.GetRequiredService<IAppNotificationService>();
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // 1. Invited + 48 saat geçmiş → Expired
        var expiredInvites = await challengeReadRepo.GetWhere(
            c => c.Status == ChallengeStatus.Invited &&
                 c.InvitedAt.AddHours(48) < now,
            tracking: true)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        foreach (var c in expiredInvites)
        {
            c.Status = ChallengeStatus.Expired;
            challengeWriteRepo.Update(c);
        }

        // 2. Active + EndDate geçmiş → Complete
        var expiredActive = await challengeReadRepo.GetWhere(
            c => c.Status == ChallengeStatus.Active && c.EndDate < now,
            tracking: true)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        foreach (var c in expiredActive)
        {
            c.Status = ChallengeStatus.Completed;

            // Kazananı belirle
            Guid? winnerId = null;
            int challengerProg = c.ChallengerProgress;
            int opponentProg = c.OpponentProgress;

            if (challengerProg > opponentProg) winnerId = c.ChallengerId;
            else if (opponentProg > challengerProg) winnerId = c.OpponentId;
            // Eşitlik → winnerId = null, her ikisine yarı bonus

            c.WinnerId = winnerId;

            if (winnerId.HasValue)
            {
                await gamificationService.AddExperienceAsync(winnerId.Value, c.WinnerXPBonus);
                var loserId = winnerId.Value == c.ChallengerId ? c.OpponentId : c.ChallengerId;

                await notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    winnerId.Value, "Mücadele Kazandın! 🏆",
                    $"'{c.Title}' mücadelesini kazandın! +{c.WinnerXPBonus} XP", "ChallengeCompleted");
                await notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    loserId, "Mücadele Bitti",
                    $"'{c.Title}' mücadelesinde rakibin daha iyi oldu. Bir daha dene!", "ChallengeCompleted");
            }
            else
            {
                // Beraberlik
                int halfBonus = c.WinnerXPBonus / 2;
                await gamificationService.AddExperienceAsync(c.ChallengerId, halfBonus);
                await gamificationService.AddExperienceAsync(c.OpponentId, halfBonus);

                await notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    c.ChallengerId, "Mücadele Bitti — Beraberlik!",
                    $"'{c.Title}' mücadelesi berabere bitti! +{halfBonus} XP", "ChallengeCompleted");
                await notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    c.OpponentId, "Mücadele Bitti — Beraberlik!",
                    $"'{c.Title}' mücadelesi berabere bitti! +{halfBonus} XP", "ChallengeCompleted");
            }

            challengeWriteRepo.Update(c);
        }

        await challengeWriteRepo.SaveAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("ChallengeExpiryWorker: {Exp} süresi doldu, {Comp} tamamlandı.",
            expiredInvites.Count, expiredActive.Count);
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.DailyQuest;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;

public class DailyQuestWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly ILogger<DailyQuestWorker> _logger;
    private readonly TimeSpan _period = TimeSpan.FromHours(24);

    public DailyQuestWorker(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, ILogger<DailyQuestWorker> logger)
    {
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Worker Başlatıldı.");

        using PeriodicTimer timer = new PeriodicTimer(_period);

        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested && await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stoppingToken))
        {
            try
            {
                using (var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope())
                {
                    var dailyQuestService = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IDailyQuestService>();
                    await dailyQuestService.DistributeDailyQuestsAsync();

                    // SP-05: Günlük sayaçları sıfırla
                    await ResetDailyCountersAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, stoppingToken);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Worker hata aldı!");
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>SP-05: Her gece TodayTaskCount ve OverLimitWarningShown sıfırla, Pazartesi WeeklyCompletedCount sıfırla.</summary>
    private async Task ResetDailyCountersAsync(IServiceProvider services, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var userReadRepo = services.GetRequiredService<IAppUserReadRepository>();
        var userWriteRepo = services.GetRequiredService<IAppUserWriteRepository>();

        var users = await userReadRepo.GetAll(tracking: true).ToListAsync(ct);
        var isMonday = DateTime.UtcNow.DayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Monday;

        foreach (var user in users)
        {
            user.TodayTaskCount = 0;
            user.OverLimitWarningShown = false;
            if (isMonday) user.WeeklyCompletedCount = 0;
            userWriteRepo.Update(user);
        }

        await userWriteRepo.SaveAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("SP-05: {Count} kullanıcının günlük sayaçları sıfırlandı.", users.Count);
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\BackgroundServices\GoalReminderWorker.cs

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;

/// <summary>SP-05: Hedef hatırlatma bildirimleri. Her gün 09:00'da çalışır.</summary>
public class GoalReminderWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly ILogger<GoalReminderWorker> _logger;

    public GoalReminderWorker(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, ILogger<GoalReminderWorker> logger)
    {
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("GoalReminderWorker başlatıldı.");

        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            var nextRun = now.Date.AddDays(1).AddHours(6); // UTC 06:00 = TR 09:00
            var delay = nextRun - now;
            if (delay < TimeSpan.Zero) delay = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);

            await Task.Delay(delay, stoppingToken);

            try
            {
                using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
                await SendGoalRemindersAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, stoppingToken);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "GoalReminderWorker hata aldı.");
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task SendGoalRemindersAsync(IServiceProvider services, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var goalRepo = services.GetRequiredService<IUserGoalReadRepository>();
        var goalWriteRepo = services.GetRequiredService<IUserGoalWriteRepository>();
        var notificationService = services.GetRequiredService<IAppNotificationService>();

        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var goals = await goalRepo.GetWhere(
            g => !g.IsCompleted && !g.IsArchived && g.ReminderEnabled, tracking: true)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        var dayOfWeek = now.DayOfWeek;
        int remindedCount = 0;

        foreach (var goal in goals)
        {
            bool shouldRemind = goal.ReminderFrequency switch
            {
                "daily" => true,
                "weekly" => dayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Monday,
                "on_lag" => IsGoalOnLag(goal, now),
                _ => false
            };

            if (!shouldRemind) continue;
            if (goal.LastReminderAt?.Date == now.Date) continue; // Bugün zaten gönderildi

            var progressPct = goal.TargetValue > 0
                ? (int)((double)goal.CurrentValue / goal.TargetValue * 100)
                : 0;

            await notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                goal.AppUserId,
                "Hedef Hatırlatması 🎯",
                $"'{goal.Title}' hedefinizde %{progressPct} tamamlandı. Devam et!",
                "GoalReminder");

            goal.LastReminderAt = now;
            goalWriteRepo.Update(goal);
            remindedCount++;
        }

        await goalWriteRepo.SaveAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("GoalReminderWorker: {Count} hedef hatırlatması gönderildi.", remindedCount);
    }

    private static bool IsGoalOnLag(Domain.Entities.UserGoal goal, DateTime now)
    {
        var totalDays = (goal.EndDate - goal.StartDate).TotalDays;
        if (totalDays <= 0) return false;
        var elapsedDays = (now - goal.StartDate).TotalDays;
        var expectedProgress = elapsedDays / totalDays;
        var actualProgress = goal.TargetValue > 0 ? (double)goal.CurrentValue / goal.TargetValue : 0;
        return actualProgress < expectedProgress * 0.8;
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\BackgroundServices\GoalRevisionWorker.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;

/// <summary>
/// SP-04: Her Pazar 20:00'de çalışır.
/// Son 14 günde tamamlama oranı %20'nin altında olan ve kullanıcı hedefinde yer alan
/// kategorileri tespit eder; chatbot üzerinden hedef revizyon sorusu gönderir.
/// </summary>
public sealed class GoalRevisionWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly ILogger<GoalRevisionWorker> _logger;
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;

    private static readonly TimeZoneInfo TurkeyTz =
        TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById("Turkey Standard Time") ??
        TimeZoneInfo.CreateCustomTimeZone("Turkey Standard Time", TimeSpan.FromHours(3), "Turkey", "Turkey");

    public GoalRevisionWorker(ILogger<GoalRevisionWorker> logger, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("GoalRevisionWorker başlatıldı.");

        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var nowLocal = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(DateTime.UtcNow, TurkeyTz);

            // Her Pazar 20:00
            if (nowLocal.DayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Sunday && nowLocal.Hour == 20)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("GoalRevisionWorker: Hedef revizyonu başlıyor.");
                await RunRevisionAsync(stoppingToken);

                // 2 saat bekle (aynı gün tekrar çalışmasın)
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromHours(2), stoppingToken);
            }
            else
            {
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30), stoppingToken);
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task RunRevisionAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
        var userReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAppUserReadRepository>();
        var userTaskReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IUserTaskReadRepository>();
        var notifService = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAppNotificationService>();
        var chatWriteRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IChatBotMessageWriteRepository>();

        var cutoff = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-14);

        var users = await userReadRepo
            .GetWhere(u => u.UserGoals != null && u.UserGoals.Any() && !u.IsOnVacation, tracking: false)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        foreach (var user in users)
        {
            try
            {
                var tasks = await userTaskReadRepo.Table
                    .Include(ut => ut.AppTask).ThenInclude(t => t!.Category)
                    .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == user.Id && ut.AssignedAt >= cutoff)
                    .ToListAsync(ct);

                if (!tasks.Any()) continue;

                // Kategori bazlı tamamlama oranı
                var categoryStats = tasks
                    .Where(t => t.AppTask?.Category != null)
                    .GroupBy(t => t.AppTask!.Category!.Name)
                    .Select(g => new
                    {
                        Category = g.Key,
                        Total = g.Count(),
                        Completed = g.Count(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed),
                        Rate = g.Count() > 0
                            ? (double)g.Count(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed) / g.Count()
                            : 0.0
                    })
                    .ToList();

                // %20 altında olan, kullanıcı hedefinde yer alan kategoriler
                var weakGoals = categoryStats
                    .Where(s => s.Rate < 0.20 && s.Total >= 3 // en az 3 görev atanmış olmalı
                        && (user.UserGoals ?? new()).Any(g =>
                            g.Contains(s.Category, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                    .ToList();

                foreach (var weak in weakGoals)
                {
                    string message =
                        $"'{weak.Category}' hedefini son 2 haftadır zor buluyor gibisin " +
                        $"(tamamlama: %{(int)(weak.Rate * 100)}). Bu hedefi güncellemek ister misin?";

                    // ChatBotMessage olarak kaydet (aksiyonlu)
                    var chatMsg = new Domain.Entities.ChatBotMessage
                    {
                        Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                        AppUserId = user.Id,
                        Content = message,
                        SenderType = Domain.Enums.SenderType.Bot,
                        IsProactive = true,
                        Intent = "goal_revision",
                        // Aksiyonlar JSON string formatında saklanır
                        ActionsOfferedJson = new List<string>
                        {
                            $"{{\"type\":\"update_goal\",\"label\":\"Evet, güncelle\",\"payload\":\"{weak.Category}\"}}",
                            $"{{\"type\":\"keep_goal\",\"label\":\"Hayır, devam et\",\"payload\":\"{weak.Category}\"}}"
                        },
                        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                    };

                    await chatWriteRepo.AddAsync(chatMsg);
                    await chatWriteRepo.SaveAsync();

                    // SignalR push
                    await notifService.SendNotificationAsync(
                        user.Id,
                        "Hedef Revizyonu 🎯",
                        message,
                        "GoalRevision");

                    _logger.LogInformation(
                        "GoalRevisionWorker: {Category} → {UserId}", weak.Category, user.Id);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "GoalRevisionWorker: {UserId} için hata.", user.Id);
            }
        }
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\BackgroundServices\NudgeWorker.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;

/// <summary>
/// SP-03: Belirli saatlerde pasif kullanıcılara proaktif chatbot nudge mesajı gönderir.
/// Zamanlama (UTC+3): 13:00, 19:00, 21:30
/// </summary>
public sealed class NudgeWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly ILogger<NudgeWorker> _logger;
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;

    // Türkiye saati (UTC+3) — offset
    private static readonly TimeZoneInfo TurkeyTz =
        TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById("Turkey Standard Time") ??
        TimeZoneInfo.CreateCustomTimeZone("Turkey Standard Time", TimeSpan.FromHours(3), "Turkey", "Turkey");

    // Günlük gönderim zamanları (yerel saat)
    private static readonly (TimeOnly Time, NudgeType Type)[] Schedule =
    [
        (new TimeOnly(13, 0), NudgeType.Midday),
        (new TimeOnly(19, 0), NudgeType.Evening),
        (new TimeOnly(21, 30), NudgeType.NightStreak)
    ];

    public NudgeWorker(ILogger<NudgeWorker> logger, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("NudgeWorker başlatıldı.");

        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var nowUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
            var nowLocal = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(nowUtc, TurkeyTz);
            var nowTime = TimeOnly.FromDateTime(nowLocal);

            foreach (var (scheduleTime, nudgeType) in Schedule)
            {
                // ±2 dakika tolerans penceresi
                var diff = Math.Abs((nowTime - scheduleTime).TotalMinutes);
                if (diff <= 2)
                {
                    _logger.LogInformation("NudgeWorker: {NudgeType} zamanı geldi.", nudgeType);
                    await RunNudgeAsync(nudgeType, nowLocal, stoppingToken);
                    break;
                }
            }

            // Bir dakika bekle — gereksiz döngü yok
            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1), stoppingToken);
        }
    }

    private async Task RunNudgeAsync(NudgeType nudgeType, DateTime nowLocal, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
        var userReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAppUserReadRepository>();
        var userTaskReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IUserTaskReadRepository>();
        var chatWriteRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IChatBotMessageWriteRepository>();
        var notifService = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAppNotificationService>();

        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(nowLocal);

        // NudgeEnabled=true olan kullanıcıları çek
        var users = await userReadRepo
            .GetWhere(u => u.NudgeEnabled, tracking: false)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        foreach (var user in users)
        {
            try
            {
                // Bugün bu türden nudge gönderildi mi? (ChatBotMessage kontrolü)
                var chatReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IChatBotMessageReadRepository>();
                var alreadySent = await chatReadRepo.GetWhere(
                    m => m.AppUserId == user.Id
                        && m.IsProactive
                        && m.Intent == nudgeType.ToString()
                        && DateOnly.FromDateTime(m.CreatedAt) == today,
                    tracking: false).AnyAsync(ct);

                if (alreadySent) continue;

                // Bugünkü görev durumunu kontrol et
                var todayTasks = await userTaskReadRepo.Table
                    .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == user.Id)
                    .ToListAsync(ct);

                string? message = BuildNudgeMessage(nudgeType, user, todayTasks);
                if (message == null) continue;

                // ChatBotMessage kaydı (IsProactive=true)
                var chatMsg = new ChatBotMessage
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    AppUserId = user.Id,
                    Content = message,
                    SenderType = SenderType.Bot,
                    IsProactive = true,
                    Intent = nudgeType.ToString(),
                    CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                };
                await chatWriteRepo.AddAsync(chatMsg);
                await chatWriteRepo.SaveAsync();

                // SignalR ile push
                await notifService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    user.Id,
                    "LifeQuest AI 🤖",
                    message,
                    "ProactiveNudge");

                _logger.LogInformation("NudgeWorker: {NudgeType} → {UserId}", nudgeType, user.Id);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "NudgeWorker: {UserId} için nudge gönderilemedi.", user.Id);
            }
        }
    }

    private static string? BuildNudgeMessage(
        NudgeType nudgeType,
        Domain.Entities.Identity.AppUser user,
        List<Domain.Entities.UserTask> todayTasks)
    {
        var name = user.Name;
        var completed = todayTasks.Count(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed);
        var remaining = todayTasks.Count(t =>
            t.Status is AppTaskStatus.Suggested or AppTaskStatus.Selected or AppTaskStatus.InProgress);

        return nudgeType switch
        {
            NudgeType.Midday when completed == 0 =>
                $"Merhaba {name}! 🌞 Öğlen oldu ama henüz hiç göreve başlamadın. 15 dakikan varsa hızlı bir görev seni bekliyor!",

            NudgeType.Evening when completed == 0 =>
                $"Hey {name}! 🌆 Akşam oldu, bugün henüz hiç görev tamamlamadın. Streak'ini kurtarmak ister misin?",

            NudgeType.Evening when remaining > 0 =>
                $"{name}, bugün {completed} görev tamamladın! 💪 Hâlâ {remaining} görev bekliyor. Son bir hamle?",

            NudgeType.NightStreak when completed == 0 =>
                $"Gece olmadan önce {name}! 🌙 Sadece 5 dakikalık mini bir görev bile serini kurtarır. Hadi!",

            _ => null // Koşul sağlanmıyorsa mesaj gönderme
        };
    }
}

public enum NudgeType { Midday, Evening, NightStreak }

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\BackgroundServices\WeeklyReportWorker.cs
