using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;

public class WeeklyReportWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly ILogger<WeeklyReportWorker> _logger;
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;

    public WeeklyReportWorker(ILogger<WeeklyReportWorker> logger, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Haftalık Rapor İşçisi (WeeklyReportWorker) başlatıldı.");

        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

            // Pazar günü (Sunday) saat 23:00'te çalışsın
            if (now.DayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Sunday && now.Hour == 23)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Haftalık raporlar hesaplanmaya başlanıyor...");
                await GenerateReportsAsync(stoppingToken);
                
                // Bir kez çalıştıktan sonra sonraki haftaya kadar veya ertesi saate kadar uyusun
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromHours(2), stoppingToken);
            }
            else
            {
                // Her 30 dakikada bir kontrol et
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30), stoppingToken);
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task GenerateReportsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
        var userReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAppUserReadRepository>();
        var userTaskReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IUserTaskReadRepository>();
        var reportWriteRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IWeeklyReportWriteRepository>();
        var notificationService = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<Application.Abstractions.Notifications.IAppNotificationService>();

        var weekEnd = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var weekStart = weekEnd.AddDays(-7);

        var users = await userReadRepo.GetAll(false).ToListAsync();

        foreach (var user in users)
        {
            var thisWeekTasks = await userTaskReadRepo.Table
                .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
                .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == user.Id && ut.AssignedAt >= weekStart)
                .ToListAsync();

            if (!thisWeekTasks.Any()) continue;

            var completedTasks = thisWeekTasks.Where(t => t.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Completed).ToList();
            var failedTasks = thisWeekTasks.Where(t => t.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Abandoned
                || t.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Expired
                || (t.DueDate < DateTime.UtcNow && t.Status != Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Completed)).ToList();

            var totalXpEarned = completedTasks.Sum(t => t.EarnedXp);

            // Basit AI/Hesaplama özetleri
            string insight = "Bu hafta harika bir iş çıkardın!";
            string recommendation = "Önümüzdeki hafta Sağlık kategorisine daha fazla odaklanabilirsin.";

            var categoryGroups = completedTasks
                .Where(t => t.AppTask != null)
                .GroupBy(t => t.AppTask.CategoryId)
                .Select(g => new { CategoryId = g.Key, Count = g.Count() })
                .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count)
                .ToList();

            var report = new WeeklyReport
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                AppUserId = user.Id,
                WeekStartDate = weekStart,
                WeekEndDate = weekEnd,
                TasksCompleted = completedTasks.Count,
                TasksFailed = failedTasks.Count,
                TotalXPEarned = totalXpEarned,
                StreakDays = 0, // Günlük streak logu eklendiğinde buradan çekilebilir
                StrongestCategory = categoryGroups.FirstOrDefault()?.CategoryId.ToString() ?? "N/A",
                WeakestCategory = categoryGroups.LastOrDefault()?.CategoryId.ToString() ?? "N/A",
                AIInsight = insight,
                AIRecommendation = recommendation,
                OverallPerformanceScore = (thisWeekTasks.Count > 0) ? ((float)completedTasks.Count / thisWeekTasks.Count * 100) : 0,
                CategoryBreakdownJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(categoryGroups),
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            await reportWriteRepo.AddAsync(report);
            
            // Bildirim At
            await notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                user.Id, 
                "Haftalık Raporun Hazır! 📊", 
                $"Bu hafta {completedTasks.Count} görev tamamladın ve toplam {totalXpEarned} XP kazandın.", 
                "Report");
        }

        await reportWriteRepo.SaveAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation($"Haftalık raporlar {users.Count} kullanıcı için oluşturuldu ve kaydedildi.");

        // SP-03: Davranış analizi güncelle
        var behaviorService = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IUserBehaviorAnalysisService>();
        foreach (var user in users)
        {
            try { await behaviorService.AnalyzeAndUpdateUserBehaviorAsync(user.Id, ct); }
            catch (Exception ex) { _logger.LogError(ex, "Davranış analizi hatası — UserId: {Id}", user.Id); }
        }
        _logger.LogInformation("SP-03: Davranış analizi tüm kullanıcılar için tamamlandı.");
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\Controllers\BadgesController.cs

﻿using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Badges.Commands.CreateBadge;

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Chat.Commands.ProcessChatAction;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Chat.Commands.SendMessage;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System.Security.Claims;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/chat")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
public class ChatController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public ChatController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    /// <summary>AI chatbot'a mesaj gönder ve bağlam-duyarlı cevap al.</summary>
    [HttpPost("send")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> SendMessage([FromBody] ChatMessageBody body)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var response = await _mediator.Send(new SendMessageCommandRequest
        {
            UserId = Guid.Parse(userIdString),
            Message = body.Message
        });

        if (!response.Success) return BadRequest(response);
        return Ok(response);
    }

    /// <summary>SP-02: Chatbot aksiyon butonuna tıklandığında aksiyonu işle.</summary>
    [HttpPost("action")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ProcessAction([FromBody] ProcessChatActionBody body)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var result = await _mediator.Send(new ProcessChatActionCommandRequest
        {
            UserId = Guid.Parse(userIdString),
            MessageId = body.MessageId,
            ActionType = body.ActionType,
            TaskId = body.TaskId,
            Payload = body.Payload
        });

        if (!result.Success) return BadRequest(result);
        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>SP-02: Konuşma geçmişi (son 50 mesaj).</summary>
    [HttpGet("history")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetHistory([FromQuery] int limit = 50)
    {
        // Basit implementasyon — gelecekte paged query eklenebilir
        return Ok(new { message = "Coming soon — SP-03" });
    }
}

public class ChatMessageBody
{
    public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
}

public class ProcessChatActionBody
{
    public Guid? MessageId { get; set; }
    public string ActionType { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public Guid? TaskId { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, string>? Payload { get; set; }

using System.Security.Claims;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Goals.Commands.CreateUserGoal;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Goals.Commands.UpdateGoalProgress;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Goals.Commands.ArchiveGoal;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Goals.Queries.GetUserGoals;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Goals.Queries.GetGoalDashboard;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/goals")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
public class GoalsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public GoalsController(IMediator mediator) => _mediator = mediator;

    private Guid GetUserId() =>
        Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)!.Value);

    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMyGoals()
    {
        var response = await _mediator.Send(new GetUserGoalsQueryRequest { UserId = GetUserId() });
        return Ok(response);
    }

    /// <summary>SP-05: Hedef dashboard (aktif/tamamlanan/arşiv + lag detection)</summary>
    [HttpGet("dashboard")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetDashboard()
    {
        var response = await _mediator.Send(new GetGoalDashboardQueryRequest { UserId = GetUserId() });
        return Ok(response);
    }

    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateGoal([FromBody] CreateGoalBody body)
    {
        var request = new CreateUserGoalCommandRequest
        {
            UserId = GetUserId(),
            Title = body.Title,
            Description = body.Description,
            Type = body.Type,
            TargetValue = body.TargetValue,
            CategoryId = body.CategoryId,
            StartDate = body.StartDate,
            EndDate = body.EndDate,
            BonusXP = body.BonusXP,
            // SP-05 alanlar
            Icon = body.Icon,
            Color = body.Color,
            Why = body.Why,
            ProgressUnit = body.ProgressUnit ?? "görev",
            DifficultyLevel = body.DifficultyLevel,
            AutoTrackByCategory = body.AutoTrackByCategory,
            AutoTrackByXP = body.AutoTrackByXP,
            ReminderEnabled = body.ReminderEnabled,
            ReminderFrequency = body.ReminderFrequency ?? "daily"
        };

        var response = await _mediator.Send(request);
        return Ok(response);
    }

    /// <summary>SP-05: Manuel ilerleme güncelle (+1 / +5 / +10)</summary>
    [HttpPatch("{goalId}/progress")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateProgress(Guid goalId, [FromBody] UpdateProgressBody body)
    {
        try
        {
            var response = await _mediator.Send(new UpdateGoalProgressCommandRequest
            {
                UserId = GetUserId(),
                GoalId = goalId,
                IncrementBy = body.IncrementBy,
                Note = body.Note
            });
            return Ok(response);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>SP-05: Hedefi arşivle</summary>
    [HttpPatch("{goalId}/archive")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ArchiveGoal(Guid goalId)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await _mediator.Send(new ArchiveGoalCommandRequest
            {
                UserId = GetUserId(),
                GoalId = goalId
            });
            return Ok(new { success = result });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = ex.Message });
        }
    }
}

using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using System.Security.Claims;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Mood.Commands.RecordDailyMood;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/mood")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
public class MoodController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;
    private readonly IUserDailyMoodReadRepository _moodReadRepository;

    public MoodController(IMediator mediator, IUserDailyMoodReadRepository moodReadRepository)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
        _moodReadRepository = moodReadRepository;
    }

    /// <summary>POST /api/mood/daily — Günlük mood kaydet (UPSERT)</summary>
    [HttpPost("daily")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> RecordDailyMood([FromBody] RecordDailyMoodRequest request)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var result = await _mediator.Send(new RecordDailyMoodCommandRequest
        {
            UserId = Guid.Parse(userIdString),
            MoodMode = request.MoodMode,
            AvailableMinutes = request.AvailableMinutes,
            EnergyLevel = request.EnergyLevel
        });

        return Ok(new { success = true, data = result });
    }

    /// <summary>GET /api/mood/today — Bugünkü mood kaydını getir</summary>
    [HttpGet("today")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetTodayMood()
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var userId = Guid.Parse(userIdString);
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);

        var mood = await _moodReadRepository
            .GetWhere(m => m.AppUserId == userId && m.Date == today, tracking: false)
            .Select(m => new UserDailyMoodDto
            {
                Id = m.Id,
                AppUserId = m.AppUserId,
                Date = m.Date,
                MoodMode = m.MoodMode,
                AvailableMinutes = m.AvailableMinutes,
                EnergyLevel = m.EnergyLevel,
                RecordedAt = m.RecordedAt
            })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, data = mood });
    }

    /// <summary>GET /api/mood/history — Son 30 günün mood geçmişi</summary>
    [HttpGet("history")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMoodHistory()
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var userId = Guid.Parse(userIdString);
        var thirtyDaysAgo = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-30));

        var history = await _moodReadRepository
            .GetWhere(m => m.AppUserId == userId && m.Date >= thirtyDaysAgo, tracking: false)
            .OrderByDescending(m => m.Date)
            .Select(m => new UserDailyMoodDto
            {
                Id = m.Id,
                AppUserId = m.AppUserId,
                Date = m.Date,
                MoodMode = m.MoodMode,
                AvailableMinutes = m.AvailableMinutes,
                EnergyLevel = m.EnergyLevel,
                RecordedAt = m.RecordedAt
            })
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, data = history });
    }
}

public record RecordDailyMoodRequest(Domain.Enums.MoodMode MoodMode, int AvailableMinutes, int EnergyLevel);

using System;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System.Linq;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/notifications")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
public class NotificationsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly INotificationReadRepository _notificationRead;
    private readonly INotificationWriteRepository _notificationWrite;

    public NotificationsController(
        INotificationReadRepository notificationRead,
        INotificationWriteRepository notificationWrite)
    {
        _notificationRead = notificationRead;
        _notificationWrite = notificationWrite;
    }

    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMyNotifications()
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var userId = Guid.Parse(userIdString);

        var notifications = await _notificationRead.GetAll(false)
            .Where(n => n.AppUserId == userId)
            .OrderByDescending(n => n.CreatedAt)
            .Take(50) // Son 50 bildirim
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, notifications });
    }

    [HttpPatch("{id}/mark-as-read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> MarkAsRead(Guid id)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var userId = Guid.Parse(userIdString);

        var notification = await _notificationRead.GetByIdAsync(id.ToString());
        if (notification == null) return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "Bildirim bulunamadı." });
        if (notification.AppUserId != userId) return Unauthorized();

        notification.IsRead = true;
        await _notificationWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true });
    }

    [HttpPatch("mark-all-as-read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> MarkAllAsRead()
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var userId = Guid.Parse(userIdString);

        var unreadNotifications = await _notificationRead.GetAll(true)
            .Where(n => n.AppUserId == userId && !n.IsRead)
            .ToListAsync();

        foreach (var notification in unreadNotifications)
        {
            notification.IsRead = true;
        }

        if (unreadNotifications.Any())
        {
            await _notificationWrite.SaveAsync();
        }

        return Ok(new { success = true });
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\Controllers\RecommendationController.cs

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.AI;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/recommendation")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize(Roles = "Admin")] // Sadece Admin tetikleyebilir
public class RecommendationController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ITaskRecommendationService _recommendationService;
    private readonly IUserTaskInteractionReadRepository _interactionReadRepository;
    private readonly ILogger<RecommendationController> _logger;

    public RecommendationController(
        ITaskRecommendationService recommendationService,
        IUserTaskInteractionReadRepository interactionReadRepository,
        ILogger<RecommendationController> logger)
    {
        _recommendationService = recommendationService;
        _interactionReadRepository = interactionReadRepository;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [HttpPost("train")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> TrainModel()
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("ML.NET model eğitimi API üzerinden tetiklendi.");
        
        var allInteractions = await _interactionReadRepository.GetAll(false).ToListAsync();
        
        if (allInteractions.Count < 50)
        {
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = $"Yetersiz etkileşim verisi. En az 50 kayıt gerekiyor. Mevcut sayı: {allInteractions.Count}" });
        }

        var success = await _recommendationService.TrainModelAsync(allInteractions);

        if (success)
        {
            return Ok(new { success = true, message = $"Model başarıyla eğitildi. Eğitim veri sayısı: {allInteractions.Count}" });
        }
        else
        {
            return StatusCode(500, new { success = false, message = "Model eğitimi sırasında bir hata oluştu." });
        }
    }

    [HttpGet("status")]
    public IActionResult GetModelStatus()
    {
        return Ok(new 
        { 
            isReady = _recommendationService.IsModelReady,
            message = _recommendationService.IsModelReady 
                ? "ML.NET görev öneri modeli aktif ve hazır." 
                : "Model henüz hazır değil. Eğitim gerekli (en az 50 etkileşim kaydı sonrasında '/api/recommendation/train' tetiklenmeli)." 
        });
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Social.Commands.SendChallengeInvite;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Social.Commands.RespondToChallenge;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Social.Queries.GetActiveChallenges;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System.Security.Claims;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/social")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
public class SocialController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IFriendshipReadRepository _friendshipRead;
    private readonly IFriendshipWriteRepository _friendshipWrite;
    private readonly IChallengeReadRepository _challengeRead;
    private readonly IChallengeWriteRepository _challengeWrite;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userRead;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWrite;
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public SocialController(
        IFriendshipReadRepository friendshipRead,
        IFriendshipWriteRepository friendshipWrite,
        IChallengeReadRepository challengeRead,
        IChallengeWriteRepository challengeWrite,
        IAppUserReadRepository userRead,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWrite,
        IMediator mediator)
    {
        _friendshipRead = friendshipRead;
        _friendshipWrite = friendshipWrite;
        _challengeRead = challengeRead;
        _challengeWrite = challengeWrite;
        _userRead = userRead;
        _userWrite = userWrite;
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    // ================================================================
    // ARKADAŞLIK
    // ================================================================

    [HttpGet("friends")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetFriends()
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var friendships = await _friendshipRead.GetAll(false)
            .Where(f => (f.RequesterId == userId || f.AddresseeId == userId) && f.Status == FriendshipStatus.Accepted)
            .Include(f => f.Requester)
            .Include(f => f.Addressee)
            .ToListAsync();

        var friends = friendships.Select(f =>
        {
            var friend = f.RequesterId == userId ? f.Addressee : f.Requester;
            return new
            {
                friendshipId = f.Id,
                friendId = friend.Id,
                name = friend.Name,
                surname = friend.Surname,
                fullName = friend.FullName,
                userName = friend.UserName,
                level = friend.GeneralLevel,
                totalXP = friend.TotalXP,
                avatarId = friend.AvatarId,
                acceptedAt = f.AcceptedAt
            };
        });

        return Ok(new { success = true, friends });
    }

    [HttpGet("friend-requests")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetFriendRequests()
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var requests = await _friendshipRead.GetAll(false)
            .Where(f => f.AddresseeId == userId && f.Status == FriendshipStatus.Pending)
            .Include(f => f.Requester)
            .OrderByDescending(f => f.CreatedAt)
            .Select(f => new
            {
                requestId = f.Id,
                requesterId = f.RequesterId,
                requesterName = f.Requester.Name,
                requesterSurname = f.Requester.Surname,
                requesterUserName = f.Requester.UserName,
                requesterLevel = f.Requester.GeneralLevel,
                sentAt = f.CreatedAt
            })
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, requests });
    }

    [HttpPost("friend-request/{targetUserId}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> SendFriendRequest(Guid targetUserId)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        if (userId == targetUserId)
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Kendinize istek gönderemezsiniz." });

        var targetUser = await _userRead.GetByIdAsync(targetUserId.ToString());
        if (targetUser == null)
            return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "Kullanıcı bulunamadı." });

        var existing = await _friendshipRead.GetAll(false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(f =>
                (f.RequesterId == userId && f.AddresseeId == targetUserId) ||
                (f.RequesterId == targetUserId && f.AddresseeId == userId));

        if (existing != null)
        {
            var msg = existing.Status == FriendshipStatus.Accepted
                ? "Zaten arkadaşsınız."
                : "Zaten bir istek gönderilmiş veya mevcut.";
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = msg });
        }

        var friendship = new Friendship
        {
            RequesterId = userId.Value,
            AddresseeId = targetUserId,
            Status = FriendshipStatus.Pending
        };

        await _friendshipWrite.AddAsync(friendship);
        await _friendshipWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Arkadaşlık isteği gönderildi!" });
    }

    [HttpPatch("friend-request/{requestId}/accept")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> AcceptFriendRequest(Guid requestId)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var friendship = await _friendshipRead.GetByIdAsync(requestId.ToString());
        if (friendship == null)
            return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "İstek bulunamadı." });

        if (friendship.AddresseeId != userId)
            return Unauthorized();

        if (friendship.Status != FriendshipStatus.Pending)
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Bu istek artık beklemede değil." });

        friendship.Status = FriendshipStatus.Accepted;
        friendship.AcceptedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _friendshipWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Arkadaşlık isteği kabul edildi! 🎉" });
    }

    [HttpPatch("friend-request/{requestId}/reject")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> RejectFriendRequest(Guid requestId)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var friendship = await _friendshipRead.GetByIdAsync(requestId.ToString());
        if (friendship == null)
            return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "İstek bulunamadı." });

        if (friendship.AddresseeId != userId)
            return Unauthorized();

        friendship.Status = FriendshipStatus.Rejected;
        await _friendshipWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "İstek reddedildi." });
    }

    [HttpDelete("friends/{friendshipId}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> RemoveFriend(Guid friendshipId)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var friendship = await _friendshipRead.GetByIdAsync(friendshipId.ToString());
        if (friendship == null)
            return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "Arkadaşlık bulunamadı." });

        if (friendship.RequesterId != userId && friendship.AddresseeId != userId)
            return Unauthorized();

        _friendshipWrite.Remove(friendship);
        await _friendshipWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Arkadaşlık sonlandırıldı." });
    }

    [HttpGet("users/search")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> SearchUsers([FromQuery] string query)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query) || query.Length < 2)
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "En az 2 karakter girin." });

        var users = await _userRead.GetAll(false)
            .Where(u => u.Id != userId &&
                   (u.UserName.Contains(query) || u.Name.Contains(query) || u.Surname.Contains(query)))
            .Take(10)
            .Select(u => new
            {
                id = u.Id,
                name = u.Name,
                surname = u.Surname,
                userName = u.UserName,
                level = u.GeneralLevel,
                totalXP = u.TotalXP,
                avatarId = u.AvatarId
            })
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, users });
    }

    // ================================================================
    // SP-05: MÜCADELELER — MediatR Handler'lar
    // ================================================================

    /// <summary>SP-05: Mücadele listesi (status: active | invited | completed | all)</summary>
    [HttpGet("challenges")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetChallenges([FromQuery] string status = "active")
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var challenges = await _mediator.Send(new GetActiveChallengesQueryRequest
        {
            UserId = userId.Value,
            StatusFilter = status
        });

        return Ok(new { success = true, challenges });
    }

    /// <summary>SP-05: Mücadele daveti gönder</summary>
    [HttpPost("challenges/invite")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> SendChallengeInvite([FromBody] SendChallengeInviteCommandRequest request)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        request.ChallengerId = userId.Value;

        try
        {
            var result = await _mediator.Send(request);
            return Ok(result);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>SP-05: Mücadele davetine cevap ver (kabul/red)</summary>
    [HttpPatch("challenges/{challengeId}/respond")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> RespondToChallenge(Guid challengeId, [FromBody] ChallengeRespondBody body)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        try
        {
            var result = await _mediator.Send(new RespondToChallengeCommandRequest
            {
                UserId = userId.Value,
                ChallengeId = challengeId,
                Accept = body.Accept,
                Message = body.Message
            });
            return Ok(result);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>SP-05: Mücadeleyi iptal et</summary>
    [HttpDelete("challenges/{challengeId}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CancelChallenge(Guid challengeId)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var challenge = await _challengeRead
            .GetWhere(c => c.Id == challengeId && c.ChallengerId == userId, tracking: true)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        if (challenge == null)
            return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "Mücadele bulunamadı." });

        if (challenge.Status == ChallengeStatus.Completed)
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Tamamlanmış mücadele iptal edilemez." });

        challenge.Status = ChallengeStatus.Cancelled;
        _challengeWrite.Update(challenge);
        await _challengeWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Mücadele iptal edildi." });
    }

    // ================================================================
    // YARDIMCI
    // ================================================================

    private Guid? GetUserId()
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return null;
        return Guid.Parse(userIdString);
    }
}

    public int BonusXP { get; set; } = 200;
}

{
    public bool Accept { get; set; }
    public string? Message { get; set; }
}

using System;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Hubs;

[Authorize]
public class NotificationHub : Hub
{
    private readonly ILogger<NotificationHub> _logger;

    public NotificationHub(ILogger<NotificationHub> logger)
    {
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public override Task OnConnectedAsync()
    {
        var userId = Context.User?.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
        {
            // Kullanıcıyı kendi Id'sine sahip bir gruba al
            Groups.AddToGroupAsync(Context.ConnectionId, userId);
            _logger.LogInformation($"SignalR: User connected: {userId} ({Context.ConnectionId})");
        }
        
        return base.OnConnectedAsync();
    }

    public override Task OnDisconnectedAsync(Exception? exception)
    {
        var userId = Context.User?.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
        {
            Groups.RemoveFromGroupAsync(Context.ConnectionId, userId);
            _logger.LogInformation($"SignalR: User disconnected: {userId}");
        }

        return base.OnDisconnectedAsync(exception);
    }
}

using System.Net;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Middlewares;

public class GlobalExceptionMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ILogger<GlobalExceptionMiddleware> _logger;

    public GlobalExceptionMiddleware(RequestDelegate next, ILogger<GlobalExceptionMiddleware> logger)
    {
        _next = next;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task Invoke(HttpContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Sunucuda beklenmeyen bir hata oluştu: {Message}", ex.Message);

            await HandleExceptionAsync(context, ex);
        }
    }

    private static Task HandleExceptionAsync(HttpContext context, Exception exception)
    {
        context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";

        if (exception is FluentValidation.ValidationException validationException)
        {
            context.Response.StatusCode = (int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest;

            var validationResponse = new
            {
                IsSuccess = false,
                Message = "Doğrulama hataları oluştu.",
                Errors = validationException.Errors.Select(e => new
                {
                    Property = e.PropertyName,
                    Error = e.ErrorMessage
                })
            };

            var validationJsonResponse = JsonSerializer.Serialize(validationResponse, new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase });
            return context.Response.WriteAsync(validationJsonResponse);
        }

        context.Response.StatusCode = (int)HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError;

        var response = new
        {
            IsSuccess = false,
            Message = $"Sunucuda beklenmeyen bir hata oluştu." // Avoid exposing raw exception messages to the client
        };

        var jsonResponse = JsonSerializer.Serialize(response, new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase });
        return context.Response.WriteAsync(jsonResponse);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Bu servis hem veritabanına log düşer hem de SignalR Hub'ını kullanarak anlık push yapar.
/// </summary>
public class AppNotificationService : IAppNotificationService
{
    private readonly INotificationWriteRepository _notificationWriteRepository;
    private readonly IHubContext<Hubs.NotificationHub> _hubContext;

    public AppNotificationService(
        INotificationWriteRepository notificationWriteRepository,
        IHubContext<Hubs.NotificationHub> hubContext)
    {
        _notificationWriteRepository = notificationWriteRepository;
        _hubContext = hubContext;
    }

    public async Task SendNotificationAsync(Guid userId, string title, string message, string? type = null)
    {
        // 1. Veritabanına kaydet
        var notification = new Notification
        {
            AppUserId = userId,
            Title = title,
            Message = message,
            Type = Enum.TryParse<LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums.NotificationType>(type, true, out var parsedType) ? parsedType : LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums.NotificationType.SystemMessage,
            IsRead = false,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        try
        {
            await _notificationWriteRepository.AddAsync(notification);
            await _notificationWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

            // 2. Anlık olarak (çevrimiçiyse) gönder
            // Grup adı olarak userId kullanıyoruz (Hub içerisinde öyle tanımladık)
            await _hubContext.Clients.Group(userId.ToString()).SendAsync("ReceiveNotification", new 
            {
                Id = notification.Id,
                Title = title,
                Message = message,
                Type = notification.Type.ToString(),
                CreatedAt = notification.CreatedAt
            });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // Loglanabilir
            Console.WriteLine($"Bildirim gönderilirken hata oluştu: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }
}
